title: AI Systems Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.


Position description

The Business Technology team is composed of passionate technologists who are fully engaged in delivering the best products that help teams deliver their best work. We are focused on reducing friction and getting the most value from solutions to enhance outcomes. We want to expand our Business Technology landscape to manage more systems in a predictable way that accounts for scalability, resilience, and performance.

This role sits at the intersection of AI-native operations, enterprise platform engineering, and IT service management. You will own how Sonar designs, builds, and operationalizes AI-augmented systems across its internal technology ecosystem — engineering AI agents and connectors, automating workflows end-to-end, and integrating our enterprise tool stack, with Jira Service Management and the Atlassian suite as one core platform among several.

While Jira Service Management and the broader Atlassian suite form a core part of your platform footprint, your scope extends well beyond it: you will build and maintain integrations across our enterprise tool stack, engineer automation pipelines that eliminate manual work at scale, and operationalize AI-native capabilities (Enterprise Apps connectors, Claude MCP integrations, Rovo agents) that put Sonar ahead of the curve in AI-driven internal operations.

Your success will directly enable every internal team at Sonar to work faster, smarter, and with less friction — and will give leadership real-time visibility, consistent governance, and a platform that scales effortlessly with the company's global growth.


What you will do

You are confident in owning and evolving a multi-platform internal technology ecosystem for a fast-growing, multi-site, multinational organization. You bring deep expertise in building AI-native systems and automations, and you are equally at home administering and evolving ITSM platforms — especially Atlassian — that anchor Sonar's internal operations.

You bring proven, multi-year experience in:

  • AI Systems & Agent Engineering (primary focus): Designing, building, and operationalizing AI-native capabilities across Sonar's internal stack — Claude MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations, custom Claude skills, Rovo agents, and Enterprise Apps connectors. You prototype on the frontier, then harden what works into reliable, governed production systems that internal teams depend on daily.

  • ITSM Platform Ownership (JSM): Administering, configuring, and continuously evolving Jira Service Management — including service catalog design, SLA management, queue configuration, request type rationalization, and automated routing. You treat JSM as a product, not a ticket system.

  • Atlassian Suite Administration: Managing the full Atlassian Cloud ecosystem (Jira Software, Confluence, JSM, Guard, Loom, Trello, Bitbucket) with deep expertise in governance, user access management, project templates, and platform health monitoring.

  • Automation Engineering: Designing and implementing sophisticated workflow automations — using Atlassian Automation, REST APIs, and third-party middleware — that eliminate manual processes and scale operations without adding headcount.

  • Enterprise Integration Architecture: Building and maintaining integrations between Atlassian and adjacent enterprise systems (Slack, HR platforms, identity providers, monitoring tools) using webhooks, APIs, and marketplace apps.

  • CMDB & Asset Management: Owning JSM Assets configuration, data integrity, and lifecycle management across IT hardware, software licenses, and configuration items (CIs) — ensuring a reliable, audit-ready source of truth.

  • ITSM Process Governance: Defining and enforcing ITIL-aligned processes including incident management, change management, problem management, and access management — translating business needs into governed, automated workflows.

  • Security, Compliance & Audit Support: Ensuring platform configurations adhere to SonarSource's data protection, access control, and audit requirements. Supporting external audit engagements (KPMG, PwC) with documentation and evidence packages.

  • Stakeholder Enablement: Partnering with all internal teams (HR, Finance, Legal, IT, Security, GTM) to identify automation opportunities, gather requirements, and deliver continuous improvements — acting as a true internal platform consultant.

  • Platform Roadmap Contribution: Proactively identifying opportunities to modernize internal processes, adopt new platform capabilities, and drive the platform roadmap forward in partnership with the BizTech BackOffice lead


    • Experience and qualifications

    Experience & Technical Acumen

  • AI Engineering (Required): Hands-on experience with AI-native platforms and building on them — Claude/Anthropic, MCP, agent frameworks (Rovo or equivalent), connectors, and prompt-based workflows. You've built and shipped something real, not just experimented.

  • Atlassian Platform Expertise (Required): 5+ years hands-on administration of Jira Service Management (JSM), Jira Software, and Confluence Cloud in enterprise, multi-team environments. Deep knowledge of JSM request types, workflows, SLAs, queues, automations, and service catalog design.

  • Automation & Integration Engineering: Proven experience building workflow automations using Atlassian Automation and/or third-party tools. Comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON for system integrations. Scripting experience (Python, Groovy, JavaScript) is a strong plus.

  • Enterprise Tool Breadth: Experience with adjacent enterprise systems — identity providers (Okta, JumpCloud), collaboration tools (Slack, Zoom), or business systems (NetSuite, BambooHR, Salesforce) — is a strong differentiator. We don't need deep expertise in all of them, but curiosity and adaptability across the stack matters.

  • CMDB / Asset Management: Experience configuring and maintaining a CMDB or IT asset management system (JSM Assets, ServiceNow CMDB, or equivalent).

  • ITSM & ITIL Knowledge: Strong understanding of ITSM processes and ITIL v3/v4 frameworks — including incident, change, problem, and request management — with the ability to configure platform workflows that enforce these processes at scale.

  • Security & Compliance Awareness: Understanding of IT General Controls (ITGC), access governance, and audit-readiness requirements. Experience supporting external audit engagements is a plus.

  • Atlassian Certifications (Plus): ACP-620 (Jira Service Management), ACP-120 (Jira Administrator), or ACP-420 (Confluence Administrator) are highly valued.

    • Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities — you see patterns others miss and turn complexity into clean solutions.

  • Highly autonomous and pragmatic: you make concrete progress in the face of ambiguity and imperfect information, without waiting for perfect requirements.

  • Strong decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize across competing demands and manage multiple concurrent initiatives.

  • Self-confident enough to challenge the status quo — and to give and receive direct feedback in the service of continuous improvement.

  • Excellent communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Fluent in English, written and verbal.

  • Collaborative by nature: you share information and ideas freely, and you understand that the best solutions emerge from collective thinking.

  • Leadership mindset: you take ownership of initiatives end-to-end and drive them to completion with accountability and autonomy.

  • Values "done" over "perfect" — while continuously looking for ways to improve processes and deliver measurable impact.

    We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

    At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing - alternance
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Pourquoi Deliveroo ?

Lorsque l'on vous dit Deliveroo, vous imaginez sans doute d'abord les bons petits plats livrés chez vous en moins d'une demi-heure. Plutôt sympa non ? Mais c'est en coulisses que l'histoire est la plus intéressante. Nous opérons désormais à travers le monde et travaillons avec plus de 176 000 restaurants partenaires et commerces en tous genres en France. Nous collaborons avec des milliers de livreurs et de livreuses partenaires pour le plus grand bonheur de nos millions de personnes clientes.

Nous recherchons un·e Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing Merchant en alternance pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing à Paris, pour une durée de 12 mois. Aux côtés de l'équipe Merchant, vous contribuerez au développement de la croissance de nos partenaires, au déploiement de nos campagnes nationales 360° et en accompagnerez des projets à fort impact sur l'acquisition, la rétention et la fidélisation de nos restaurants partenaires.

Descriptif du poste :

En tant qu'Apprenti(e) dans l'équipe Marketing Merchant Restaurant, vous travaillerez au quotidien avec l'équipe marketing chargée de mettre en avant toute la sélection de restaurants et de partenaires de Deliveroo. Vous serez également amené(e) à interagir régulièrement avec les autres départements marketing tels que l'équipe média, l'équipe créative, le CRM ainsi qu'avec l'équipe commerciale.

Vos missions consisteront à:

  • Mettre en avant sur l'application les restaurants et partenaires disponibles sur l'app.
  • Soutenir l'équipe commerciale dans la création et l'exécution de plans marketing destinés à mettre en avant les partenaires présents sur Deliveroo.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe commerciale et les équipes marketing transversales (marque, réseaux sociaux, CRM et influenceurs) pour développer et exécuter des plans partenaires basés sur les priorités commerciales (par exemple, objectifs régionaux, accords d'exclusivité, renégociations).
  • Préparer des présentations et des supports pour appuyer les discussions de l'équipe commerciale avec les partenaires, en veillant à l'alignement et à la clarté.
  • Contribuer à l'exécution des points forts des partenaires en collaboration avec le CRM et le Commercial (communications mensuelles d'exclusivité / bannières dédiées sur l'application / notifications push...).
  • Gérer le budget alloué pour le plan de chaque partenaire, en optimisant les ressources locales pour obtenir un impact maximal.
  • Analyser l'impact de nos campagnes pour en tirer des recommandations pour les équipes commerciales

Cette alternance vous permettra d'appréhender de nombreux sujets marketing (création de campagne, analyse, sensibilité client) et vous permettra d'acquérir une bonne connaissance des enjeux marketing et de la gestion de projets complexes grâce à la collaboration transverse que vous aurez avec les autres pôles.

Ce qui vous permettra de réussir

Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5 en école de commerce, université ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en marketing, communication ou digital et recherchez une alternance d'une durée d'un an à partir de Décembre 2026 / Janvier 2027.

Vous Vous Reconnaissez Dans Les Points Suivants

  • Vous êtes organisé·e, rigoureux·se et savez gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle en respectant les délais
  • Vous avez une excellente communication écrite et orale en français ainsi qu'un bon niveau d'anglais.
  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec les chiffres et aimez analyser les performances pour en tirer des recommandations.
  • Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et la coordination de nombreux interlocuteurs.
  • Vous êtes curieux·se, proactif·ve et souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et en forte croissance.

Voici un lien avec de la documentation pour vous préparer aux entretiens.

Nous offrons un environnement de travail dynamique et stimulant, où vous aurez l'opportunité de développer vos compétences et de contribuer activement à notre mission. Rejoignez notre équipe exceptionnelle dès maintenant et faites partie de cette aventure passionnante !

La vie chez Deliveroo :

Notre équipe est en forte croissance, notre impact très important, et nous cherchons à répondre aux questions les plus stimulantes du moment. Nous progressons rapidement, nous explorons toujours de nouvelles idées et nous sommes très transparents quant aux décisions que nous prenons et à ce qui motive nos choix.

Il y a tellement de questions que nous souhaitons résoudre, et encore plus que nous n'avons pas encore rencontrées. Comment les données et la technologie peuvent-elles aider les restaurants à développer leur activité à mesure que les habitudes des consommateurs évoluent ? Comment pouvons-nous prédire ce qu'une personne souhaitera pour dîner avant même que l'idée ne lui vienne à l'esprit ? Chez Deliveroo, ces questions ne sont que quelques-uns des défis ambitieux auxquels nous nous efforçons de répondre – et il n'y a aucun projet qui ne peut pas devenir le vôtre. Aucune solution n'appartient à une équipe en particulier, ce qui vous ouvre d'extraordinaires possibilités en termes de développement et d'impact personnel.

À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l'article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité professionnelle, l'emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Backbone Fibre Connectivity Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

The role

As Backbone Fibre Connectivity Lead, you will lead delivery of the long-haul fibre that links Volta's AI factories and network locations. You will manage backbone route delivery across the portfolio, making sure capacity is in place, physically diverse and accepted before sites need it.

This is an expert-level individual contributor role, reporting to the Senior Director, Global Network Connectivity Delivery. You will drive alignment and set the delivery strategy for backbone delivery across network, procurement and site teams. Your view on route risk and diversity will directly steer commercial and network decisions.

What you will do

Backbone delivery

  • Own delivery of long-haul and inter-site backbone routes across Europe and North America to meet Volta’s requirements.

  • Manage carriers through complex processes including wayleaves, civils, PoP access and interconnection.

  • Escalate and recover routes that threaten facility turn-up, proactively leading recovery plans or identifying alternative routing options.

  • Lead network feasibility studies and outcomes for site due diligence.

Standards and commercial input

  • Set Volta's standards for backbone delivery and acceptance, including diversity evidence and optical test requirements.

  • Assess carrier proposals and route options, and advise Procurement and Legal on leased fibre, IRU and transport deals.

Handover

  • Ensure operational readiness, making sure restoration paths, support protocols, and records are fully prepared for Network Operations.

What we are looking for

  • Expert-level experience delivering long-haul fibre, backbone or carrier infrastructure, typically 9 to 12 years.

  • A proven track record of owning end-to-end backbone delivery across multiple complex routes or geographic regions.

  • Strong knowledge of dark fibre, managed transport, optical infrastructure and route diversity.

  • Commercial strength with carriers and IRU or leased fibre agreements.

  • Ability to influence network architecture, procurement and leadership decisions.

Nice to have

  • Experience in Hyperscale or data centre connectivity portfolios.

  • Optical transport systems and interconnection ecosystems.

  • Experience in International fibre procurement.

What We Offer

At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of.
As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do.

  • Competitive salary based on the work you do here, not your previous salary

  • Equity in Volta, giving you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success

  • Retirement/pension contributions

  • Comprehensive health, wellbeing and insurance benefits

  • Generous number of vacation days each year

Additional Information

Background Checks

All offers of employment at Volta are conditional on the satisfactory completion of pre-employment screening, which includes confirmation of your right to work, verification of your employment history and a criminal record check, where this is permitted by local law. Screening is carried out by Zinc, an accredited third-party provider, after an offer is made and all information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection law.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Broker Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

THE ROLE

Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission.

Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. You’ll engage them on the market-leading benefits of Flock’s connected fleet proposition, and how together, we can reduce risk, improve costs and save lives. You’ll also have real freedom in how you use AI to work, whether that’s getting under the skin of a broker’s book before a meeting or spotting growth opportunities across your panel.

A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

  • Act as a primary face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners, driving mutual growth and long-term success.

  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from broker research and meeting prep to analysing your pipeline, so your time goes on relationships rather than admin.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK:

ESSENTIAL

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing broker relationships within the insurance sector, possessing a reputable standing in the industry.

  • Energy and innovation in abundance - the ability to work fast, spot opportunity and solve problems.

  • A proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, driving business growth, and closely collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve collective objectives.

  • An existing network of broker contacts that will enable a rapid integration and immediate impact within Flock’s business development realm.

  • Exceptional understanding of the commercial broker marketplace, competitor carriers, broker business models, and processes.

  • Ability to deliver a consultative sales process, aligning Flock’s value proposition with brokers’ current and future business needs.

  • Comfortable using AI in your daily work, from research and meeting prep to account analysis, and curious about where else it could help you win business.

PREFERABLE

  • Have a broker distribution background with an active panel of brokers in the commercial insurance market.

title: Business Analyst - Enterprise & AI Solutions
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

Working in technology & innovation with WPP Enterprise Solutions

At WPP Enterprise Solutions Netherlands, we create connected brands to drive growth. Our expertise spans the full customer journey, with deep capabilities in commerce, consultancy, CRM, CX, data, production, technology, content, media and more. We deliver end-to-end solutions for ambitious B2B and B2C brands, supported by the wider WPP network.

Our work combines strategy, product thinking, experience design, data, engineering and AI to solve real business problems, from enterprise commerce modernisation and digital shelf excellence to AI-enabled content operations, marketing automation, GEO, workflow orchestration and custom AI agents.

About the team

You’ll join the Product Management & AI Solutions team: the group that bridges business strategy, customer experience and technology to deliver scalable commerce and enterprise solutions. We work closely with UX/CX, Data & AI, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Paid and Retail Media, Engineering and Delivery teams.

Our ambition is to move beyond isolated skills and build repeatable, outcome-led propositions around commerce growth topics such as Search & Discovery, Personalisation, CRO & Experience Optimisation, Product Data/PIM & Digital Shelf, Content Supply Chain & AI Content Operations, CRM & Lifecycle Growth, Performance & Retail Media, SEO/GEO and Composable Commerce Modernisation. Alongside this, we are growing our applied AI work: shaping and delivering custom AI agents and AI-enabled workflows for clients, from discovery and pilot through to production and continuous improvement.

Why this role exists

Clients are increasingly asking for integrated solutions rather than isolated delivery capacity. They need people who can understand the business problem, shape the product direction, define the right solution, translate it into clear specifications and guide teams through delivery. At the same time, AI is changing how commerce, content, marketing and operations work, creating a need for analysts who can combine structured requirements thinking with product ownership, enterprise technology understanding and the design of AI-enabled workflows and agents.

This role is designed for someone who can operate as a strong Business Analyst, step into Product Owner responsibilities when needed, advocate for product thinking inside the organisation and help turn our AI and commerce capabilities into scalable client value. You will work across both our commerce and enterprise product work and our applied AI work. The mix depends on client demand, and we expect the AI share to grow over time.

The role

As Business Analyst, Enterprise & AI Solutions, you bridge business needs, product direction and technical delivery across enterprise digital commerce and martech ecosystems. You analyse business processes, clarify user and stakeholder needs, define requirements and support solutioning across the commerce stack: CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation, paid/media platforms and integration layers.

You will also work on AI initiatives such as custom AI agents (for example for pricing, search or customer service), content and marketing automation, product/content enrichment, GEO and organic discoverability, AI orchestration and workflow automation. You do not need to be a machine learning engineer or a domain expert, but you must be technically curious and comfortable working with APIs, data flows, automation tools, LLM-based workflows, AI quality evaluation, governance requirements and human-in-the-loop processes.

Depending on your experience and the project context, you may act as a hands-on BA, a product-minded discovery partner, a proxy Product Owner or a work stream lead. In all cases, your job is to make ambiguity manageable, decisions explicit and delivery focused on measurable value.

What you will do

  • Collaborate with Solution Architects and Product Owners and translate business goals into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, tech architecture, data flows and integration specifications that delivery teams can act on.
  • Work across commerce, martech and enterprise ecosystems, including CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and media platforms.
  • Identify, shape and specify practical AI, automation and workflow orchestration opportunities across content, marketing, commerce and operational processes, from process mapping and readiness checks to a scoped pilot with a clear business case.
  • Specify AI agents and LLM-based workflows: define the task, data sources, tools and integrations, guardrails, human-in-the-loop steps and escalation paths, plus the evaluation criteria that decide when a solution is ready to go live. After launch, help measure quality, adoption and business impact.
  • Act as a Business Analyst or proxy Product Owner when needed by supporting prioritisation, backlog refinement, sprint planning, UAT, release preparation and stakeholder alignment.
  • Connect business, UX, data, SEO/GEO, content, engineering, legal and delivery teams to make sure solutions are valuable, feasible, scalable and well governed.
  • Help make our AI work repeatable and sellable: contribute to proposals, scoping and estimates, and build reusable assets such as discovery templates, requirement patterns, evaluation sets and playbooks.
  • At the senior end of the role, independently lead workstreams, own parts of the client relationship and coach junior analysts or product team members.

Who you are

  • A structured problem-solver who starts with the business problem, not only the requested feature.
  • A product-minded Business Analyst who can move between discovery, specification, prioritisation and delivery support.
  • Comfortable acting as a proxy Product Owner when a project needs stronger product ownership.
  • Technically fluent enough to discuss APIs, data flows, integrations, platform dependencies and implementation trade-offs with engineering teams.
  • Curious and pragmatic about AI: you use AI tools in your own work and understand the opportunity, but also the need for governance, quality, reliability and human oversight.
  • Comfortable with fast-moving technology: you focus on the problem and the outcome rather than a specific tool, and you pick up new platforms quickly.
  • Strong in workshops, stakeholder alignment and decision-making, with the confidence to challenge constructively.
  • Able to represent the Product Management & AI Solutions team inside WPP and help other teams understand the value of product thinking and applied AI.
  • Commercially aware: you can connect requirements and solutions to client value, efficiency, scalability, conversion, discoverability or operational impact.
  • Collaborative and low-ego, with the ability to work across Commerce, UX/CX, Data, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Media, Engineering and Delivery.

What you’ll need

The basics

  • 3-5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, Solution Analyst or similar role, ideally in commerce, martech, enterprise platforms, consulting or a digital agency environment.
  • Experience with digital commerce ecosystems, preferably B2B and/or B2C enterprise environments.
  • Working knowledge of platforms and domains such as CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and paid/media technology.
  • Strong experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, process flows and integration requirements.
  • Good technical understanding of REST APIs, web platforms, data flows, system integrations and common delivery dependencies.
  • Hands-on familiarity with generative AI tools and a working understanding of how LLM-based solutions behave, including their limitations and how to test the quality of their output.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with tools such as Jira, Confluence or similar.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, documentation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent professional English.
  • Currently residing in the Netherlands with a valid work permit.

Bonus points

  • Hands-on experience with automation tools such as n8n, Zapier or similar.
  • Experience shaping AI, LLM, agentic or workflow orchestration use cases in a business or delivery context, ideally including at least one that went live.
  • Familiarity with AI and agent platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, and with concepts such as retrieval (RAG), tool use and evaluation.
  • Familiarity with AI governance and regulation, such as the EU AI Act, and with responsible AI practices.
  • Experience with search and personalisation platforms, composable commerce, PIM/PXM, CDP, CRM or marketing automation platforms.
  • Experience with GA4, BigQuery, SQL, Python, Postman, Figma, Miro or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in Dutch.

In return, this is what we offer

You’ll get access to an international network of clients, colleagues, technology partners and resources. We have a listening ear for ambitious ideas, and together we keep stretching our boundaries. We want you to follow the path you’re building, and we invest in your personal development in a dynamic, collaborative workplace.

Our compensation

  • A monthly salary between €4,800 and €5200 gross, depending on your experience, seniority and fit with the role.
  • A gross annual 8% holiday allowance.
  • Access to our commuting package to suit your individual needs.
  • Competitive pension benefits.
  • A choice of a Mac or Windows laptop.

Our culture

  • A culture of trust, with a feel-at-home vibe and an international environment.
  • Mental health support, including complimentary membership EAP counselling services.
  • Wellness benefits (when available) including yoga classes, an in-house masseuse.
  • The opportunity to work with a renowned international customer base of B2B and B2C brands.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

title: Business Automation & AI Manager (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Automating the future and building the systems that make Foodji scale

Automation & AI sind dein Spielfeld und du weißt genau, wie man sie in echten Mehrwert verwandelt. Du bringst Struktur in komplexe Prozesse, denkst in Lösungen statt in Problemen und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Systeme nicht nur laufen, sondern mit uns wachsen. Der Bau unseres eigenen Foodji OS, das Operations & GTM steuert, ist genau die richtige Herausforderung für dich. Bei Foodji bekommst du die Bühne, um Automatisierung und AI dort einzusetzen, wo es wirklich zählt – mit spürbarer Wirkung auf unser gesamtes Business.

Deine Mission bei Foodji

  • Entwicklung und Implementierung komplexer, AI-gestützter Prozesse und Systeme von der Idee bis zum Go-Live. Dabei kannst du auf den Toolstack von Make.com, n8n, Claude (Code), Airtable & Snowflake zurückgreifen

  • Aktive Mitgestaltung unserer Datenarchitektur und unseres Context Layers für AI: Entwurf und Pflege unserer zentralen Datenmodelle als Fundament für AI & Automation

  • Verantwortung für unsere eigene Cloud-Schnittstelle: Spezifikation, Testing, aktives Monitoring und strategische Weiterentwicklung gemeinsam mit dem Tech-Team

  • Zuverlässiger Betrieb und kontinuierliche Optimierung unserer bestehenden Automatisierungen und Prozesse. Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle bei Störungen, Fehlern und laufender Pflege und sorgst dafür, dass alles reibungslos läuft

  • Proaktive Identifikation von Ineffizienzen, veralteten Strukturen und unnötigem Tool-Wildwuchs mit klaren Lösungsarchitekturen, die uns effizienter machen & neue Möglichkeiten kreieren

  • Steuerung und Betreuung von Stakeholdern aus Operations, GTM und Tech. Dabei kommunizierst du technische Lösungen verständlich und priorisierst konsequent nach Wirkung und Mehrwert

Das bringst du mit

  • 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Prozessautomatisierung, Systemintegration, Development oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Rolle, idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden Startup oder Scale-up

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Naturwissenschaften oder Betriebswirtschaft mit technischem Schwerpunkt

  • Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Low-Code- und Automatisierungstools (Make.com, n8n, Zapier o. ä.) sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in der Anbindung von Schnittstellen und Datenmodellen

  • Grundlegendes Verständnis in Scripting- und Programmiersprachen wie z.B. JavaScript oder Python - Einsatz von Code für individuelle Prozessschritte, Datentransformationen und Validierungen

  • Nah dran an den neuesten AI-Entwicklungen und bereits erfolgreiche Umsetzung von AI-gestützten Produkten, Systemen oder Prozessen

  • Strukturierte, dokumentationsaffine und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise – du sorgst dafür, dass Wissen nachhaltig im Team verankert bleibt und unsere Systeme mit uns skalieren

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Office Foodji: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

  • JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

  • Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen

  • Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven!

  • Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland

  • Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür

  • Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam!

NOCH FRAGEN?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.

Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

title: Business Development & Growth Intern
descriptionHtml:
Über Valova

Wir entwickeln KI-Software für Krankenhäuser, die administrative Prozesse in Dokumentation, Kodierung und Abrechnung automatisiert. Damit entlasten wir Klinikteams, sichern Erlöse und schaffen mehr Zeit für Patient.

Unser ambitioniertes Team aus Medizin, Technologie und Business arbeitet daran, die Krankenhausverwaltung nachhaltig zu verändern.

Deine Rolle

Du berichtest direkt an unseren Strategy & Business Development Lead. In dieser Rolle gestaltest Du aktiv mit, wie Valova den Klinikmarkt erschließt und nachhaltig wächst. Du identifizierst und qualifizierst relevante Kliniken, entwickelst gezielte Ansätze für unseren Outreach, eröffnest erste Gespräche und bringst potenzielle Kunden in unsere Demotermine. Gleichzeitig arbeitest Du eng mit dem Team an strategischen Initiativen im kommerziellen Bereich. Das reicht von der Weiterentwicklung unserer Go-to-Market-Strategie über neue Vertriebskanäle und Partnerschaften bis hin zur Optimierung unserer Sales-Prozesse. Darüber hinaus baust Du unsere operative Infrastruktur mit auf.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Neue Kliniken und Marktpotenziale erschließen: Du identifizierst vielversprechende Kliniken, von privaten Klinikgruppen über kommunale und ländliche Häuser bis hin zu Unikliniken. Du recherchierst die relevanten Entscheider:innen in Geschäftsführung, Finanzen, Medizincontrolling und Kodierung und qualifizierst neue Marktpotenziale.

  • Gezielte Kundenansprache entwickeln: Du konzipierst und steuerst Outreach-Kampagnen über Telefon, LinkedIn und E-Mail. Du entwickelst zielgruppenspezifische Ansprachekonzepte und eröffnest erste Gespräche mit potenziellen Kunden.

  • Unsere kommerzielle Strategie weiterentwickeln: Du unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Go-to-Market-Strategie und analysierst Markt- und Wettbewerbspotenziale. Außerdem arbeitest Du an strategischen Initiativen rund um neue Vertriebskanäle, Partnerschaften und kommerzielle Wachstumsfelder.

  • Skalierbare Sales-Strukturen aufbauen: Du entwickelst unser CRM, unsere Outreach-Sequenzen und unsere Sales-Playbooks weiter und etablierst aussagekräftige Dashboards.

  • Mit KI neue Möglichkeiten schaffen: Du identifizierst Automatisierungspotenziale und setzt KI-gestützte Workflows für Recherche, Datenanreicherung und Outreach um.

  • Vertriebsprozesse aktiv mitgestalten: Du entwickelst SOPs und interne Prozesse weiter.

Was Du mitbringst

  • Studium: Du studierst oder hast Dein Studium abgeschlossen, zum Beispiel in BWL, VWL, Gesundheitsmanagement, Medizin oder einem vergleichbaren Fach.

  • Erste Erfahrung: Du hast bereits erste relevante Berufserfahrung in Vertrieb, Business Development oder Strategieberatung gesammelt.

  • Offen und kommunikativ: Du gehst gerne auf Menschen zu und hast keine Scheu vor Telefonaten. Auch nach einem „Nein“ bleibst Du motiviert und freundlich.

  • Strukturiert und sicher im Umgang mit Zahlen: Du arbeitest gerne mit Daten und bist fit in Excel. Erste Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen, idealerweise Pipedrive, ist ein Plus.

  • Interesse an KI: Du nutzt gerne KI-Tools und hast Lust, neue Möglichkeiten auszuprobieren und Prozesse zu automatisieren.

  • Sprachen: Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch und fließend Englisch.

  • Arbeitsort: München.

Dir fehlen ein oder zwei Punkte, aber Du bist überzeugt, die richtige Person für diese Rolle zu sein? Dann bewirb Dich trotzdem. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Verantwortung von Anfang an: Du übernimmst eigene Aufgaben und Projekte und bringst Deine Ideen ein. Du siehst direkt, welchen Beitrag Deine Arbeit zum Wachstum von Valova leistet.

  • Schnell lernen und viel bewegen: Du bekommst früh Verantwortung und arbeitest an unterschiedlichen Themen. So sammelst Du praktische Erfahrung in einem stark wachsenden Health-Tech-Start-up.

  • Einblick in Strategie und Vertrieb: Du arbeitest nicht nur im Tagesgeschäft. Du gestaltest auch strategische Themen mit, etwa unsere Go-to-Market-Strategie, neue Partnerschaften und den Ausbau unserer Vertriebsstrukturen.

  • Ein Team mitten in der Stadt: Wir arbeiten gemeinsam vor Ort im WeWork am Odeonsplatz in München und im WeWork in Berlin-Mitte. Dich erwarten moderne Büros mit Kaffee, Meetingräumen und Phone Booths sowie zahlreiche Lunch-Spots direkt um die Ecke.

  • Gemeinsame Team-Events: Bei regelmäßigen Events bringen wir unsere Teams aus München und Berlin zusammen, denn gemeinsam arbeiten soll auch gemeinsam Spaß machen.

Der Bewerbungsprozess

Nach Deiner Bewerbung lernen wir uns in einem ersten Gespräch kennen. Anschließend tauschen wir uns vertiefend über Deine Erfahrung und Deinen Vertriebsansatz aus.

Zum Abschluss lernst Du unser Team persönlich in Berlin oder München kennen. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, freuen wir uns auf die Zusammenarbeit!

Klingt spannend? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

title: Business Development Representative, EMEA (Hybrid)
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Having surpassed $300M ARR and continuing to grow, Optro helps enterprises transform risk into opportunity through its AI-powered GRC Intelligence Platform. More than 50% of the Fortune 500, including 7 of the Fortune 10, leverage our award-winning technology to move their businesses forward with greater clarity and agility. And our customers love us: Optro is top-rated on G2.com and Gartner Peer Insights.

At Optro, we inspire each other to innovate and are proud of what we are producing. We spend each day thinking of new ways to help our customers and contribute to the greater good of our company and our surrounding communities. We are all about assisting each other and breaking through barriers to create the most loved audit, risk, ESG, and InfoSec platform by our customers. This is how we have become one of the 500 fastest-growing tech companies in North America for the seventh year in a row, as ranked by Deloitte!

***We are hiring multiple BDR positions based out of our London HQ to support our EMEA based AEs***

Why This Role is Exciting

The Business Development Representative (BDR) partners with Account Executives to drive pipeline growth by identifying and creating new qualified sales opportunities within an assigned territory. This role manages outbound campaigns in partnership with account executives, identifying decision makers at key accounts, and working to pre-qualify new opportunities and schedule meetings with potential buyers. Our BDR team is a critical component of our revenue organization and will fuel the next wave of company growth. Exceptional performers will have incredible opportunities for advancement within the company.

The ideal candidate for the Business Development Representative role will have an interest in a sales career, a strong work ethic, self-discipline, and time management skills. In addition to generating new business opportunities, your responsibilities may include developing long-term customer relationships, managing assigned customer accounts, partnering with account executives to assist with product demos, and developing and optimizing a sales pipeline while maintaining pursuit strategies focused on key decision makers. There will be career development and growth opportunities available to those who thrive in this role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Bring a world-class solution to market and function as the initial face of Optro

  • Generate new business opportunities to fuel Optro's growth

  • Leverage sales technology including Salesforce, Outreach, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Orum and UserGems to build and manage pipeline

  • Make 50+ outbound phone calls and 60+ outbound emails each day

  • Manage your named accounts, own your territory, and help maintain data integrity in Salesforce.com

  • Support marketing efforts by assisting in demand generation campaigns

  • Achieve, or exceed, weekly and monthly metrics including sales activities, meetings set, qualified leads, and new contacts prospected

Attributes for a Successful Candidate

  • Have a strong desire to launch a career in the world of SaaS sales

  • Audit or Accounting background a plus, but not required

  • Enjoy working in a collaboratively competitive and fun environment. Achieve your goals while also making others around you better too!

  • Think strategically - You’re going to need to partner with your sales team members to execute winning strategies to get more meetings with your target accounts

  • Be comfortable in a fast-paced, high-energy, ever-changing environment

  • Possess a go-getter attitude! You strive to turn any “No!” you get into a “Yes!”

  • Be coachable - we’ll provide feedback to help you grow and reach your best

  • Be confident using platforms like Salesforce.com, LinkedIn, and Outreach. It’s ok if you haven’t used them before! You’re smart and we’ll train you

  • Be committed to lifelong learning and continuous development personally and professionally

  • Be friendly, enthusiastic, thoughtful, and empathetic in your professional communication. Know your stuff so you have the ability to think on your feet in a conversation

  • You are highly organized and able to adapt to changing priorities

Perks (United Kingdom)

  • Launch a career at one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in North America and EMEA!

  • Live your best life (LYBL)! $200/mo (USD) for anything that enhances your life

  • Comprehensive employee health coverage

  • Pension scheme with company contributions

  • Competitive compensation & bonus program

  • Generous annual leave of 25 days plus bank holidays

  • Time off for your birthday & volunteering

  • Employee resource groups

  • Opportunities for team and company-wide get-togethers!

*perks may vary based on eligibility/location

Our Company Values

  • Customer obsession: It starts and ends here. Consistently ask yourself how what you’re doing creates value for our customers. It’s a mindset.

  • Gritty resilience: Make it happen. Find a way. Move fast, stay positive, and do what it takes.

  • Drive innovation: Create the future. Continuously improve what exists and invent what’s next.

  • Win, together: One team. No silos, no egos. Drive to be the best and support each other’s success.

  • Growth mindset: 10x, not 10%. Think in orders of magnitude, not increments. Seek feedback, learn, and improve.

We love building strong partnerships, but please note that Optro cannot accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Any submissions without a signed agreement in place will not create a fee obligation.

Privacy Notice for Candidates
When you apply for a role at Optro, we collect and process personal data including your contact details, resume, work history, and application responses to evaluate your candidacy. For full details on how we collect, use, and protect your data — including your rights under GDPR, UK GDPR, and US state privacy laws and other applicable data protection laws — please review our Candidate Privacy Notice.

  • Use of AI in Recruitment: Optro may use artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to assist in the screening and evaluation of applications, including resume parsing and candidate matching. These tools do not make final hiring decisions — all assessments are reviewed by our human recruitment team. You may opt out of AI-assisted screening at any time without impact to your candidacy by contacting Interview Recording: Optro may use recording and transcription technology during interviews. You will be notified before any recording begins and may opt out at any time without affecting your candidacy.

  • Background Checks: Background checks are required for this role. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. This role may have access to highly sensitive data, including employee data, customer data, company financials, and proprietary product information.

Optro does not sell candidate personal data.

Questions? Contact Optro's Privacy Team at

title: Business Development Representative - Mid-Market (German-speaking)
descriptionHtml:
Hybrid in Munich. C2 German Language is essential.

At Secfix, we’re at the forefront of automating security compliance in Europe. We help companies get and stay ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, and SOC 2 fast and easy and reduce hundreds of hours of manual work.

Secfix is run by a 100% remote team with hubs in Munich, Berlin and London. We’re a high-performing team looking for passionate, execution-focused, owners to help us automate security and compliance for modern companies and become the European compliance automation leader. We’ve just raised our $12M Series A and are backed by top VCs, including Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital.

About The Role:

We’re hiring a BDR to build and grow our mid-market segment in the DACH region.

You will join our Go-To-Market team and work closely with the GTM Lead and Account Executives to develop and execute a structured approach to winning mid-market accounts.

This is a high-ownership role where you won’t just execute outbound — you will help shape how we strategically approach and penetrate more complex accounts.

Your mission: identify, engage, and qualify mid-market accounts, build strong relationships, and generate high-quality pipeline.

We see this role as a fast-track opportunity for high performers. As the segment grows, strong results will translate into expanded ownership, increased strategic responsibility, and clear promotion opportunities.

What You'll Do:

You will play a key role in establishing Secfix’s mid-market presence in DACH.

We don’t micromanage — we give context, trust, and ownership. You’ll have the freedom to test, iterate, and improve how we approach mid-market accounts, while being fully accountable for your results.

You will:

  • Own and develop a portfolio of mid-market target accounts

  • Identify and prioritize strategic accounts based on ICP, industry focus, and buying signals

  • Build net-new pipeline through thoughtful, multi-touch outbound (calls, email, LinkedIn, events)

  • Navigate multi-stakeholder buying processes

  • Run structured discovery and qualification calls

  • Build long-term relationships and nurture accounts beyond initial outreach

  • Represent Secfix at relevant industry events

  • Collaborate closely with Account Executives to support deal progression

  • Maintain high CRM discipline and structured reporting in HubSpot

  • Contribute to refining messaging, segmentation, and mid-market playbooks

This is a strategic account-building role. Success is measured not just by volume, but by opportunity quality and long-term account development.

About You:

You are relationship-driven, structured, and commercially sharp. You think beyond individual meetings and understand how accounts are developed over time.

You bring:

  • 1+ year of experience (internship, working student, or full-time) in a fast-paced environment (startup, consulting, sales, business development, etc.) preferably in a client-facing role

  • Experience working with mid-market accounts or more complex sales cycles

  • A strong ownership mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not just activities

  • Excellent communication skills in German (C2 level) and strong English skills

  • Confidence engaging multiple stakeholders across different functions

  • Strong relationship-building skills across functions

  • A structured, strategic approach to account development

  • A data-driven mindset and comfort working with KPIs and CRM systems

  • A Bachelor’s/Master’s degree

You are motivated to grow into a Mid-Market AE or leadership role over time.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, security, compliance, or regulated industries

  • Experience leveraging industry events for pipeline generation

  • Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, Apollo

  • Experience in an early-stage startup (Series A–B)

  • Academic or extracurricular track record of high achievement (e.g. top university, competitive sports)

What We Offer:

  • Hybrid-Flexible Work: 2-3 days in our new sales office in Munich and added flexibility where needed.

  • Competitive Salary: Industry-competitive local salaries. We pay local rates that are at or above the market. We share this philosophy with GitLab.

  • Equity: Generous equity package – we’re all owners of Secfix and beneficiaries of our collective success.

  • Mentorship: We are backed by top VCs and accelerators and have direct access to world-class mentors.

  • Development Budget: €1,000 annual personal development budget.

  • Home office Budget: Home office budget and access to co-working spaces.

  • Holidays: 26 days holiday + local public holidays.

  • Annual Retreat: Annual retreat to build connections and inspire ideas (last year we’re headed to Costa Brava!).

  • Company Events: Company-wide events to build relationships and have some fun!

  • Tech Equipment: Latest tech equipment (MacBook, headphones).

Interview Process:

  • 30 min – Intro call with Talent team

  • Hiring Manager Interview

  • Take-home assignment

  • 60–90 min – Assignment review & Role Play with Head of Sales

  • 45 min – Final interview with Co-Founder/s

Please note: We are an equal-opportunity employer and remote-only company. At this time, we can support hiring only within EU time zones. We work in sync using Gather as our virtual office. As a small fast-growing company, we believe in the need for an in-sync component of daily communication and therefore cannot support 100% asynchronous work. Read more about our Remote Culture here.

title: C++ Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
C++ Software Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 60+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a C++ Software Engineer who wants to build low-latency trading infrastructure on Linux. You'll work on the core components of our Switchboard trading platform — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source

  • Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres

  • Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (3+ years)

  • Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code

  • Experience with performance-sensitive systems (profiling, optimisation, deterministic behaviour)

  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals (TCP/UDP, socket programming)

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems —trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to senior roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition
Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager
Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

 

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

title: CDI - Context & Analytics Engineer Manager - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Un agent ne vaut que ce que valent les données et les connaissances sur lesquelles il répond. Pipelines, modèles de données, définitions de métriques, droits d’accès : vous créez et gouvernez ce socle, et les applications et les agents de nos clients s’appuient dessus. Quand un analyste ou un agent demande un chiffre, la réponse est celle de l’équipe finance, accompagnée de sa définition et de sa source.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que les métiers et les agents puissent se fier aux données, et les utilisent.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Context & Analytics Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

Avec les équipes métier et les analystes, il s’agit de définir ce que signifie chaque métrique et de vérifier que les données y correspondent. Sur ce socle, les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers construisent applications et agents.

Les Platform Engineers exploitent l’infrastructure sur laquelle tournent vos pipelines. Les échanges avec les data owners et les équipes de gouvernance du client, la relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues complètent le quotidien.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des pipelines d’ingestion et des modèles de données, avec dbt par exemple.
  • Mettre en place des contrôles de qualité des données et maintenir le lineage.
  • Construire la couche sémantique et les définitions de métriques, pour que les personnes et les agents utilisent les mêmes chiffres, y compris en text-to-SQL.
  • Définir les règles de gouvernance et les droits d’accès.
  • Construire des pipelines de connaissances pour le RAG : indexation, chunking, métadonnées, permissions.
  • Préparer le contexte exploitable par les agents : métadonnées, définitions, lineage et permissions.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous écrivez du SQL avec aisance et modélisez les données pour l’analyse.
  2. Des pipelines de données planifiés, testés et surveillés figurent à votre actif.
  3. Aux côtés des équipes métier, vous définissez les métriques et vérifiez que les données veulent bien dire ce que tout le monde croit y lire.
  4. La qualité des données, la documentation et les droits d’accès comptent pour vous.
  5. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Python pour le traitement de données.
  • Une plateforme de données cloud, comme BigQuery, Snowflake ou Databricks.
  • Une couche sémantique ou un metrics store.
  • La préparation de documents pour le RAG : chunking, indexation, métadonnées.
  • Des outils de data catalogue ou de lineage.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Dans un métier où deux tableaux de bord affichent parfois deux chiffres différents, ce poste consiste à rétablir la confiance : un chiffre juste, une définition partagée, une source identifiable. Ce travail, discret quand il réussit, conditionne tout ce que les autres archétypes construisent au-dessus.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets, avec les AI Engineers et l’appui de la communauté Context & Analytics Engineer, notamment le context engineering, c’est-à-dire le travail qui rend les données exploitables par les agents d’IA. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Context & Analytics Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.
  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).
  3. Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.
  4. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.
  5. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.
  6. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 66 000€ à 85 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

title: CDI - Sales Executive - Large Accounts
descriptionHtml:
En rejoignant l’équipe Sales de Matera, tu auras l’opportunité d’échanger chaque jour avec des interlocuteurs très différents ! Il existe 600.000 copropriétés en France et chacune d’elle constitue une communauté à part entière, dont il nous faut comprendre le fonctionnement afin de les convaincre de nous rejoindre !

Nos prospects peuvent aussi bien être une petite copropriété de 3 lots en zone rurale, déjà autonome, qu’un grand ensemble immobilier de 300 logements en centre-ville, géré par un professionnel en face duquel nous présenterons une offre concurrente.

Au sein de notre département Sales, tu retrouves :

  • les SDR, dont l’objectif est de qualifier les prospects et d’organiser des démos avec les Sales Executive

  • Sales Executive, dont l’objectif est d’accompagner les prospects sur la suite du cycle de vente jusqu’à la signature du contrat.

Pour signer un contrat avec une copropriété, il faut obtenir la majorité des votes des copropriétaires lors de l'Assemblée Générale annuelle (cycle de vente est long et complexe - 3 mois en moyenne).

Onboarding et montée en compétences :

  • Sur les 6 premiers mois : tu vas monter en compétences sur la qualification des leads, le pitch aux prospects inbound et outbound, les produits de Matera, l’accompagnement dans le changement de syndic pour tes clients, les techniques de vente et tu vas te familiariser avec le monde de la copropriété (droit et compta notamment).

  • Ensuite : prise en main complète du cycle de vente, jusqu'à la signature des contrats - organisation et pitch lors des AG.

Les avantages

Les plus :

  • Package : 45€ à 65K selon profil et expérience,

  • 2 semaines d'onboarding pour comprendre le fonctionnement et les valeurs de Matera, et un onboarding spécifique à ton métier,

  • Un career path pour t’accompagner dans ton évolution professionnelle : accompagnement hebdomadaire par taon manager, 2 performances reviews par an, et politique de mobilité interne,

  • Politique de rémunération et de BSPCEs transparente,

  • Politique d’accompagnement à la parentalité : une reprise en douceur à 80% pendant 4 semaines (payées à 100%), ainsi que 5 jours de congés supplémentaires par an pour enfant malade,

  • Temps de Trajet Responsable (TTR) : 1 jour de congé supplémentaire par an, découpable en 2 demi-journées et rémunéré comme un congé payé, pour inciter à choisir des modes de transports responsables,

  • Congés menstruels : 1 jour de congé payé supplémentaire par mois, pour mieux gérer les règles douloureuses,

  • Sport : accès à Gymlib pour faire du sport à petits prix,

  • Des bons plans culture avec la plateforme Leeto (réductions cinéma, musées, parcs d'attraction...).

La base légale :

  • Congés payés et RTT (selon statut)

  • Mutuelle & Carte Swile - pris en charge à 50%

  • Prise en charge de la prévoyance à 100%

  • Prime vacances (SYNTEC)

  • Prise en charge des transports à 50%

  • Un ordinateur et équipements te seront fournis

Les informations pratiques :

  • Localisation : Paris

  • Télétravail : au moins 2 jours de présence au bureau, mais attention, des déplacements en IDF sont à prévoir pour ce poste (pour pitcher en AG).

  • Type de contrat : CDI

  • Statut : cadre

  • Date de prise de poste : Janvier 2027


Idéalement,

  • Tu as plusieurs années d’expérience sur les métiers de la vente,

  • Tu aimes la vente en B2C et aller au contact de tes clients,

  • Tu es déterminé·e, et as une bonne capacité d'exécution : tu es motivé·e par l'atteinte de tes objectifs et peux gérer un volume élevé de leads,

  • Tu as un fort esprit d’équipe, trouves des solutions rapidement.

  • Tu as une excellente communication orale et écrite : tu sais vulgariser des notions parfois complexes, et aller à l'essentiel.

Tu hésites entre les challenges de la vente complexe en B2C et le plaisir de parler à des individus très différents pour les fédérer autour d’un projet ?

Tu apprécies autant les outils digitaux que rencontrer tes prospects là où ils se trouvent ?

Tu rêves d’une équipe où tout le monde s’entraide pour atteindre et dépasser ses objectifs, sans oublier de passer de bons moments ensemble, pendant ou après les heures de bureau ? De participer à la création d’un leader européen des services immobiliers ?

Ne cherche plus et postule pour nous rejoindre !

Le processus de recrutement :

1️⃣ Premier entretien téléphonique de 20 à 30 mn avec notre recruteuse,

2️⃣ Entretien avec Inès, Head of SDR, et Paul, Team Lead (n+1), pour une mise en situation (45 en visio)

3️⃣ Entretien Jean-Cyril, Head of AE, et Justine, VP Sales, ainsi que ton équipe (1h au bureau)

4️⃣ Prise de références puis offre

À savoir :

🕑 Nous nous efforçons de faire un retour sur ta candidature le plus rapidement possible (sous une semaine). Que le retour soit positif ou négatif, tu recevras un mail de notre part - pense à regarder tes spams au cas où.

☝️ Si tu as besoin de prédispositions particulières pour réaliser les entretiens dans les meilleures conditions, tu peux le notifier lors de ta candidature et en informer l’équipe Recrutement.
