title: Flight Dynamics Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital is looking for a Flight Dynamics Software Engineer to join the Ground Platform organization.

You'll work on a small and driven team, developing our flight dynamics software stack so that it can:

  • Scale to fly 50+ satellites in orbit in a highly automated, reliable, and safe (from a collision avoidance perspective) manner
  • Enable new conops and customer missions with demanding orbit determination, stationkeeping, and attitude performance requirements

We're looking for someone with a solid theoretical understanding of astrodynamics, operational flight-dynamics experience, and software-engineering foundations. If you enjoy solving hard problems and working in a fast-paced and supportive environment, we'd love to hear from you.

We’re hiring for one position across multiple locations - you only need to apply once.


About this role:
  • Implement and improve upon algorithms for orbit determination, orbit propagation, maneuver planning (stationkeeping/orbit transfer), conjunction assessment, collision avoidance, and attitude modeling, contributing to our open-source astrodynamics tooling that powers both flight operations and simulation work across the company
  • Develop and maintain the in-house flight dynamics ground software backend applications that compute, store, and serve our fleet’s ephemerides, maneuvers, conjunctions, target orbits, etc
  • Interface with systems and mission engineers to help translate technical mission requirements and customer demands into operational outcomes in orbit
  • Support satellite operations engineers by providing astrodynamics expertise during LEOP/anomalies/conjunction response and assisting with configuring our software stack for various customer missions

    • Must Haves:
  • Bachelor's degree in physics or an engineering discipline
  • Deep technical understanding of some of the following topics: orbital mechanics, state estimation, spacecraft maneuver planning, conjunction assessment, and spacecraft attitude modeling
  • Fundamentals of numerical methods: solvers, optimization, and simulation techniques
  • Experience with designing and developing software libraries and backend services, in Python
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal

    • Nice to Haves:
    • Master’s degree in physics or an engineering discipline
    • Proficiency in astrodynamics tools such as STK, Astrogator, GMAT, OreKit, Monte, Copernicus, OpenSpaceToolkit, or equivalent
    • Demonstrated practical experience in spacecraft constellation flight dynamics operations
    • Demonstrated practical experience building high-performance backend software applications and/or libraries
    • Capable of solving complex problems within a highly collaborative environment

    Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences

At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.
    Who We Are
    Loft: Space Made Simple.
    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.
    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

Das Gründerteam hat zuvor BEAT81 mit aufgebaut und skaliert. Heute führen wir LIFTED profitabel und unabhängig.

Für unsere nächste Wachstumsphase suchen wir zwei Founders Associates, die direkt mit unseren Gründer:innen Frederike, David und Carl arbeiten. Beide Rollen bieten viel Gestaltungsspielraum und eigene Verantwortung – mit unterschiedlichen Schwerpunkten.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Founders Office

Du arbeitest direkt mit den drei Gründer:innen, bringst Struktur in offene Themen und baust Funktionen auf, bevor sie eigene Teams bekommen. Du wechselst zwischen unterschiedlichen Bereichen, erkennst, wo etwas fehlt, und sorgst dafür, dass es funktioniert. Dabei unterstützt du die Gründer:innen auch im Tagesgeschäft.

Deine Verantwortungsbereiche:

  • Customer Support: Gemeinsam mit Frederike und David entwickelst du die Prozesse, Tools und Automatisierungen weiter, mit denen wir Anfragen von Mitgliedern schnell und zuverlässig beantworten.

  • Property Management: Gemeinsam mit Carl baust du den Bereich auf, übernimmst zunächst selbst die Verantwortung, stellst eine:n Property Manager:in ein und übergibst die Funktion anschließend.

  • Onboarding: Gemeinsam mit Frederike entwickelst du den Onboarding-Prozess für neue Teammitglieder und sorgst dafür, dass alle einen guten Start bei LIFTED haben.

  • Hiring: Du unterstützt die Gründer:innen bei der Besetzung wichtiger Positionen in Marketing, Tech und Operations. Sourcing und Screening übernimmst du selbst, bei Interviews und Auswahlentscheidungen bist du eng eingebunden.

  • Founder Support: Du unterstützt unseren OKR-Zyklus, hältst das Org Chart aktuell, organisierst Offsites und Team-Events und übernimmst Ad-hoc-Analysen sowie weitere Themen, die bei den Gründer:innen anfallen.

2. Operations

Du baust die Strukturen, mit denen wir die besten Trainer:innen für LIFTED gewinnen, entwickeln und langfristig halten.

2027 kommen über 150 Trainer:innen in vier neuen Städten dazu. Dafür brauchen wir ein System, das funktioniert – von der ersten Bewerbung bis zum Einsatz im Studio.

Die Verantwortung teilst du dir mit Carl. Frederike und David sind eng eingebunden, denn unsere Trainer:innen prägen das LIFTED-Erlebnis entscheidend. Du entwickelst unser bisheriges Berliner Playbook zu einem skalierbaren System für mehrere Städte weiter.

Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Prozesse zu definieren: Du baust die notwendigen Strukturen und das Team auf und packst selbst mit an, bis alles funktioniert.

Deine Verantwortungsbereiche:

  • Recruiting & Auswahl: Du entwickelst unsere Recruiting-Kanäle und Auswahlprozesse weiter und definierst, woran wir erkennen, welche Trainer:innen zu LIFTED passen.

  • Onboarding & Education: Du baust ein skalierbares Onboarding- und Ausbildungssystem auf, mit dem neue Trainer:innen unser Workout lernen und in jeder Stadt auf demselben Niveau unterrichten können.

  • Entwicklung: Du etablierst Prozesse für Weiterbildung, Feedback und Offboarding und entwickelst ein System, das Performance und Vergütung sinnvoll miteinander verbindet.

  • Kapazitätsplanung: Du stellst sicher, dass jedes neue Studio zur Eröffnung ausreichend Trainer:innen für alle Trainingszeiten hat – inklusive verlässlicher Backups.

  • Teamaufbau: Anfangs übernimmst du viele Aufgaben selbst. Mit dem Wachstum baust du das Team auf, das die Prozesse langfristig eigenständig verantwortet.

  • City Launches: Du bist bei der Eröffnung neuer Städte vor Ort und sorgst dafür, dass Recruiting, Onboarding und Einsatzplanung rechtzeitig stehen.

Das bringst du mit

Du musst nicht alles schon gemacht haben. Wichtiger ist uns, dass du schnell lernst, Verantwortung übernimmst und Dinge eigenständig voranbringst.

  • Erfahrung: Rund 2–4 Jahre Berufserfahrung, zum Beispiel in einem Startup, in der Beratung oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle.

  • Aufbau-Mentalität: Du hast schon einmal etwas von null aufgebaut und weißt, dass es dabei nicht immer einen klaren Plan gibt.

  • Ownership: Du strukturierst offene Themen selbst, triffst Entscheidungen und bringst Dinge ins Ziel.

  • Struktur: Du kannst komplexe Themen herunterbrechen und daraus funktionierende Prozesse machen.

  • AI & Automatisierung: Du nutzt AI-Tools selbstverständlich, um Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten und wiederkehrende Aufgaben zu automatisieren.

  • Sprache: Deutsch auf C2-Niveau.

  • Standort: Du lebst in Berlin oder bist bereit, nach Berlin zu ziehen und regelmäßig mit uns im Büro zu arbeiten.

Das bringst du für Founders Office mit

  • Du kannst zwischen sehr unterschiedlichen Themen wechseln, ohne den Überblick oder die Qualität zu verlieren.

  • Du arbeitest gerne mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern und kannst die Bedürfnisse von drei Gründer:innen zusammenbringen.

  • Du kommunizierst klar, arbeitest zuverlässig und kannst auch sensible Themen eigenständig vorantreiben.

  • Plus: Erfahrung im Recruiting oder im Umgang mit Verträgen und externen Dienstleister:innen.

Das bringst du für Operations mit

  • Du denkst in Systemen, arbeitest gerne mit Daten und erkennst, wo Prozesse verbessert werden können.

  • Du kannst Menschen gewinnen, entwickeln und führen – sowohl Trainer:innen als auch dein eigenes Team.

  • Du bist gerne regelmäßig in unseren neuen Städten vor Ort.

  • Plus: Erfahrung mit freiberuflichen Teams, Marktplätzen oder standortübergreifenden Operations.

Was wir bieten

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründer:innen: Du arbeitest eng mit Frederike, David und Carl zusammen und verantwortest vom ersten Tag an eigene Themen.

  • Echte Aufbauverantwortung: Du entwickelst Funktionen und Systeme, die mit LIFTED wachsen und langfristig Teil unserer Organisation werden.

  • Wachstum aus nächster Nähe: Du erlebst 2027 mehrere City Launches und gestaltest die Expansion aktiv mit.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Mit dem Unternehmen wächst auch deine Verantwortung. Du kannst eigene Bereiche und Teams aufbauen und übernehmen.

  • Unser Office: Ein großes, helles Büro am Senefelderplatz, zwischen Mitte und Prenzlauer Berg.

  • LIFTED Membership: Kostenlose und unbegrenzte Mitgliedschaft in allen LIFTED-Studios.

  • Team: Gemeinsame Aktivitäten wie Padel, Grillen und regelmäßige Team-Events.

So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und eine kurze Notiz (3–5 Sätze) mit zwei Dingen:

  1. Welcher Schwerpunkt interessiert dich – Founders Office oder Operations – und warum?

  2. Was hast du schon einmal von null aufgebaut? Was war das Problem, was hast du gemacht und was hat sich dadurch verändert?

Uns interessiert weniger, ob du schon genau diese Rolle gemacht hast. Wir wollen verstehen, wie du denkst, Verantwortung übernimmst und Dinge aufbaust.

Start: Ab sofort

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

title: Founders Associate Intern (m/w/d) - Start-Up
descriptionHtml:
We are building Germany's leading tax advisory firm. Many business owners want a tax advisor who acts as a true sparring partner: proactive, responsive and strategic. What they often get is a service provider that books receipts and files returns, with little real advice. We're building the alternative.

Founded in 2025, Taxforce rethinks tax advisory from the ground up: AI-powered and highly automated, yet personal. We're starting with healthcare professionals, a complex and underserved segment, and we grow both organically and through M&A.

This is a €40B market in Germany alone, with processes that have barely changed in decades. AI now enables a fundamental shift, and there are no playbooks yet. We're writing them. We're a small, highly ambitious team in Berlin, backed by €5M from Tenet VC and founded by alumni of Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company, Y Combinator and the former Klarna Head of Engineering.

The role

Future founders: learn how to transform an industry using AI. You work directly with our founders on the topics that matter most right now, from investor updates and product to growth and finance, and you own each workstream from question to result.

Tasks

  • Investor relations. Prepare investor updates and board materials, from KPIs and financials to the storyline.

  • Reporting, controlling and finance. Build and maintain the reporting and financial planning that keeps Taxforce running, and support our invoicing, cashflow management and the monthly internal close.

  • Product. Shape our business intelligence product for practices, from monthly business analyses (BWA) to the reports that show practice owners where they stand on revenue, costs and liquidity.

  • Growth. Build and test ways to win new practices, from lead lists and outreach to content, partnerships and pricing.

  • Onboarding and support. Maintain our client onboarding process and help run client support, so that happy practices drive organic growth.

  • Getting things done. Own topics that cut across teams or have no owner yet, fix manual workflows at the root and automate them with AI as you go.

What this role is not: an assistant role, or strategy that stays on slides.

Requirements

  • Drive & ambition. You go the extra mile and thrive in fast-paced startup environments.

  • First practical experience. You’ve done internships or working student roles, ideally in consulting, investment banking, VC or tech.

  • Strong academic background. You study at or graduated from a well-regarded university or business school.

  • Analytical mindset. You break down complex problems and prioritise between many tasks.

  • Tech-savvy. You use AI tools every day and build small automations yourself.

  • German language skills. Our clients mostly speak German, so we require fluent German (C2) and strong English (C1+).

Benefits

  • Work directly with experienced founders. Learn first-hand from a team with backgrounds at Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company and Klarna, and from a former Y Combinator founder.

  • Learn from founders who have done it before. Work alongside a former Y Combinator founder and see first-hand how a company is built from zero.

  • Ownership from day one. Take on real responsibility early, on live clients, deals and projects.

  • Front-row seat to AI in the real world. See how AI transforms a traditional industry and help build it.

  • Hands-on venture building. Broad scope across growth, finance, operations and technology instead of one narrow function.

  • Steep learning curve. Work on real problems, ship quickly and build skills that prepare you to start your own company.

  • Future founders. Build the skills and the network to start your own company in a few years.

  • A path to stay. Strong interns get an offer to continue as working student or full-time.

The details

Full-time internship for 3 to 6 months, start any time of the year, on-site in our Berlin office five days a week.

How to apply

Send us your CV and a few lines on why this role fits you. Our process has three steps: a 30-minute intro call, a short live case from our day-to-day work, and a conversation with the founders.

About Pallet

Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy, a $12 trillion global TAM. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. 

Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, and control.

As companies across the physical economy look to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.

Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.

London, United Kingdom (Remote to start, transitioning to 5 days/week in-office once our local office opens)

You could be an Enterprise Account Executive anywhere. Why us?

  • Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.
  • Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.
  • Build Pallet’s presence across Europe as one of the first commercial hires on the ground.
  • Work directly with founders and senior leadership to define our international go-to-market strategy.
  • Help transform one of the world’s largest industries while building toward a $10B+ outcome.

About the opportunity

We’re hiring Founding EMEA Enterprise Account Executives to build Pallet’s commercial presence across Europe.

You’ll own net-new enterprise acquisition across the region, build relationships with the largest supply chain companies in Europe, and help establish the playbook for our international expansion. This is a highly consultative enterprise sales role focused on educating customers on an entirely new category of AI-powered workflow automation.

You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to drive a solution-selling motion centered around workflow discovery, AI use case identification, structured pilots, and measurable ROI.

Initially, this role will be remote from London while we establish our UK presence. Once our London office opens, this role will transition to working from the office five days per week when not traveling to customer sites.

How you will make an impact

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle across EMEA, from outbound prospecting through contract signature.
  • Build and maintain a 3x-4x qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound execution while self-sourcing at least 30% of opportunities.
  • Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Europe’s largest logistics providers, including COO, CIO, VP Operations, VP Supply Chain, and VP Technology.
  • Lead consultative discovery sessions that map operational workflows to Pallet’s AI agent capabilities.
  • Scope and lead structured pilots that demonstrate measurable operational ROI and convert into enterprise deployments.
  • Build executive business cases that align operational improvements with financial outcomes.
  • Document repeatable customer use cases and market feedback to shape Pallet’s product roadmap and international GTM strategy.
  • Help establish Pallet as the leading AI platform for enterprise logistics across Europe.

What we’re looking for

  • 8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS or enterprise logistics sales experience.
  • Business-fluent French: you can run discovery, negotiate and present to executives in French. 
  • Proven track record of consistently closing six- and seven-figure enterprise software agreements.
  • Strong consultative selling and value-based sales methodology.
  • Experience navigating complex buying committees and long enterprise sales cycles.
  • Executive presence with senior operators and technology leaders.
  • Comfortable selling technical, workflow-heavy software products.
  • Ability to quickly understand complex logistics operations and translate them into compelling AI automation opportunities.
  • Excellent outbound prospecting and territory-building discipline.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.

Experience selling into logistics, supply chain, transportation, or warehouse operations is strongly preferred but not required. Candidates without logistics experience should demonstrate an ability to quickly learn operational workflows and become trusted advisors to customers.

Working model

Working hours are generally 9:00am-6:00pm London time, providing full coverage of the European business day while maintaining regular collaboration with our San Francisco headquarters.

You’ll typically spend:

  • Mornings and early afternoons working directly with European customers and prospects.
  • Late afternoons collaborating with our US-based Sales, Product, and Engineering teams during our daily overlap window.
  • Approximately 75% of your time traveling across Europe for customer meetings, executive workshops, pilots, and industry events.

Reporting structure

You’ll report directly to our VP of Global Revenue, for territory strategy, customer relationships, and international expansion and will participate in weekly pipeline reviews, forecasting, and sales process alignment with the US team.

Interview Process

  • Chat with Christy - Business Recruiter - 30 mins
  • Deal Review with VP of Global Revenue - 30 mins
  • Discovery Mock Interview - 45-60 mins
  • Final Interview - 2hr hours
  • Brief Background Check and Reference Check

We move fast, and we’ll keep you informed at every stage of the process.

Compensation

The estimated compensation range for this role is £220,000-£280,000 OTE, 50/50 split, depending on experience and skill set.

Our compensation follows a standard 50/50 enterprise sales structure consisting of base salary and target commission. High performers are eligible for uncapped commission accelerators above quota.

In addition to cash compensation, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and significant growth opportunities as one of our earliest international commercial hires.

Final compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated enterprise sales performance.

Our Benefits 

We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously.

  • 🩺 Health, Vision, and Dental benefits 
  • 🏝️ Take-what-you-need Paid Vacation
  • ➕ Life Insurance and Accidental Insurance 
  • ❤️‍🩹 Short-Term Disability Coverage
  • 💸 Generous salary and equity for all staff
  • 🪜 401k option; helping you save for the future
  • 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Paid parental leave to support growing families
  • 📚 Yearly learning and development stipend
  • 🚌 Commuter benefits for Bay Area and New York employees
  • 🚘 Uber ride stipend if you ever have to work late in the office 
  • 🏡 Remote office home stipend to get you comfy in your space for remote employees
  •  📸 Free professional headshot 
  • 🍔 Daily catered lunches and dinners provided in office
  • 💪 Complimentary On-Site Gym: Our SF office has a fully equipped gym 
  • ✈️ Onboarding trip to one of our offices if you work remotely
  • 🥤 Monthly happy hours
  • 🎉 Annual Company Offsites; our last one was in Palm Springs CA 🌴

Workplace Policy

We are an in-person company. Our offices in San Francisco, New York City and London are where ideas get built, decisions get made, and the team gets stronger. We have invested in making them genuinely great places to spend your day, with catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and people who care about the work and each other.

Most of our team works in office five days a week. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip. 

Every role is different. Travel expectations are always shared upfront in the job description and confirmed in your first call with us.

Equal Opportunity

Pallet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, disability status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We prohibit any form of discrimination or harassment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring.

Candidate Privacy Notice

Please review Pallet’s Candidate Privacy Notice here.

Accommodations

Pallet complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended by the ADA Amendments Act, and all applicable state or local laws. We will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with a disability during the application process and throughout employment as required by law.

If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please contact us at Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Founding GTM Lead, Founders Office (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Full-time | Onsite in Berlin Mitte or Potsdam-Babelsberg

You can work from either of our two offices.

About PLACED

With PLACED we are building the data and agent infrastructure for modern talent markets, unlocking a >€1TN global opportunity to make talent markets radically more efficient. Our first product, an agentic sales OS on top of a prediction system for the job market helps human and AI staffing agents win business and place candidates radically faster.

Since launching in mid-2026, we work with leading staffing firms and have just closed our first institutional funding round. Next come AI staffing, job boards and employers. We are now looking for our first senior GTM lead to help us build the next European tech champion.

Your role

You work directly with our founders, Fatih and Kai, to build and expand PLACED’s commercial business. You will develop GTM processes, test markets and channels, shape commercial offerings and take full ownership of customer segments and projects. You will own projects across the company and take on whatever needs doing.

You start with the customer, make AI the default and own what you take on end to end. This is a senior role with no direct reports at the start. As we grow the commercial team, you help hire and shape it.

What you'll own

  • AI workflows. Build AI into research, copywriting, image and video production, outbound, and reporting. Automate the repeatable steps so you can run more tests each week. Check claims, visuals, and prospect data before anything goes live.

  • Market and messaging. Speak with agency owners and sales teams. Find out what makes them look for a tool like PLACED, what they use today, and what stops them from switching.

  • Pipeline and sales: Build target lists, run outbound and partnerships, lead discovery calls and demos, and close deals, with the founders alongside you on strategic accounts.

  • Next segment: Decide with the founders which segment and use case we win after staffing. Test it with real customers and build the playbook to scale it.

  • Offer and story: Shape packages, pricing and propositions, and sharpen how we tell the PLACED story in sales calls, decks and campaigns, and on our website.

  • GTM system: Build the processes, HubSpot setup, reporting and AI workflows that make the whole team faster. Bring customer feedback back to Product.

  • Founder projects: Own end to end whatever moves PLACED most right now.

What you bring

  • Experience: 4+ years in GTM, business development, sales or a Founders Office, ideally in B2B SaaS, vertical AI or staffing.

  • Commercial results: You've owned business results, such as a segment, a channel or a set of accounts, and can explain what you built and what it generated.

  • Range: You're as comfortable on a call with an agency owner as in a pricing model or a HubSpot report.

  • First principles: You understand the problem before you reach for the standard solution, and you can show it in how you built a deal, a channel or a process.

  • AI in your daily work: You use agents to get work done and can point to something you've built, automated or sold. You know which steps to automate and where the output needs your judgment.

  • Languages: Fluent German and English. You write clearly in both.

What you get

  • Competitive package: Salary + VSOP, calibrated to seniority.

  • Team: Work in a small, focused and experienced team with high talent density. High trust, high outcome.

  • Room to grow: Own projects and take on more responsibility as you deliver.

  • Health & learning: Urban Sports Club membership and a €1,000 annual learning budget.

  • Everyday support: Monthly budget for Uber or cleaning services.

  • Live close to the office: Extra gross salary for living within a 10 or 20 minute walk.

  • Late evenings: Dinner and an Uber home when you stay until 8pm or later

title: Founding sales lead
descriptionHtml:
Who are we?

The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable.

Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction: detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them.

We sell to navies and coast guards, and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy.

Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa, the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk.

⚡ What is at stake in the coming months

  • Confirm the technology at sea with navies and operators.

  • Deploy and sign our first paid pilots.

  • Sign our first contracts.

By joining us, you'll play a key role in turning that early traction into multi-year protection contracts, and in building the sales team that follows.

🎯 Your mission

  • Own every deal from first meeting to signed contract, with navies, port authorities and operators of cables and offshore energy.

  • Sell interdiction, not detection alone: make the threat and the gap between alarm and response concrete for each buyer, then turn pilots into multi-year protection contracts.

  • Shape requirements before the tender: work with navies and operators months ahead of an RFP so that it asks for detection and action together.

  • Open our priority export markets: the Baltic and the Nordics, the Black Sea, the Gulf and Southeast Asia.

  • Work as a pair with Gauthier, our Co-CEO, on key accounts, and bring Aymeric and the engineers in when the technical conversation starts.

  • Build the partner channel: primes and integrators, offshore and cable operators, and local partners in each country.

  • Turn every deployment into a reference the next customer can check.

  • Set up the sales machine, then hire and lead the first sellers.

📈 How you will be measured

  • First 3 months: you own the pipeline, have a qualified deal plan for each priority region, and a first paid pilot or LOI is signed.

  • 6 months: paid pilots are running and the first contracts are signed.

  • 12 months: recurring contracts in at least two countries, and your first sales hires are made and ramped.

🤩 This job is your dream job if:

  • You have closed defense or government deals and want to do it again, from zero, where every contract changes the trajectory

  • You like being the second half of a founder pair: the CEO brings operational credibility, you bring the deal

  • You'd rather be on a plane to Tallinn, Constanța or Abu Dhabi than in a forecast meeting

  • You speak engineer well enough to sell sensors, AI and C2

  • You want to write the sales playbook yourself, then hire the team that runs it

🙅 This job is not for you if:

  • You need a brand, a marketing team and SDRs to sell

  • You have only sold short-cycle SaaS or SMB deals, never through formal procurement

  • You want to manage a large team from day one rather than close deals yourself

  • Sales cycles of 12 to 24 months and 40% travel put you off

  • You are looking for the comfort of a large defense group

What we offer

  • A founding role in a seed-stage defense tech company backed by Hexa

  • Fixed salary, variable on signed revenue, BSPCE

  • Offices in Paris, real deployments at sea

🧭 Our recruitment process

  1. A first call to get to know each other.

  2. A deep dive into two deals you closed.

  3. A case study on a real Pelagon challenge, presented to the founders.

  4. A conversation with the founders.

  5. Reference checks, with your consent.

  6. Offer.

We answer after each step.

Pelagon is committed to creating a diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment irrespective of gender, origin, identity, background and sexual orientation.

title: Founding Strategy & Operations
descriptionHtml:
Alassio recherche son (sa) prochain(e) Founding Strategy & Operations !

  

Missions

 

🏗️ Alassio en quelques mots

En France, la paie et le social comptent parmi les fonctions les plus réglementées qui soient. Entre inflation réglementaire et évolutions légales et conventionnelles incessantes, la conformité est devenue un véritable fardeau pour les cabinets de paie et les services RH :

  • ce fardeau les empêche de se consacrer à ce qui compte vraiment, le conseil et l'accompagnement des salariés, qui en subissent donc eux aussi le poids ;

  • c'est aussi l'un des métiers où l'attrition est la plus forte en France, notamment parce que 60 % du temps des gestionnaires de paie est encore consacré à de la saisie ou à de la relecture manuelle.

Pourtant, des solutions technologiques majeures existent : l'IA permet en particulier d'automatiser une très grande partie des tâches les plus pénibles et de valoriser les données sociales. Mais le secteur reste largement à l'écart de cette révolution, et le problème n'est pas seulement réglementaire : le marché était verrouillé par des éditeurs historiques vieillissants, difficiles à quitter faute d'alternative crédible et de moyens pour migrer efficacement. Là aussi, l'IA fait voler ces barrières en éclats et ouvre la voie à une vague d'innovation attendue depuis des décennies.

C'est pour y répondre qu'Alassio construit la plateforme de paie et de gestion RH moderne qui manquait à ce marché, au service des cabinets et de leurs clients TPE/PME. Notre ambition est de développer en un temps record :

  • une plateforme collaborative et ouverte, qui s'intègre nativement aux outils des cabinets et de leurs clients, respecte leurs habitudes de travail et fluidifie les échanges entre gestionnaires de paie et entreprises ;

  • l'automatisation de la tenue administrative : collecte des données, paramétrage des évolutions légales et des règles propres à chaque entreprise, génération automatique des rapports et formulaires, traçabilité juridique dynamique et en temps réel, etc. ;

  • la valorisation des données de paie et sociales, pour offrir un conseil social à 360° et enfin répondre efficacement à l'ensemble des attentes des salariés, qui se sont de surcroît largement amplifiées depuis le Covid : gestion contractuelle, pilotage de la masse salariale, avantages salariés, fidélisation des talents, mutuelle…

L'objectif : devenir le « People OS » sur lequel les cabinets et leurs clients TPE/PME s'appuient pour gérer l'intégralité de leurs problématiques paie et RH.

 

🚀 Tes responsabilités

Ta mission est de concevoir et faire vivre les systèmes de fonctionnement d'Alassio. Concrètement, tu identifies partout dans l'entreprise ce qui empêche les équipes de travailler à l'échelle (un process défaillant ou absent, un passage de relais flou, une information introuvable, une tâche répétitive que personne n'a pris le temps d'automatiser) et tu le résous de bout en bout : un diagnostic précis, puis un cahier des charges documenté et actionnable, puis l'accompagnement de sa mise en œuvre jusqu'à son adoption effective par les équipes. Une solution que personne n'utilise n'est pas une solution.

Tes leviers sont aussi bien managériaux (formalisme interne, rituels, répartition des responsabilités) que produit et techniques (modèle de données, outillage, automatisation des flux de travail), avec un parti pris constant : « Just build it ». Tu mettras en place, avec les équipes concernées, des solutions actionnables et des systèmes qui tournent.

 

🧭 Tes premiers chantiers

Pour te donner une idée concrète, voici le type de chantiers que tu pourrais mener dans tes six premiers mois :

  1. Bâtir un réseau national de formateurs et d'intégrateurs certifiés, pour permettre aux cabinets de se former partout en France sans saturer nos équipes à chaque pic de déploiement : modèle économique et tarification, maillage du territoire avec les Sales, parcours de certification et suivi qualité avec l'équipe DnA (Déploiement & Accompagnement), cadre contractuel, et circuit de remontée des demandes des cabinets vers le support et le Product. En bref, tu contribueras à mettre sur pied une place de marché d'intégrateurs et de formateurs Alassio.

  2. Fluidifier le parcours d'un cabinet, de la signature à la production : formaliser les passages de relais entre les squads Sales, DnA, Métier & Juridique et Tech (ce qui est transmis, dans quel outil, dans quel délai, et qui tranche en cas de blocage). Ce travail se traduit par la mise en place de workflows au sein de Bedrock, notre OS interne : il rend l'ensemble du contexte d'Alassio interrogeable et permet de transformer quasi instantanément une solution que tu as formalisée en gain concret pour toute l'équipe.

  3. Améliorer en profondeur, en coordination étroite avec l'AI Engineer, notre OS Bedrock pour en faire le réflexe par défaut de toutes les équipes : identifier les cas d'usage transverses à plus fort impact, structurer le contexte métier qui alimente l'OS, travailler sur l'hébergement et la dimension collaborative, mettre en place des workflows d'agents déclenchés par événement, tenir à jour le catalogue des commandes, et mettre en place le suivi qui mesure la performance et l'adoption.

  

Profil recherché

 

🌱 Expérience

  • Au moins 2 ans d'expérience dans des rôles opérationnels (GTM, Ops) ou en conseil en stratégie, idéalement avec une dimension technique, dans des contextes où tu as vu la structure d'une équipe évoluer vite (par exemple une scale-up, ou une refonte organisationnelle chez des clients en conseil)

  • Une compréhension fine des goulots d'étranglement organisationnels et informationnels qui ralentissent les entreprises à mesure qu'elles grandissent, et des transformations que l'IA est en train d'y opérer

  • Le goût des défis techniques et un esprit très analytique, sans perdre ton profil généraliste : tes expériences t'ont amené(e) à croiser les expertises, entre commercial et technique, produit et métier

 

💎 Qualités

  • Un goût pour l'optimisation et l'organisation : tu aimes que les choses soient claires, que l'information soit facile à mobiliser, propre et maintenable, et tu prends plaisir à produire vite des éléments actionnables

  • Un biais très fort pour l'action : tu repères les problèmes avant qu'on te les signale, et tu ne t'arrêtes jamais au diagnostic

  • Penser à l'échelle : tu conçois dès le départ des solutions capables d'encaisser des montées en charge ×10 ou ×100, tout en restant pragmatique sur ce qui compte à court et moyen terme

  

Processus de sélection

  1. Premier entretien avec Tancrède (CEO) : 45 min

  2. Étude de cas à partir de situations réelles, à dominante métier, avec Tancrède, Maxime (Head of Sales) et Alexandre (Responsable DnA) : 1 h30

  3. Étude de cas à partir de situations réelles, à dominante technique, avec Hector (COO) et Paul Rousseau (Founding SWE) : 1 h30

  4. Rencontre informelle de l'équipe dans nos bureaux, puis échange séparé avec les fondateurs

  5. Deux à troise prises de référence

  

Ce que nous offrons

 

👊 Une mission unique

Tu rejoins une aventure entrepreneuriale en plein passage à l'échelle, sur un marché verrouillé depuis des années. Notre conviction : les bons process libèrent les équipes, les mauvais les étouffent. Ton rôle est précisément de concevoir les premiers, pour que chaque équipe d'Alassio aille plus vite, avec l'ambition assumée de bâtir une référence en matière d'organisation nativement construite autour de l'IA.

Le poste a vocation à grandir avec l'entreprise : selon tes envies et ce que tu auras construit, il pourra évoluer vers la direction des opérations, la structuration d'une nouvelle fonction ou le lancement d'une nouvelle activité.

 

🎁 Rémunération et avantages

  • 💰 Package de 60 à 70K€ + BSPCE

  • 🏥 Mutuelle Alan

  • 🍽️ Carte Swile (titres-restaurant)

  • 💻 Matériel informatique haut de gamme (MacOS, écran incurvé)

  • 🤓 Offsite légendaires

title: General Application - Join our Talent Community!
descriptionHtml:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now.

Your work will contribute to turning advanced robotics into reliable, manufacturable and deployable technology for real-world industrial applications.

Don't see the right role?

Great people don't always fit neatly into an existing job description. If you're excited about what we're building but haven't found a suitable opening, we'd still love to hear from you!

We're always interested in meeting people who want to help shape the future of robotics and Physical AI, whether your expertise lies in:

  • Engineering & Robotics: Mechanical engineering, electronics, actuators, embedded systems, controls, robotics and system integration.

  • Software & AI: Robotics software, machine learning, perception, motion planning and software development.

Our team will review your application and get in touch if we see a potential match with our current or future opportunities. If there isn't an immediate fit, we'd be happy to stay connected for relevant opportunities down the road, subject to your consent.

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

descriptionHtml:
Growth at Private Equity Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

Babyzone is an innovative and fast-growing UK early childhood charity. It runs free, open-access community hubs for families with children aged 0-5 in areas of high deprivation, bringing together services, programmes and partners to improve outcomes for young children and their families.

 THE GRADUATE OPPORTUNITY

Joining Blenheim Chalcot as a Graduate, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced and progressive environment while working exclusively with Babyzone. You will be embedded within the Babyzone team and contribute to meaningful projects that support the charity's growth, operations and impact, while benefiting from Blenheim Chalcot's learning, development and employee benefits.

For you as a graduate, this opportunity involves:

  • Dedicated to Babyzone – although you will be employed by Blenheim Chalcot, your role will sit fully within Babyzone. Your day-to-day work, projects and objectives will be focused entirely on supporting Babyzone and its mission, giving you the opportunity to build deep experience within a fast-growing, mission-led organisation.
  • Training & Development – we pride ourselves on having an intentional and continuous learning and development culture at Blenheim Chalcot. You will have access to BC learning and development opportunities designed to strengthen your core professional, commercial and leadership skills, while applying that learning directly to your work at Babyzone. You will learn by doing, taking on real responsibility and developing quickly within the Babyzone team.
  • Early Careers Development – as a BC graduate, you will have access to structured development opportunities designed for those early in their careers. These will support your professional growth while your role itself remains fully dedicated to Babyzone.
  • Graduate Community – you will be part of the wider BC graduate community, with access to relevant learning sessions, networking opportunities and socials. This community is intended to support your development and connection with fellow graduates; your substantive role and day-to-day responsibilities will remain entirely within Babyzone.
  • Accountability – you will be given meaningful responsibility from the outset and supported to take ownership of work that matters. Rather than rotating between businesses, you will build continuity and depth within Babyzone, seeing the direct impact of your work on the organisation and the families and communities it serves.

ARE YOU BC? 

We are not expecting you to have worked in start-ups before or to have studied a tech related degree. For us, it is about hiring the right person and their potential, not just their experience. As such, we are looking for graduates from any discipline – different areas of expertise are great for new perspectives. 

We look for some key fundamentals in people when hiring into the BC Group. We look for people who are:

  • Curious – people in BC are inquisitive, they want to understand ‘why’ and consider if there is a better approach rather than take on the ‘it’s how we’ve always done it’ perspective. Given our ethos is all about disrupting industries with new methods and products, curiosity is at the heart of what we do.
  • ‘Doers’ – surprisingly, this is not a given in a lot of working environments; we are a community of pro-active self-starters. We will provide full support to our graduates, though we do look for proactive people who can use their initiative and drive on a daily basis. Working in an environment where everyone has this trait is incredibly refreshing and we strive to maintain it.
  • Flexible Mindset – working in a growth business environment is ambiguous, diverse and, at times, chaotic by definition. Being adaptable and recognising the importance of flexibility to add value in a constantly evolving company is vital for us.
  • Enthusiasm – you do not need to be a ‘techy’ at heart to work in our environment. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic about what digitalisation is doing to industries and a drive to work in a pioneering sector which represents that drive. A desire for doing new and challenging things makes coming into work a whole lot more fun.
  • Humble & Sociable – building a tech start-up is never easy. As such, we have a ‘no-ego’ policy and seek out people who bring energy to a team, not drain it. We have a down-to-earth and personable culture; we solve complex problems but do not take ourselves too seriously and look to have fun whilst doing so.

If you see yourself in this and would like to work with similarly minded people, we would love to hear from you!

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU AS A BC EMPLOYEE:

  • Be part of the UK’s leading digital venture builder and have the opportunity to be a part of and learn from the incredible talent in BC
  • Be exposed to the right mix of challenges and learning and development opportunities while building deep, hands-on experience within Babyzone
  • A fun and open, if a little cricket obsessed, atmosphere
  • Discretionary bonus
  • 25 days of paid holidays + your birthday off
  • Life Assurance, Pension Scheme, Cycle to Work Scheme
  • Flexible Benefits including Private Medical and Dental, Gym Subsidiaries

APPLICATION & PROCESS

If you are keen to apply, please submit your CV and a member of our Talent Team will contact you with next steps. We have a rigorous recruitment process, which we use for all our roles to ensure we attract the very best talent. 

We have a three-stage process that will consist of the following:

Stage 1: Telephone interview with a member of the BC Talent team

Stage 2: Virtual assessment day, consisting of both individual and group activities

Stage 3: Final interviews with Blenheim Chalcot and Babyzone at Scale Space, White City

*Please note the timeframes provided above are subject to change, which we will communicate throughout the process*

Blenheim Chalcot is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Diversity is one of our core values, thus making it core to our business. We strive to maximise the diversity of our workforce and welcome applications from everyone. We encourage diversity through perspective, background, identity, and thought whilst also fostering an environment where everyone can express themselves regardless of your race, religion, sex, gender, colour, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We are committed to continuing to nurture an inclusive environment and building a diverse workforce.

By submitting your CV you understand that we have a legitimate interest to use your personal data for the purposes of assessing your eligibility for this role.  This means that we may use your personal data to contact you to discuss your CV or arrange an interview, or transfer your CV to the hiring manager(s) of the role you have applied for.  You can ask us at any time to remove your CV from our database by emailing  here.

title: Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Kurz und knapp

Du hast dein Studium in der Tasche, sprühst vor Energie und willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern echte Verantwortung übernehmen?

Bei Picnic startest du direkt in einer Führungsrolle durch! Als Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d) in unserem teilautomatisierten Fulfillment Center (FC) in Falkensee bist du der Motor des Standorts. Unterstützt von Investoren wie der Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation bauen wir gemeinsam das modernste, 100 % elektrische Liefersystem Europas.

Sei von Anfang an dabei: Im August 2027 eröffnen wir unser neues teilautomatisiertes FC in Falkensee. Du kannst aber schon früher bei uns starten und dein Onboarding an einem unserer bestehenden Standorte absolvieren - zum Beispiel in unserem manuellen FC in Ludwigsfelde oder unserem vollautomatisierten FC in Oberhausen. So bekommst du einen umfassenden Einblick in unsere Operations und bist bestens vorbereitet, wenn wir in Falkensee an den Start gehen.

Das erwartet dich 

  • Teamleitung: Du bist Coach und Vorbild – mit deinem echten, intrinsischen Interesse an Menschen führst und inspirierst du dein Team aus 5 Lead Shoppers und über 150 Shoppers.
  • Schichtleitung: Im FC behältst du stets den Überblick, priorisierst Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass jede Bestellung pünktlich rausgeht.
  • Abwechslung: Du erlebst den perfekten Mix aus Action direkt auf der Lagerfläche (4 Tage pro Woche) und strategischem Deep Dive im FC Office (1 Tag pro Woche).
  • Prozessoptimierung: Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast Ideen? Hier entwickelst du eigene Logistikprojekte und hebst unsere Abläufe durch deinen Tatendrang aufs nächste Level.
  • Ownership: Du hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, auch wenn Dinge mal außerhalb deines unmittelbaren Bereichs liegen. Du schaust über den Tellerrand hinaus und nimmst die Dinge proaktiv selbst in die Hand.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) in Logistikmanagement, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
  • Du brennst für die Logistik und bringst idealerweise erste Einblicke aus dem Lagerbereich mit (z. B. durch Praktika oder ein Werkstudium).
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch & Englisch und bringst die nötige Flexibilität für die Arbeit in zwei Schichten (6:00 – 14:30 Uhr & 14:30 – 23:00 Uhr, auch samstags) mit.
  • Ein extrem hohes Maß an Eigenantrieb. Du siehst Dinge von selbst, nimmst sie proaktiv in die Hand und übernimmst Verantwortung – auch über deinen eigenen Tellerrand hinaus.
  • Ein echtes, intrinsisches Interesse an Menschen. Du bist empathisch, nahbar und liebst es, dein Team zu motivieren und weiterzuentwickeln.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.
  • Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Individuelle Mobilität:  Du entscheidest, wie du zu uns kommst. Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kostenlose Parkplätze an den Picnic Standorten stehen dir zur Verfügung. Dazu bieten wir ein „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm an.
  • Lebensmittelretter: Hol dir unsere exklusiven "Too-Good-To-Go"-Tüten und rette leckere Lebensmittel – nur für unsere Mitarbeitenden!
  • Lerne & wachse: Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.
  • Absicherung für morgen: Wir unterstützen dich mit einem überdurchschnittlichen Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, damit du auch an später denkst.

descriptionHtml:

Today, over 100,000 users across 40+ countries rely on the Acturis platform. By working closely with brokers, insurers, and MGAs, we continue to shape the market and drive new standards across both personal and commercial lines.

title: Grafikdesigner, Mediengestalter
descriptionHtml:
Tradition, Kreativität und Medienkompetenz – willkommen bei Horn Druck & Verlag!

Die Horn Druck & Verlag KG ist ein traditionsreiches, inhabergeführtes Unternehmen, das seit 1986 erfolgreich in der Fitness- und Gesundheitsbranche tätig ist. Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden mit individuellen Marketinglösungen, kreativen Gestaltungskonzepten und einer persönlichen Beratung.

Dabei verbinden wir langjährige Branchenerfahrung mit modernen Medien, frischen Ideen und einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen engagierten Grafikdesigner oder Mediengestalter (m/w/d), der Freude an kreativer Arbeit hat und unsere Kundenprojekte gestalterisch mitentwickeln möchte.

Der reguläre Arbeitsort ist unser Unternehmensstandort in Bad Schönborn. Alternativ ist auch eine Besetzung am Standort Berlin möglich.

Ihre Aufgaben – kreativ, vielseitig und abwechslungsreich

Sie gestalten unterschiedliche Print- und Digitalprodukte für unsere Kunden aus der Fitness- und Gesundheitsbranche und begleiten deren Umsetzung von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Ergebnis.

Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

  • Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Printmedien wie Anzeigen, Flyern, Broschüren, Magazinen und Werbemitteln

  • Entwicklung und Gestaltung digitaler Werbemittel für Websites, Social Media und Online-Marketingkampagnen

  • Bildbearbeitung, Retusche und kreative Aufbereitung von Bildmaterial

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung visueller Gestaltungskonzepte unter Berücksichtigung der jeweiligen Corporate Designs

  • Erstellung und Aufbereitung druckfertiger Daten

  • Weiterentwicklung bestehender Layouts und Gestaltungsvorlagen

  • Abstimmung mit unserem Marketing- und Verlagsteam sowie die Umsetzung individueller Kundenwünsche

Das bringen Sie mit

Sie haben eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Bereich Grafikdesign, Mediengestaltung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation abgeschlossen und verfügen über ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung, Farben, Typografie und Bildsprache.

Darüber hinaus wünschen wir uns:

  • Gute Kenntnisse in den gängigen Grafik- und Layoutprogrammen, idealerweise Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator und InDesign

  • Erfahrung in der Gestaltung von Print- und Digitalmedien

  • Kreativität, Sorgfalt und einen Blick für Details

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • Freude daran, eigene Ideen einzubringen und gestalterische Lösungen zu entwickeln

  • Teamfähigkeit und eine offene Kommunikation

Sie müssen nicht jede Anforderung perfekt erfüllen. Wenn Sie gestalterisches Talent, Motivation und die Bereitschaft mitbringen, sich weiterzuentwickeln, freuen wir uns ausdrücklich auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Ihre ersten Monate bei uns

Uns ist wichtig, dass Sie gut bei uns ankommen. Deshalb erhalten Sie eine strukturierte Einarbeitung und lernen zunächst unsere Kunden, Projekte und internen Arbeitsabläufe kennen.

Während Ihrer sechsmonatigen Probezeit werden Sie Schritt für Schritt an Ihre Aufgaben herangeführt, übernehmen erste eigene Gestaltungsprojekte und arbeiten zunehmend eigenständig an unseren Marketingkampagnen und Kundenaufträgen.

Dabei stehen Ihnen erfahrene Kollegen als Ansprechpartner zur Seite. Auch die Abläufe unserer Druckproduktion lernen Sie kennen, damit Sie Ihre Gestaltungsideen optimal für die spätere Umsetzung vorbereiten können.

Arbeiten bei Horn Druck & Verlag – das erwartet Sie

Wir bieten Ihnen einen abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsplatz in einem etablierten Unternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem kollegialen Arbeitsumfeld.

Ihre Vorteile:

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag in Vollzeit (40 Wochenstunden)

  • Abwechslungsreiche Projekte für namhafte Kunden aus der Fitness- und Gesundheitsbranche

  • Persönliche und begleitende Einarbeitung mit festem Ansprechpartner

  • Möglichkeiten zur internen Weiterbildung und beruflichen Entwicklung

  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten und Raum für kreative Ideen

  • Lockere Kleiderordnung und angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre

  • Kostenlose Parkmöglichkeiten direkt vor Ort am Standort Bad Schönborn

  • Bezahlte Krankheitstage im Rahmen der geltenden Regelungen

Ihr möglicher Arbeitsort: Bad Schönborn oder alternativ Berlin.

Klingt das nach Ihrer nächsten beruflichen Herausforderung?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen! Senden Sie uns Ihre aussagekräftige Bewerbung inklusive Lebenslauf und – wenn vorhanden – Arbeitsproben oder Portfolio. Gerne möchten wir erfahren, welche kreativen Ideen Sie in unser Team einbringen möchten.

title: Group Financial Accountant
descriptionHtml:
The Group Financial Accountant will provide support in preparing the consolidated Group accounts for publishing (both internal and external) and be a main point of contact for EY, the Group’s external auditors. Additionally, the role will deputise for the Senior Director, Financial Reporting.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Financial Reporting and accounting

    • Maintain the Groups consolidation system (BPC) and perform basic consolidations including generating and posting consolidation journal entries

    • Ensuring accurate and complete exchange rates are maintained in SAP and BPC

    • Supporting colleagues using BPC to generate Group reports e.g. Group cash reporting and tax reporting

    • Account for the Group’s internal and external debt including loan fees

    • Accounting for deferred taxes on Group intangibles and deferred revenues

    • Reporting on Group Fixed assets in reporting currency (USD)

    • Accounting for Group Intangibles including amortisation

    • Support local Controllers with lease accounting entries

    • Maintain the Group’s external Cash Flow model

    • Support the US GAAP reporting team and help maintain the analysis of GAAP bridge adjustments

    • Support the preparation of annual consolidated Group accounts and related audit requests

    • Prepare detailed accounts for Sophos Parent (Jersey) with emphasis on equity movements

    • Prepare intermediate holding company annual report and accounts

    • Prepare external reports as requested by the owners e.g. Hart-Scott-Rodino

    Share-based payments

    • Maintain / update valuations of equity awards on the Groups Equity platform for the purposes of expense valuation reporting

    • Support Local entity controllers with annual disclosures

    • Generate detailed movement tables for disclosure notes

     

    Ad hoc

    • Provide accounting support and / or oversight for internal restructurings

    • Assist in the accounting for major transactions e.g. acquisitions / debt refinancing

    • Support management queries / report requests

    • Investigate large / unusual account movements

Experience

  • Essential

    • Good grasp of basic accounting entries (debits and credits)

    • Large company ERP system exposure, SAP preferred

    • Understanding of basic consolidations

    Desirable

    • Working within a global organisation, ideally a software company

    • IFRS and US GAAP accounting standards

    • Accounting for the impact of foreign exchange rates

Skills & Abilities

  • Essential

    • Excellent communication skills at all levels

    • The ability to work to deadlines whilst maintaining accuracy and attention to detail

    • Good MS Office skills, particularly Excel to intermediate level (pivot tables and Lookups)

    Desirable

    • Presentation skills

    • Experience using AI tools, particularly the Microsoft suite of products

    • Exposure to foreign currency impact and consolidations

Qualifications

  • Essential

    • Newly qualified ACA / ACCA

    Desirable

    • Treasury

Training

  • Essential

    • Training and mentoring will be provided as part of the position, with the aim of being able to deputise for the Senior Director, Financial Reporting

    Desirable

    • An ambition to continue studying and developing skills in relation to consolidations / large transactions / Treasury

Sophos supports flexible ways of working, with many roles offered remotely and others working in a hybrid model. For remote roles, you may work remotely within the location specified in the job posting. Candidates must reside in and be authorized to work in that location. Our teams collaborate across locations and time zones, using technology to stay connected and deliver results.

 

Our Commitment To You

Sophos welcomes applicants with diverse experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds. We believe great ideas come from different ways of thinking, and we are committed to building a workplace where people can contribute, grow, and succeed.

We evaluate all candidates based on job-related skills, qualifications, and experience, and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities consistent with applicable laws and regulations.

title: Growth Operations Apprentice
descriptionHtml:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot,based on 60,000 reviews. Our cultureputs customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

 

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 byAlexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

 

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

 

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

Join Qonto's Growth Operations team apprentice and help build the data connections and integrations that power our growth channels. You'll work under the guidance of Hugo, our Lead Growth Operations.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Make our Growth Engine go further: You'll configure API integrations so data flows reliably between systems (Salesforce, Segment, Braze, Meta, etc.), our marketing tools and beyond.

  • Fuel outbound with data: You'll build data enrichment flows to provide the Sales teams with the best insights to convert prospect into loyal customers.

  • Boost our Paid Acquisition campaigns by owning website tracking and tagging.

  • Deliver powerful insights for business teams: You'll use SQL and Python or JavaScript, with AI tools to move faster, to turn messy data into insights teams can act on.

  • Investigate issues and improve our infrastructure: You'll take down recurring blockers and bring your own solution so the team gets stronger every time.

  • Be a sparring partner for Engineering: You’ll help challenge and shape technical choices with our engineers, so the integrations and data flows you build hold up at scale.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Data confidence: You're comfortable with at least two of SQL, JavaScript or Python.

  • Integration mindset: You understand APIs and enjoy making different systems work together.

  • Technical and analytical background: You're studying software engineering, data science or a similar field.

  • AI-fluent: You use AI to move faster and stay critical about the output.

  • English: You can work and communicate in English every day; French is a plus.

  • Analytical: you know how to transform raw data into valuable insights for non technical stakeholders

  • Problem solver: you enjoy tackling structural issues and make other people's jobs easier with your solutions.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Three skill sets, one team: You'll work alongside the Ops, Product and Engineering sides of Growth Operations.

  • Room to shape your path: We encourage breadth across domains, so you grow into the areas that suit you.

title: Head of Cementitious Product (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Co-reactive is a fast-growing greentech company with a clear mission: We transform CO₂ into high‑performance construction materials, enabling climate‑friendly building for everyone. At our brand‑new site in Erkrath, we unite laboratory, production, and development under one roof. Our pilot plant already showcases what the construction industry of tomorrow will look like.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Head of Cementitious Product who will take full ownership of translating our R&D efforts into market‑ready, certifiable, and scalable products. In this role, you sit at the critical interface between research, engineering, operations, and customers ensuring that our technology becomes a repeatable product that succeeds technically, regulatorily, and commercially.

At Co-reactive, we embrace a maker mentality and a common goal: reshaping the construction sector. As a startup team, we move fast, make decisions quickly, and implement them decisively. You will take over customer projects once they are set up and lead them to successful product delivery.

We value diverse perspectives and open communication. Embedded in a strong network of customers, industry partners, and technical experts, you will have significant autonomy to shape our product portfolio and play a defining role in scaling a breakthrough climate technology.

Tasks

As Head of Cementitious Product, you are responsible for shaping, executing, and safeguarding Co-reactive’s products from early customer projects to scalable, certifiable, and market‑ready offerings. You translate scientific innovation into robust products by combining technical depth, customer focus, and structured execution across the organization.

  • Take full ownership of translating Co-reactive’s R&D efforts into market‑ready, certifiable, and scalable construction material products, ensuring clear product definitions aligned with market, regulatory, and industrial requirements
  • Assume responsibility for customer projects once they are set up and lead them through implementation to successful technical, regulatory, and product outcomes, acting as the single point of accountability for product‑related success
  • Define, lock, and manage product scopes, specifications, performance requirements, and boundary conditions for customer‑specific and standard products, balancing customer needs with long‑term platform strategy
  • Act as the central interface between R&D, engineering, operations, and customers, translating scientific insights and experimental results into concrete product definitions, application concepts, and use‑case‑specific solutions
  • Drive engineering refinements and product optimization with a strong focus on manufacturability, scale‑up readiness, robustness, cost implications, and repeatability across sites and customers
  • Own decisions on which feedstocks are suitable for which products and applications, and evaluate and validate product performance for targeted use cases, ensuring technical credibility, comparability, and scalability
  • Lead the product‑side certification and regulatory pathway, including REACH, CE marking, DIBt approvals, and relevant EN/DIN standards, and translate regulatory requirements into clear product development priorities
  • Act as technical key account lead for strategic customers during product execution, supporting sales and business development with credible technical‑product narratives, documentation, and customer‑ready materials
  • Manage the evolution of the product portfolio across lifecycle stages, from prototype and pilot products to pre‑commercial and commercial offerings, and prepare structured, data‑driven product recommendations for executive decision‑making

Requirements

You combine technical depth with a strong sense of ownership and pragmatism. You are motivated to take complex technology and turn it into real‑world products that can be deployed at scale.

  • Degree in Materials Science, Civil Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or a related field; a PhD is a strong plus
  • 6+ years of experience in product development, technical project leadership, or application engineering in construction materials, cement, concrete, mineralization, or related industries
  • Solid understanding of cementitious materials, inorganic materials, mineral processes, or industrial materials systems
  • Proven experience with certification, standards, and regulatory frameworks for construction materials (e.g. REACH, CE, EN/DIN, DIBt)
  • Experience working at the interface of R&D, engineering, and customers, ideally in industrial or scale‑up environments
  • Strong ability to structure complex problems, make trade‑offs, and drive execution across teams
  • Excellent communication skills, able to bridge scientific, industrial, and commercial perspectives
  • Hands‑on mindset, high level of ownership, and passion for climate‑positive construction technologies

Benefits

We offer you more than just a job — we offer you ownership, responsibility, and the chance to shape a new category of climate‑positive construction materials.

  • A key role at the heart of Co-reactive’s technology‑to‑market journey, with direct impact on customer success and product strategy
  • High level of ownership over product decisions, customer projects, and certification pathways
  • Close collaboration with the CEO, Head of R&D, engineering, and operations
  • A dynamic startup environment where your work quickly translates into real‑world impact
  • Access to state‑of‑the‑art lab, pilot, and production facilities at our new site in Erkrath
  • Exposure to leading customers, industry partners, and regulatory bodies in the construction sector
  • Attractive compensation package with competitive salary and equity participation options
  • 30 days of annual leave and a modern working culture focused on trust, autonomy, and responsibility
  • An inclusive, mission‑driven team committed to decarbonizing the global construction industry

Ready to reshape the construction sector with us?
