title: Head of Electronics & software
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Head of Electronics & Software

Purpose

We are looking for a Head of Electronics & Software to lead and develop the engineering capability behind some of the most critical systems in our spacecraft.

This is a senior leadership role combining people leadership, engineering excellence, organisational development and technical breadth. You will lead a multidisciplinary organisation spanning:

  • Avionics, communications and electrical power systems

  • Flight software (FSW)

  • Guidance, navigation and control (GNC)

  • Electrical wiring and interconnection systems (EWIS), including harness engineering

  • Future projects and advanced electronics and software development

You will be responsible for ensuring our teams have the people, skills, processes, tools and engineering standards needed to deliver ambitious space programmes today, while building the capabilities we will need for the future.

This is not a role for someone looking to step away from engineering. We are looking for a leader who can engage credibly with highly technical teams, challenge constructively, develop strong technical leaders and help create an environment where exceptional engineering can happen.

Matrix Organisation

Our engineering teams work in a matrix organisation, combining strong functional leadership with project-based delivery.

As Head of Electronics & Software, you will lead the functional organisation, developing its people and capabilities while working closely with Project Managers, Project Chief Engineers, technical authorities and engineering Leads responsible for programme delivery.

You will:

  • Lead and develop Project Leads, discipline Leads, Principal Engineers and transversal engineering resources

  • Partner with project leadership to align capability, resources and priorities with programme needs

  • Help teams navigate competing priorities across projects

  • Ensure clear ownership and accountability between functional leadership and project execution

  • Build an organisation capable of supporting multiple programmes as the company grows

Success in this environment requires collaboration, influence and sound engineering judgement rather than centralising every technical decision.

Role Boundaries

This role owns the strength and effectiveness of the Electronics & Software organisation: its people, capability, engineering practices, tools, standards and functional budget.

You will create the environment in which our technical teams can perform at their best, providing mentoring, challenge and access to expertise while supporting technical and project leadership in making strong engineering decisions.

Project technical decisions and product technical authority remain within the relevant project and technical organisations. Your role is to ensure they are supported by a highly capable engineering organisation with the right expertise, methods and resources.

Key Responsibilities

People, Hiring & Organisation

You will build and shape a high-performing Electronics & Software organisation.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning workforce and headcount planning across the function

  • Recruiting and retaining exceptional engineering talent

  • Developing clear job families, role levels and assessment standards

  • Partnering with Talent Acquisition, engineering Leads and hiring managers to maintain a high technical hiring bar

  • Leading promotion, compensation and organisational planning within the function

  • Building succession plans and reducing key-person dependencies in specialist areas

  • Creating an organisation that remains lean, scalable and aligned with current and future programme needs

Line Management & Development

Developing strong engineers and technical leaders will be a major part of the role.

You will:

  • Lead and develop the managers, Leads and senior engineers within your organisation

  • Establish meaningful objectives aligned with project and company priorities

  • Build clear development and technical career paths

  • Strengthen mentoring, coaching and leadership capability across the organisation

  • Create opportunities for engineers to gain experience across design, integration, test and operations

  • Address performance challenges fairly and constructively

  • Build a culture where progression is based on demonstrated capability, impact and organisational need

Engineering Processes, Standards & Compliance

title: Head of Engineering - Optimisation & Control
descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in:
KrakenFlex is the flexibility arm of the Kraken group, built to put a big green dent in global carbon emissions by rewriting how electricity grids operate. We stabilize the grid and help renewables come online much faster by managing the second-by-second balance of clean power. Right now, our platform connects nearly one million assets worldwide, putting over 6GW of live load under our direct control.

Behind the scenes, that means handling massive technical scale: solving complex optimization problems in real time and processing 15 billion data readings a day from the latest green technologies, ensuring the grid stays reliable without relying on old fossil-fuel backup plants.

The next phase of our journey involves monumental growth. Currently operational across multiple countries, we are poised for further global expansion, scaling our asset base and tackling unique grid challenges in new territories. Our mission is to integrate an increasingly diverse array of green flexibility assets while ensuring our market-leading platform remains exceptionally stable and performant.

What is Optimisation in Flex?
The Optimisation chapter is the mathematical and algorithmic engine of the KrakenFlex platform. While other chapters manage physical asset connectivity or ingest market signals, this domain is responsible for the intelligence that decides exactly what every asset should do, second by second, to maximise both grid stability and financial returns.

The teams within this chapter build and maintain the real-time dispatch engines, predictive forecasting models, and algorithmic solvers that handle massive multi-asset portfolios. This involves translating complex market rules, physical asset constraints (like battery degradation curves, state-of-charge limits, and ramp rates), and fluctuating price signals into optimised execution strategies.

The defining challenge for this chapter is scaling computational performance alongside our rapid asset growth. Running complex, multi-variable mathematical models in tight real-time windows requires immense efficiency. The core tension lies in balancing the demand from data science and quantitative engineering to introduce increasingly sophisticated models with the strict platform requirement for absolute reliability, low latency, and cost-effective cloud compute.

Ultimately, this chapter must move away from bespoke optimisation routines tailored to individual markets or asset types. Your goal is to architect a highly performant, modular optimisation core that uses standard abstract layers, allowing us to roll out new algorithms or expand into new global territories without rewriting the underlying engine.

🚀 What you’ll own:
The Flex platform is built on autonomous Chapters, which are collections of specialists focused on delivering a core service or business outcome, defined by the unchanging nature of the energy business (independent of technology, hardware, or regional differences). A Head of Engineering leading a Chapter is a senior leadership role combining strong product thinking, engineering judgement, operational awareness, and people leadership. They manage managers and senior individual contributors, helping teams own their product surfaces, make sound trade-offs, and deliver reliably.

This role requires influencing beyond its formal remit, spotting cross-team patterns, clarifying ownership and decision-making, and driving initiatives to turn recurring issues into visible actions with owners, dates, and measures of success. Ultimately, they maintain the technical vision for their specific area, ensuring services are appropriately owned, maintained, and aligned with Flex's sustainable growth.

  • Managing the leads.

  • Maintaining the technical vision for a given area.

  • The overall team architecture

  • Ensuring the services in that area are owned and maintained appropriately.

  • Ensuring that product features are built in a way that scales, is cost-effective, and is in line with the vision for a product area.

  • Ensuring the appropriate level of quality and resilience, with a specific focus on reducing system incidents and improving stability.

  • Ensuring appropriate tech debt is prioritised to support sustainable delivery.

  • Potentially managing a squad (team) as well.

🧠 What you’ll bring to the party:
You’ll be a strong fit if you have experience leading engineering teams across multiple squads, teams or product areas in a complex product environment.

  • A collaborative product and engineering mindset: you care about customer outcomes, product strategy, technical quality and the people needed to make the work real.

  • Strong judgement in ambiguity: you can separate urgent from important, make trade-offs explicit and help teams move without pretending all uncertainty has disappeared.

  • A track record of influencing beyond your reporting line and team, building trust with senior stakeholders and helping teams reach decisions when ownership is shared.

  • A bias for action and improvement: when you see a recurring issue, you turn it into the smallest useful action that starts making the system better.

  • Reliability in driving initiatives: people can trust that when you take ownership, the work keeps moving, dependencies are managed and decisions are followed through.

descriptionHtml:

Yet an estimated 1.8 million people in the UK already use cannabis to manage a health condition, mostly outside the legal system. That is more than 10x today’s market, in a category that is still largely uncharted.

Most high-stakes moments in AI over the coming years will involve frontier company insiders having and raising concerns: within companies, to regulators, or through other pathways.

Those insiders tell us they face enormous uncertainty along the “concern raising” path -- from detecting concerns to whether and how to voice concerns with maximum impact and minimal risk, which even legally protected whistleblowing can carry. To date, no organization has dedicated itself deeply to delivering the best strategic, frontier-AI-specific guidance to these individuals, their supporters, and their attorneys (our partners). We exist to ensure that each insider disclosure is maximally impactful and safe for the person making the disclosure.

Tasks

About the role

The Head of Security is a dual inward- and outward-facing role. You will update, design and implement AIWI’s internal security posture, and provide external guidance to AI insiders, whistleblowers and partners. You will create and oversee internal security controls, manage an evolving risk appetite, and design internal policies and trainings so that staff stay safe and secure in their everyday workflows. You will also design and deliver training and guidance to would-be whistleblowers and AIWI’s partners.

In other words, you are as comfortable drafting an internal security policy or building an onboarding and device-provisioning plan as you are training whistleblowers on how to evade insider-threat-management (ITM) systems, or explaining natural language watermarking. You can design, implement, and enforce a coherent data governance policy, and you understand the intricacies of watermarking schemes and counter-forensic measures against them.

You will report to Karl Koch, our CEO, and work closely with our co-founder/technical advisor Max and the principal engineer we are hiring. You will manage potential contractors and propose spend, with CEO sign-off on budget. Our environment is highly sensitive: so confidentiality, careful judgement, and conviction in what we do are essential.

Areas of Ownership

1. Internal security and compliance.

  • Onboarding, access rights, information sharing

  • Working with trustworthy contractors

  • Tooling: audit of all tool configurations, and keeping critical software (e.g., our GlobaLeaks instance) up to date

  • Incident policy and response

  • Security input and strategy on new technology and developments

  • Full review of the current setup, identifying vulnerabilities to inform wider strategy and next steps

  • IT helpdesking (supporting Operations to field the right ones your way)

2. External: insiders and coalition members.

  • Guidance, video content, and op-eds

  • Assisting coalition members

  • Device provisioning

  • Being “ready” to urgently support security needs

  • Further services/offerings

3. Security engineering (full-time track only).

  • You will build and run the technical security layer behind AIWI’s internal and external systems, working alongside the Principal Engineer (e.g. Harden and monitor our self-hosted, set up; Build security tooling, automation, and detections in-house; Review architecture and code, and secure CI/CD and the software supply chain; Run offensive testing (pen tests, red teaming) on our own systems and tools, including our GlobaLeaks instance; Lead technical incident response and forensics; Take security engineering work off the Principal Engineer so they can focus on product delivery)

Requirements

Core (both profiles)

  • Experience working with and securing journalists, sources, whistleblowers, or others in high-risk sensitive environments.

  • Proven track record of delivering security trainings to diverse audiences in a variety of environments.

  • Demonstrated experience in source protection (how have you helped journalists or non-profits safeguard sources?).

  • Deep knowledge of secure platforms (e.g., able to explain the security differences between Signal and SimpleX, or between Qubes and Tails).

  • Proficiency in operational security, threat modeling, and risk management.

  • Familiarity with IDS, ITM, and DLP suites, and how to safeguard whistleblowers against these systems.

  • Experience drafting, enacting, and enforcing internal security controls and policies.

  • Knowledge of document, audio, and video watermarking systems, and counter-forensics.

  • Genuine, demonstrable commitment to AI safety and whistleblower protection.

  • 5-15 years experience, dependent on the projects you have worked on.

Additional for the full-time profile

  • Hands-on experience as a security engineer or builder, with a track record of shipping security tooling and infrastructure.

  • Strong coding skills in one or more of Python, Go, Rust, or C/C++, plus shell. You write security tooling, automation, and detections yourself, without relying on AI tools.

  • Offensive security experience (penetration testing, red teaming, exploit understanding). You can think and operate like an attacker.

  • Infrastructure security: Linux hardening, network segmentation, cloud and self-hosted setups, IaC (Ansible, OpenTofu, etc.).

  • Application security: secure code review, OWASP Top 10, supply-chain security, secrets management.

  • Detection and response: logging, SIEM/IDS, forensics, incident handling.

Benefits

Package for full-time

  • £120,000 base

  • Up to 9% on UEL pension contribution

  • 25 days of annual leave plus public bank holidays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Professional development budget

  • A home office or equipment stipend for hybrid staff

  • Wellness budget

  • Paid for co-working space in London/SF

  • Flexible scheduling; occasional out-of-hours work required

Why join?

  • Work as part of an ambitious team committed to a high leverage intervention: A single whistleblower disclosure can move the world if handled well. We get up every morning to make it go well.

  • Work on a vast breadth of technological challenges and varying project sizes.

  • Ownership and responsibility from day 1.

  • Chance to define your personal career development.

  • Coaching by an AIWI co-founder, now board member and serial entrepreneur/CTO as well as close collaboration with an extremely experienced Principal Engineer.

Who you’d be joining:

AIWI is an independent non-profit launched in late 2024. We are ~4 team members today and are scaling to ~15 within the year, spread across the Bay Area, DC, and London. Joining now, you will significantly shape what the future of AI insider support looks like. We are funded until 2029.

Examples of our work to date:

  • Policy: We pushed for and shaped the EU AI Office's channel, the world's first AI whistleblowing channel. In the US, we support the federal AI Whistleblower Protection Act and have provided expert research input on implementing SB 53's incident reporting mechanisms through a research coalition, which we helped set up. Read our work in Tech Policy Press, the Institute for Law & AI, and Transformer, and see our AI Whistleblowing Law Best Practice Guide.

  • Insider education & support: Our online campaigns have reached thousands of company employees. We produce guides (available upon request), online courses, and help establish connections to our great partner attorneys and support (e.g. on legal advice and defense funding).

  • Advocacy: Anthropic published its whistleblowing policy and OpenAI strengthened theirs following our Publish Your Policies Campaign.

Our ambition is to ensure that each insider disclosure is maximally impactful and safe for the person making the disclosure. Joining us means dedicating yourself to achieving that goal with us.

title: Human Data Collection Associate
descriptionHtml:
Type: Full-time ·

Location: London, UK · On-site

Compensation: £50,000–£65,000/year, in accordance with experience ·

The Role

We're building a foundation model of the brain and behaviour across species, and the data that powers it is produced in-house by a small, high-trust team. This role sits at the centre of that effort. As a Human Data Collection Associate, you run data collection sessions on assigned rigs, preparing and calibrating the setup, running the session, and making sure the data you hand off is clean and complete.

It is a hands-on role with real ownership. You'll report to the Human Data Collection Lead and work alongside the Hardware Systems team who build and maintain the rigs. You'll also take part in sessions as a contributor of your own data, so comfort being recorded during collection is part of the role.

Responsibilities

Running data collection

  • Prepare, calibrate, and run recording sessions from start to finish, following defined protocols precisely

  • Fit sensors, verify signal quality in real time, and resolve issues before they affect a session

  • Contribute your own data as a session participant where the protocol calls for it

Data quality and integrity

  • Own the quality bar for everything you collect. Review, label, and validate recordings so that only clean, well-documented data moves downstream

  • Keep accurate consent, provenance, and session-metadata records for every dataset, following the standards the Lead sets and our obligations under UK GDPR

  • Identify and document anomalies, and help refine protocols as we learn what works

Operations and equipment

  • Keep your recording setup maintained, charged, and ready, and track its condition over time

  • Support session scheduling and keep collection running smoothly day to day

  • Help onboard and coordinate short-term participants as we scale collection

Requirements

Core (essential)

  • Meticulous attention to detail and real care for data quality

  • Able to follow structured, repeatable protocols precisely and consistently

  • Confident with hands-on technical setups and quick to troubleshoot when something is not working

  • Reliable and organised, able to own a process from end to end with minimal oversight

  • Comfortable taking part in data collection sessions as a contributor, including being recorded

  • Strong interpersonal skills, with a knack for putting participants at ease

  • Right to work in the UK

Valued

  • Experience in a research, lab, clinical, or data collection setting

  • Familiarity with physiological or behavioural recording equipment

  • Exposure to biosignal or time-series data, and basic comfort with data tools such as spreadsheets or light scripting

  • Genuine interest in neuroscience, AI, or the science of human and animal behaviour

  • Experience maintaining quality standards and documentation in a high-rigour environment

title: Industrial Vision & Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

Within the Engineering Quality team, you will own industrial vision inspection across our production lines, from roadmap and qualification to integration on automated and manual stations. As production ramps up, you will turn today's manual controls into robust inline inspections, working hand in hand with the Industrialization & Automation, Quality and Production teams. With hardware already on site, this is a greenfield role: you will write the standard rather than inherit one, and see your programs running on a defense production line within weeks. This is a full time position based in Orly, with opportunities to grow within the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Build and own the industrial vision roadmap across our production lines, and defend the associated investments.

  • Audit existing cameras and programs, then establish a measured baseline of escape and false reject rates.

  • Develop and deploy vision programs on real parts, tuning optics, lighting, thresholds and Edge Learning tools.

  • Integrate vision on automated stations with the automation team, including triggering, PLC/IO handshake and robot guidance.

  • Deploy standalone camera programs on manual stations, along with the scripting and small tooling around them.

  • Define and run the qualification framework (IQ/OQ/PQ) and trace every inspection into the control plan.

  • Maintain a versioned and backed up program library, with clear documentation for every deployed inspection.

  • Review rejected images daily with production, separating real defects from false rejects and unblocking stations.

  • Partner with R&D on design for inspectability, and with Manufacturing Systems Engineering and IT on data and network handling.

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: Engineering degree or equivalent, with a strong academic record.

  • Vision Experience: 2+ years of practical industrial vision experience in a production environment, such as automotive, electronics, aerospace, medtech or a vision integrator.

  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with at least one industrial vision platform or library, scripting skills and enough automation exposure to work with a PLC or a robot.

  • Validation Rigor: Manages false rejects and escapes with data, knows that optics and lighting drive the result, and is curious about assembly (PCBA, solder joints, connectors).

  • Roadmap Ownership: Able to build a plan and a standard from scratch in a greenfield environment, and to defend an investment case.

  • Shop Floor Pragmatism: Designs for operators and shift reality, favors robust over elegant solutions, works autonomously and embraces a “no task is too small” mentality.

  • Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication in French and English, capable of working with diverse principals, from operators on the line to senior leadership.

  • Eligibility: Security clearance may be required for this role.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Interim Investment Banking Consultant
descriptionHtml:
About Aptura

Aptura is building the reinforcement learning data company that powers frontier model training globally. We combine deep expertise in finance with cutting-edge in-house tech to deliver tailored, domain-specific training data and feedback loops.

At work, we're building a high-performance, people-first culture. We move quickly, think ambitiously, and set a high bar for ourselves, all while staying open, collaborative, and genuinely enjoyable to work with. The best ideas here win regardless of who they come from, teams sit close to leadership, and every voice has a say in what comes next.

We believe real effort deserves real reward. This isn't a company you're joining — it's one you're helping to build. We went from 3 people to 15 in the past year alone and 15 to 45 in less than 30 months. We're still early and picking up the pace this year. In this role you will

Morgan, Bank of America, Citi, Barclays, UBS, Deutsche Bank, Wells Fargo, Evercore, Moelis, Centerview, Lazard, Jefferies)

How we support you

  • Tech, screens, and any equipment you need to perform at a high level

Logistics

  • Location: In-person at our office in Liverpool Street, London

title: Intern Product Design (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Job summary

You’ll work on early-stage ideas, turning concepts that don’t yet exist into reality through research and prototyping. You’ll help teams define the core problem and solution by understanding the human needs, business needs and market trends that drive them.

You’ll also build prototypes to visualize concepts, communicate possibilities and test them with users, so that the products we create deliver both business and user value.

Was wir bieten

Weitere Informationen finden Sie auch auf unserer Homepage.

sind:

  • sehr gute deutsche Sprachkenntnisse (B2 und höher)

Benefits

Ihre Einsätze erfolgen flexibel nach Ihrer Verfügbarkeit (freie Auswahl bezüglich Einsatzzeit und -ort aus einer Vergabeliste). Join us as a KYC/KYB Analyst to protect Qonto's regulated growth while keeping onboarding fast and fair for our clients. You'll review enhanced due diligence and KYBC cases, decide who can safely open or keep a Qonto account, and flag financial-crime risks the moment you spot them, working closely with our Lead EDD. 

➡️ What you'll do

  • Decide on high-risk files: Review EDD cases for onboarding and lifecycle reviews, then approve, reject, or send them back to L1 for missing or invalid documents.

  • Handle KYBC edge cases fast: Assess alternative documents and gray-activity requests, closing decisions within a 48-hour SLA when clients are blocked.

  • Focus where it matters: Automation handles the routine files, so you'll concentrate your judgment on the riskiest ones during your weekly control checks.

  • Cross-check the numbers: Compare declared turnover and financial documentation against real account activity to spot inconsistencies.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Fluent in French and English, including legal reading: You read bylaws, RCS extracts, and legal documentation as comfortably as any other business document, in French, and work just as easily in English.

  • Risk judgment under ambiguity: You reason through gray-area cases instead of defaulting to blanket rejection or blanket approval.

  • AFC/KYC/KYB fundamentals: You're curious about AFC/KYC/KYB topics and ready to learn on the job.

  • Attention to detail: You catch missing documents, invalid evidence, and inconsistencies that others might miss.

  • AI-native mindset: You're comfortable letting AI handle routine cases so you can focus on the ones that need real judgment.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Real autonomy, fast: Reach independent decision-making on routine files within a few months, with complex cases escalated together.

  • A growing scope: As Qonto's credit products expand, you'll take on larger companies and more complex corporate structures over time.

  • Structured onboarding: Shadow the team, get weekly 1:1s, and have every early decision reviewed before you go fully autonomous.

  • A seat at the intersection of compliance and fraud: Your work directly feeds AFCU's transaction-monitoring investigations, broadening your view beyond onboarding.

title: Lead Product Designer, Growth
descriptionHtml:

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re a team of 115+ designers, researchers, and brand experts led by Chief Design Officer Vuokko Aro. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Product Design makes up over half of our design disciplines, working in tight-knit squads alongside research, product, engineering and data to solve real customer problems at scale.

We design for the "magic moments"

We’ve built a bank that feels human, not just functional. Our product is our personality. We blend research, empathy, data and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.

Right now, we’re growing fast and looking for passionate designers to shape Monzo’s future — and there’s a huge opportunity to make your mark.

Our Growth collective is focused on helping more people discover Monzo, understand what makes us different, and find the products that can make money work better for them.

For this role, you’ll have a particular focus on our web experiences, helping us rethink how people discover, explore and choose Monzo before they ever open the app. You’ll combine strong visual and interaction design with a data-informed mindset, using experimentation and customer insight to understand what works and continuously improve the experience.

You don’t need to have worked in a dedicated Growth team before. We’re interested in designers who are curious about customer behaviour, comfortable using data to inform their decisions, and excited by the opportunity to apply exceptional craft to high-impact customer journeys.

  • Leading the design of high-quality web experiences that help new and existing customers discover the value Monzo can bring to their financial lives.

  • Tackling complex and ambiguous design challenges, balancing customer needs, business goals and technical constraints to create simple, effective experiences.
  • Defining compelling product visions and direction, helping teams think beyond individual experiments towards a coherent long-term customer experience.
  • Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data and Research throughout the design process, bringing people together around customer problems and opportunities.
  • Using AI to level-up parts of your design workflow. Whether that’s ideation, analysis, prototyping or shipping production code.
  • Taking a pragmatic approach to experimentation — moving quickly when we need to learn, while knowing when an experience needs a higher level of craft and polish.
  • Acting as a role model in Design, sharing your work broadly, mentoring others, and contributing to the growth and success of the wider Design team.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You have a proven track record of designing high-quality web experiences, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong visual and interaction design craft.
  • You’re comfortable using data to inform your design decisions, partnering with Data Scientists or Analysts to understand customer behaviour and measure the impact of your work.
  • You can connect great customer experiences with measurable outcomes and understand how design can contribute to wider product and commercial goals.
  • You’re comfortable forming hypotheses, experimenting with different approaches and adapting your thinking as you learn.
  • You can balance speed and experimentation with a high bar for craft, knowing when to prototype quickly and when to invest in creating an exceptional final experience.
  • You’re a natural collaborator who can bring together Product, Engineering, Data, Research and other partners around complex customer problems.
  • You thrive in ambiguity and can create clarity and direction when the answer isn’t immediately obvious.
  • You’re comfortable thinking beyond an individual screen or experiment, connecting work across journeys and helping shape a longer-term vision.
  • You’re a role model who actively contributes to the growth of the Design team through mentoring, feedback and sharing your expertise.
  • You’re excited about Monzo’s mission to make money work for everyone and the opportunity to help more people discover the value of Monzo.

🙌What’s in it for you

💰 £90,000 - £120,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance.
✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.
✅ We can sponsor your visa.

⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.
📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.
🏡We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.
➕ Plus lots more!

  • 30-minute call with our Recruiter, Tom
  • 1-hour craft interview where you’ll present a single case study to 2 members of our Design team

This process should take around 4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Our process is designed to move fast:

title: Logistics & Customs Coordinator
descriptionHtml:
Logistics & Customs Coordinator

This is a future role. We're building a shortlist now and will contact you when it opens.

About us

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.

Our station network is expanding across continents. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.

We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, and Innovate UK.

Position Overview

London · Full time · On-site

You'll get station hardware where it needs to be: from suppliers to London, then on to sites across four continents, on time and compliant.

What you'll do

  • Plan and book international freight for high-value, sensitive equipment

  • Manage customs documentation, commodity codes, duty and import VAT

  • Run temporary-import processes such as ATA Carnets

  • Work within our export compliance process on classifications and licences

  • Track inventory and assets across sites

  • Build relationships with freight forwarders, customs brokers and host sites

What you'll bring

  • Experience in international logistics or freight forwarding

  • Working knowledge of Incoterms, customs procedures and HS codes

  • Strong organisation, attention to detail and follow-through

  • Confidence with spreadsheets and logistics systems

Nice to have

  • Export controls or dual-use goods

  • Shipping scientific or industrial equipment

  • Spanish speaking and additional languages

What We Offer

  • A high-impact role with real ownership at an early-stage, venture-backed spacetech company

  • EMI share options (UK employees)

  • 25 Days Annual Leave + Bank Holidays

  • Enhanced Parental Leave

  • Cycle to work schemes

  • Work alongside engineers and scientists across optics, lasers, software and astrodynamics

  • Offices in central London, with snacks, tea, coffee and regular socials

We actively champion underrepresented groups and seek to bridge gaps in our workforce. If you're excited by the role but don't match every point, or you’re seeking a part time role, please apply anyway and add a note into your application. Building the best team is our priority.

title: Management Graduate Program Intake (French speaker) HRtechX
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking for challenges within an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? If so, now is the time to apply for our 4 months paid Internship Program in London.

About us

HRtechX is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conference products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc.

What we offer you

As part of our Internship Program in London, you will rocket launch your career in a high-paced environment with a continuously steep learning curve. In short, we offer the brightest talents:

  • An opportunity to fast-track your career through responsibility for high-impact projects that constantly push you out of your comfort zone
  • Hands-on experience building and scaling ventures together with the sharpest minds
  • An amazing network and the possibility of reporting directly to C-level staff and Managing Directors

title: Manager/Senior Manager, Medical Information, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need.

As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn.

Summary of Position:
The Senior Manager, Medical Information, EMEA will be responsible for developing, managing, and delivering high-quality, accurate, and compliant medical information content to support unsolicited requests from healthcare professionals. Based in Europe and operating within a global matrix, this individual will ensure timely and accurate responses are being provided to healthcare professionals in response to their inquiries. This role necessitates a comprehensive understanding of medical information with a strong emphasis on project management, medical writing, and strategic thinking.
Position Responsibilities
  • Create custom responses to address escalated requests from the European Medical Information Call Center in addition to supporting the development of responses at the global level.
  • Ensure call center agents are equipped with up-to-date scientific content and trained to respond accurately and professionally to HCP inquiries.
  • Monitor and analyze inquiry trends and insights to inform scientific communications and strategic planning.
  • Support the adaptation and localization of existing Global Medical Information content (e.g., standard response letters) for EMEA and country-specific needs, and partner with appropriate stakeholders to ensure alignment with applicable European regulations, industry codes, company policies, and medical review processes.
  • Partner with international partner markets to ensure consistent responses across different regions.
  • Other duties within broader Global Scientific Communications as periodically assigned.

    • Candidate Requirements
    • Advanced scientific or healthcare degree (e.g., Pharm.D., Ph.D., or equivalent) preferred; a relevant master's degree with substantial medical communications experience may be considered.
    • 3+ years of experience in medical information, medical communications or a related biopharmaceutical industry role; rare disease or neuromuscular experience is preferred.
    • Demonstrated experience developing medical content (e.g., custom responses, standard responses) for healthcare professional audiences and translating complex scientific information into clear, concise, and scientifically accurate communications.
    • Experience working across European markets, including content adaptation or localization and collaboration with regional and country medical teams.
    • Knowledge of relevant European pharmaceutical regulations, industry codes, compliance requirements, and medical review processes.
    • Strong project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
    Scholar Rock is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Manager, Strategic Planning
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The role

We’re expanding Finance Business Partnering to support new business units. In this role, you’ll own the finance partnership for an assigned business unit and work directly with its leadership.

This is not a budget-reporting role. You’ll help shape how your business grows, connecting revenue strategy, go-to-market choices, investment and cost management in one clear financial model. You’ll turn commercial and operating plans into practical forecasts, challenge assumptions with evidence, and give leaders the insight to make better decisions. You’ll work with significant autonomy in a changing environment, building the financial partnership and planning discipline each business unit needs to scale.

What you’ll do

  • Act as the lead Finance partner to your assigned business unit leader, building a trusted relationship and bringing a clear, independent financial perspective to strategic and operating decisions.

  • Own the unit’s integrated financial model and performance narrative, linking revenue drivers, costs, investment, headcount and profitability.

  • Partner on end-to-end revenue strategy and go-to-market planning. Translate commercial choices into targets, forecasts and scenarios, and assess the financial implications of different growth paths.

  • Lead annual planning, forecasting and budget reviews for your unit. Recut plans as the operating model develops, making assumptions, trade-offs and risks explicit.

  • Track performance against plan, explain the drivers behind results, identify emerging opportunities or gaps, and recommend actions rather than simply reporting variances.

  • Build a strong view of unit economics and the metrics that matter, identifying the measures that best reflect the unit’s growth, customer economics and investment model.

  • Evaluate investment and resource choices, including hiring, dedicated product and technology capacity, and other material operating costs. Help ensure costs and resources are transparently attributed to the business unit they support.

  • Work across Commercial, Product, Technology, Operations and central Finance to align plans, validate assumptions and resolve trade-offs.

  • Create concise, decision-ready analysis and performance updates for business-unit and Finance leadership, translating complex financial information into clear choices.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience in FP&A, strategic finance, commercial finance or a comparable business-partnering role.

  • You pair strong financial modelling skills with practical AI fluency, using AI tools to build and improve models and analytical workflows, and applying sound financial judgement to validate the outputs.

  • A track record of owning planning and forecasting and using financial models to influence commercial or operating decisions.

  • Strong commercial and analytical judgement, including the ability to connect revenue drivers, costs, investment and profitability.

  • Confidence partnering directly with senior leaders, constructively challenging assumptions and influencing decisions without relying on formal authority.

  • The ability to make complex financial information clear and actionable for non-finance audiences.

  • Comfort working with autonomy in an ambiguous, fast-changing environment, while maintaining accuracy and follow-through.

  • Experience in fintech or another high-growth business is an advantage.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Manager Umwelt- & Arbeitsschutz / Genehmigungsmanagement (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Die Daikin Refrigerants Frankfurt GmbH mit Sitz in Frankfurt am Main ist eine 100 %ige Tochter der Daikin Chemical Europe GmbH und damit der Daikin Industries Ltd., mit Sitz in Osaka Japan, zugehörig. Die Daikin Gruppe mit weltweit über 100.000 Mitarbeitern ist ein führender Hersteller von Klima- und Kühlgeräten sowie von fluorhaltigen Chemikalien. Neben einer Anlage zur Feindestillation des Pharma-Treibmittels S227 Pharma, welches weltweit in Dosier-Aerosolen für die Verabreichung medizinischer Wirkstoffe (e.g. Sprays gegen Asthma und COPD) eingesetzt wird, betreibt Daikin seit 2020 auch eine Aufbereitungsanlage zur Reinigung rückgewonnener fluorierter technischer Gase (HFKW), so dass diese anschließend erneut zum Einsatz in Klima- und Kühlgeräten eingesetzt werden können. Zudem verfügt der Standort über eine thermische Spaltanlage zur schadlosen Entsorgung von FCKW, HFKW und FKW. Mittels Wasserstoff-Sauerstoffflamme werden die Gase in Spaltreaktoren zu Fluss- und Salzsäure umgewandelt und als Rohstoffe wieder in den Wertstoffkreislauf zurückgeführt.

Aufgaben

  • Führung & Teamentwicklung: Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung der EHS-Abteilung inkl. Ressourcensteuerung, Zielförderung und Weiterentwicklung Ihres Teams
  • Behördenmanagement & Genehmigungsverfahren: Zentrale Ansprechperson für Behörden und den Industrieparkbetreiber; Steuerung aller immissionsschutz- und umweltrechtlichen Genehmigungsverfahren inklusive Erstellung, Prüfung und fristgerechter Einreichung von Genehmigungsanträgen (insb. BImSchG)
  • Strategisches EHS-Management: Implementierung, Aufrechterhaltung und stetige Weiterentwicklung der EHS-Prozesse sowie der integrierten Managementsysteme nach ISO 45001, ISO 14001 und ISO 50001
  • Wahrnehmung gesetzlicher Beauftragtenfunktionen: Funktion als Immissionsschutz- und Störfallbeauftragter sowie Managementbeauftragter für Umwelt, Arbeitssicherheit und Gesundheitsschutz
  • Anlagen- & Rechtskonformität: Überwachung genehmigungspflichtiger Anlagen nach StörfallV und BImSchG sowie Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller gesetzlichen Vorschriften, Normen und Konzernrichtlinien
  • Gefahrenabwehr & Risikoanalysen: Durchführung von Gefährdungsbeurteilungen und HAZOP-Analysen, Untersuchung von Unfällen/Störungen sowie Entwicklung wirksamer Präventivmaßnahmen
  • Gefahrstoff- & Umweltmanagement: Steuerung des Gefahrstoffeinsatzes (Messungen, Gefahrstoff- & Lärmkataster) und Entwicklung zukunftsfähiger Umweltstrategien zur Reduzierung des ökologischen Fußabdrucks.
  • Audits & Behördenkontakt: Aktive Begleitung und Durchführung interner sowie externer Audits; zentraler Ansprechpartner für Behörden, den Industrieparkbetreiber und die Werkleitung
  • Sicherheitskultur & Schulung: Organisation von Sicherheitsunterweisungen, ASA-Sitzungen und Erstellung moderner Schulungsmaterialien zur kontinuierlichen Stärkung der Sicherheitskultur (inkl. Betreuung der internen Schulungsdatenbank)
  • Konzernnetzwerk: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit EHS-Bereichen auf europäischer und globaler Ebene.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in naturwissenschaftlicher / technischer Richtung mit mehrjähriger jähriger Berufserfahrung im industriellen oder chemischen Bereich

  • Erfahrungen im Gesundheits-, Arbeits- und Umweltschutz eines produzierenden Unternehmens

  • Erfahrungen im Behördenmanagement & Genehmigungsverfahren erforderlich

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in vergleichbarer Position mit Führungsverantwortung

  • Kenntnisse über die Rechtsvorschriften zum Gesundheits-, Arbeits- und Umweltschutz, insbesondere BImSchG

  • Von Vorteil abgeschlossener Lehrgänge / Ausbildung

  • zum Störfall- und Immissionsschutzbeauftragten

  • zum Managementbeauftragten für Umwelt- und Energiemanagement

  • zur Sicherheitsfachkraft in der Branche chemische Industrie

  • Reisebereitschaft

  • sehr gute Kenntnisse von MS-Office, insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel

  • sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

  • Gehalt gemäß außertariflicher Vergütung
  • wöchentliche Arbeitszeit von 37,5 h und ab 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Arbeitszeitkonto, arbeitgeberfinanzierte Gruppenunfall- und Pflegeversicherung sowie betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Zuschuss zur Kantine, zum EGYM Wellpass, und zum Deutschland Ticket
  • Parkplatz am Industriepark, umfassende Rabattplattformen & kontinuierliche Weiterbildungen
  • Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement
  • Kostenlose Getränke (Wasser, Kaffee, Tee) sowie kostenloses Obst im Betrieb

title: Marketing & Communication - Internship (6 months)
descriptionHtml:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

As a Marketing & Communications Intern, you will support the development and execution of Alta Ares' marketing and communications activities.

Working closely with the Sales, Engineering and leadership teams, you will help strengthen our brand presence, create engaging content, support our participation in major defense events, and communicate our technology, products and company milestones to relevant audiences.

Your Responsibilities

Content & Social Media

  • Support the creation and publication of content across LinkedIn and other relevant communication channels.

  • Draft and coordinate social media posts, company news, product updates and team highlights.

  • Help produce articles, presentations, brochures, case studies and other marketing materials.

  • Support the creation of visual content, including graphics, photos and videos.

  • Maintain an editorial calendar and ensure consistent brand messaging.

  • Coordinate with Engineering and Product teams to translate technical topics into clear and engaging content.

Brand & Corporate Communications

  • Help maintain Alta Ares' brand identity, tone of voice and visual consistency.

  • Support the preparation of corporate presentations, company profiles and communication materials.

  • Contribute to internal and external communications around company milestones, product developments and key announcements.

  • Support the preparation of leadership communications, interviews and LinkedIn content.

  • Monitor relevant industry news, competitors and trends across defence, AI and deeptech.

Events & Exhibitions

  • Support the preparation and coordination of Alta Ares' participation in defense exhibitions and industry events.

  • Help prepare event materials, presentations, brochures and booth content.

  • Coordinate logistics and communication with event organisers, suppliers and internal stakeholders.

  • Support on-site activities and capture content during exhibitions, demonstrations and company events.

  • Assist with post-event communications, recaps and follow-up materials.

Marketing & Sales Support

  • Support the creation and update of sales enablement materials, including product sheets, presentations and company credentials.

  • Help prepare targeted communication campaigns for relevant defense and institutional audiences.

  • Assist with newsletters, email campaigns and other marketing initiatives.

  • Support the organisation and management of marketing materials and contact databases.

  • Track basic marketing performance indicators, including social media engagement, content reach and event visibility.

Candidate Profile

  • Currently pursuing or recently graduated from a degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Journalism or a related field.

  • First experience in marketing, communications, content creation or event coordination is a plus.

  • Strong interest in technology, AI, defense, aerospace, or deeptech.

  • Previous experience in a startup or fast-paced environment is an advantage.

Skills & Qualities

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in French & English.

  • Strong writing and storytelling abilities, with an eye for detail.

  • Comfortable creating content for LinkedIn and other digital channels.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, PowerPoint and social media management platforms is a plus.

  • Basic understanding of digital marketing and social media analytics.

  • Organised, proactive and able to manage multiple priorities.

  • Creative, curious and eager to learn.

  • Comfortable working with technical teams and translating complex subjects into accessible content.

  • High discretion and awareness of the sensitivity of the defense sector.

title: Marketing General Application
descriptionHtml:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

Why this job posting

We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent.

The best hires rarely arrive the moment a perfectly matching job posting happens to be live. So we're not waiting. You might not fit one of our current open roles, and that's fine. If you're genuinely great at what you do, we want you, and we'll find work for you!

Tell us what you're brilliant at and where you'd have the most impact, and we'll figure out the right seat together.

What it's like to work here

A few things that are true about working here:

We move fast. Really fast. Hours and days, not weeks or months.

We keep it light. Few meetings, little bureaucracy, less talking and more doing. And we default to doing it ourselves before adding dependencies, because pulling other people in slows everything down for everyone.

We hold a high bar. Average loses. Even good often does. We're here to do the best work of our careers, and we back each other to get there, low ego, high trust.

It's not an easy game. We're in AI, the most competitive space in the world, and nobody is going to give us this market. We have to take it.

But the impact is real. You'll see your work land. If you want to build things you're proud of, this is the place.

Where you might fit

We hire top talent across the whole function. A few of the areas where you might fit:

  • Performance. Own paid end to end and turn spend into pipeline and revenue.

  • Growth. Own the experiments and loops that compound over time.

  • Field. Own the events and 1:1 and 1:few plays that accelerate deals by region.

  • SEO. Win traditional and AI search. Ship the best content and world-class landing pages.

  • Brand and Creative. Make Synthesia impossible to ignore.

  • Copywriting. Write copy that lands. Make every word earn its place.

  • Organic Social. Build organic presence across platforms. Go viral with content people love.

  • Product and Customer Marketing. Position it. Launch it. Tell the story.

  • Lifecycle. Turn new signups into engaged customers who stick and grow.

  • Analytics and Measurement. Turn data into the team's sharpest decisions.

Not seeing your exact discipline? Apply anyway and tell us where you'd have the most impact.

About you

  • You get results. Pipeline, adoption, revenue. You can point to the numbers.

  • You live in the data. You reach for the numbers and tell signal from noise.

  • You can write. Sharp positioning and copy, with a point of view you'll defend.

  • You own it. Blank slate, your call. You move and adjust based on what works.

  • You run solo. You get things done without pulling in a crowd.

  • You adapt fast. Priorities shift, channels change, AI rewrites the playbook. You keep up.

  • You love AI. You want to build a category-defining product at one of the fastest-growing AI companies in the world.

Apply

Apply here. In a line or two, tell us where you fit and what you'd want to own. We review on a rolling basis, and when there's a match with a current or upcoming role, we'll reach out. What you share stays with us for future openings too.

Want to skip the queue? Message Borys Khodan, VP of Marketing, on LinkedIn and make your case:

title: Marketplace Analytics Manager
descriptionHtml:
Powering Great Work

We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists:

🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business

🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time

🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country

As our next Marketplace Analytics Manager you'll sit at the heart of how Checkatrade connects homeowners with tradespeople. You'll decide, with the matching team, which trades appear for which jobs, and you'll keep the marketplace in balance: the right trades in the right places, great matches for homeowners, and real returns for the trades who join us. You'll be data-first, commercially sharp, and trusted by senior leaders to tell them which lever to pull and why.

The job, unfiltered

  • Own marketplace health: define what healthy looks like for homeowners and trades, forecast supply and demand by region, category and season, and set clear priorities for the teams that grow our network.

  • Own metric integrity and diagnose what’s driving marketplace performance: define what our numbers mean, find the cause, size the impact, lay out the trade-offs, and track whether the change worked.

  • Decide when to send a lead, to whom and how, so trades see real value and stay engaged.

  • Understand how trades respond to lead delivery, and use simulation to choose which lever to pull and by how much.

  • Own the matching roadmap with Product and Applied Science, prioritised by commercial impact and value to our trades.

The fit

  • 5+ years in marketplace, growth or commercial analytics, with a track record of finding the cause and driving the change that moved the outcome.

  • Super strong with data: fluent in SQL, with a solid grounding in experiments.

  • Commercial instinct: you can weigh both sides of a marketplace and size the revenue and retention impact of a decision.

  • Experience forecasting supply and demand and defining marketplace health measures, ideally with price sensitivity or elasticity.

  • Thrives with ownership: you can influence Product, Sales, trade acquisition, CRM and senior leaders, and explain complex findings in a way that moves a decision.

  • Experience in a marketplace, subscription or lead-generation business is a bonus, as are Python, simulation, and tools like Tableau or Looker.

(Don't self-select out because you don't tick every box. We'd rather meet you.)

What You Get

About us

We’re Checkatrade – the UK’s leading platform for finding a tradesperson. With more than 50,000 trades listed and over 6 million reviews, we help homeowners get jobs done right and help tradespeople grow their business.

We’re growing fast, with big plans to become the go-to brand for home improvements. If you care about great work, take pride in the details, and want to make an impact, you’ll fit right in.

title: Member of Technical Staff – Isolation, Provisioning, Uptime, Monitoring
descriptionHtml:
Your team

You will work with the engineers who turn Lyceum’s GPU hardware into a platform customers can rely on. The team’s aim is a platform that operates without manual intervention: machines are provisioned, isolated and recovered automatically, and changes reach production without customers noticing.


Your mission

You will own the layer that turns physical GPU servers into products customers can use: machines provisioned with the right stack, cleanly isolated between tenants, and kept running. Everything Lyceum sells, from GPU rental to VMs and inference, depends on this layer working.

Your focus

Provisioning: Extend the orchestration layer that spins up and purposes GPU machines across GPU types, products and data centres, with the correct firmware, drivers, subnet manager version and OS image. Cut provisioning and cold-start times.

Isolation: Design and enforce tenant separation at network, storage and compute level, including clean wipe and re-provisioning between customers.

Uptime: Build health checks, automatic failure detection and remediation, so a failing node is caught and replaced before a customer notices. Take part in incident response.

Monitoring: Provide node- and fleet-level health and GPU telemetry, and make it available to the teams and customers who depend on it.

Your KPIs

  • Time from customer request to a usable machine

  • Fleet availability and SLA adherence

  • Share of GPUs in a sellable state

  • Time to detect and time to recover from node failures

  • Tenant isolation incidents (target: zero)

Your profile

We consider candidates from diverse backgrounds, with a deep love for technical challenges and the desire to take on ownership beyond what's reasonably expected.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in infrastructure, systems or platform engineering

  • Strong proficiency in Go and Python

  • Deep Linux knowledge and experience with bare-metal provisioning and configuration management

  • Solid networking fundamentals (VLANs, routing, firewalls)

  • Experience operating production infrastructure and troubleshooting it under pressure

Nice to have

  • Experience running multi-tenant GPU infrastructure

  • Knowledge of InfiniBand partitioning and high-performance storage

  • Experience with Kubernetes in a production environment

  • Comfortable working on-call or in incident response when things break

Why us?

  • Outstanding team: Work with some of the best engineers in the world, coming from hedge funds, big tech, AI startups and top universities

  • Once in a lifetime opportunity: Early-stage company in the fastest-growing market in the world

  • Ownership: Shape how European AI companies access GPU compute

  • European mission: Build sovereign, GDPR-compliant AI infrastructure for the next generation of deep-tech

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Kpler, you will play a key role in developing and deploying predictive models that power our global commodity, energy, and maritime intelligence platforms. Working closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Product teams, you will bridge the gap between machine learning experimentation and production-grade software delivery. Your work will directly transform complex data flows into real-time, actionable insights that help world-leading trading firms, industrial leaders, and analysts make critical decisions.

  • Architect and deploy ML pipelines: Design, build, and maintain production-grade machine learning workflows and microservices for power market forecasting and electricity grid modeling.

  • Bridge research and engineering: Transition statistical and machine learning prototypes from initial experimentation into scalable, production-ready Python applications.

  • Manage time-series and event data systems: Design and optimize database schemas in PostgreSQL to handle high-throughput time-series data, event streams, and normalization routines.

  • Implement robust MLOps practices: Establish automated model training, backtesting, evaluation, tuning, and feature/model versioning standards across deployments.

  • Drive data engineering quality: Construct clean ingestion and transformation pipelines, ensuring high integrity, validation, and low-latency access across analytical models.

  • Domain knowledge: Deep understanding of electricity-grid fundamentals, including generation, transmission, and electricity markets.

  • Data engineering & databases: Experience in data engineering, including working with PostgreSQL or similar databases, database design, data normalisation, and managing time-series and event data.

  • DS & ML research rigor: Proven experience in data science and machine learning research, encompassing statistics, hypothesis testing, model training, evaluation, backtesting, tuning, and model selection.

  • MLOps & versioning: Practical experience in machine learning engineering, specifically including model and feature versioning.

Since 2012, Mirakl has been pioneering the platform economy, empowering retail and B2B enterprises with the most advanced, secure, and scalable technology to digitize and expand product assortment through marketplace and dropship, improve efficiency in supplier catalog management and payments, personalize shopping experiences, and boost profits through retail media.   In July 2025, Mirakl launched Mirakl Nexus, the first neutral infrastructure designed for agentic commerce. Built on Mirakl's 13 years of expertise and innovation, and powered by an ecosystem of more than 100,000 sellers, Mirakl Nexus connects merchants and AI agents to automate product discovery, payments, and after-sales service.   For more information: www.mirakl.com.   This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.  

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Data Experience squad led by Alexandre Blanchard, Data Engineering Manager within Mirakl's broader Data team of 70 specialists. Together, you'll be building and scaling the ML infrastructure that powers Mirakl's AI-driven products from real-time recommendation inference to LLM fine-tuning pipelines serving some of the world's most innovative e-commerce players.  

2. Your Impact

  • Design and implement a performant, robust, and scalable ML Platform architecture — covering training, evaluation, and inference — while keeping costs under control
  • Maintain and improve ML production pipelines and real-time inference applications at scale (real-time recommendation inference, 1M+ LLM calls/week, async content moderation)
  • Partner with Data Scientists from project kickoff through productionization — setting up best practices, guardrails, and CI/CD improvements in collaboration with the SRE team
  • Drive technical excellence: manage technical debt, systematize version upgrade processes, and upskill team members on MLOps and Data Engineering topics
  • Contribute to cutting-edge AI projects — including LoRA adapter creation for open-source LLM fine-tuning, in-house computer vision models, and large-scale product data transformation — and share findings across Labs teams

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • 2+ years of experience in a Machine Learning and/or Data engineering environment
  • Proven track record of shipping ML applications at scale (NLP, image processing, or classical ML) in high-volume, production-grade systems
  • Background in software development with a strong appetite for data science and machine learning
Skills:
  • Proficiency in Python and the Kubernetes/Docker ecosystem
  • Solid experience with cloud environments (AWS primarily) and Apache ecosystem frameworks
  • Hands-on knowledge of an orchestration tool (Airflow, Prefect, or equivalent)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices and MLOps principles (monitoring, model lifecycle, reproducibility)
  • Strong communicator with a knack for mentoring and presenting technical work to diverse audiences
 

4. Tech Stack

Experience with: Python, Databricks, AWS, Kafka, Airflow, Prefect, MLflow, TensorFlow, Triton, PyTorch, vLLM, KServe, Delta Lake, Kubernetes, SQL, Terraform, Apache Spark  

5. Languages

  • French: Fluent (C2 level required)
  • English: Fluent (B2/C1 level required) 
 

6. Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match. Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.
  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1 hour technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 1 hour discussion with your futur manager 
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.
Want to learn more about how we build our AI infrastructure? Read our latest article: Open source at the core, proprietary where it counts: Mirakl's AI inference platform — by Jeanine Harb, Antoine Bourgault and Maxime Roodnejad, Senior Data Engineers at Mirakl.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French.
