title: Post-doctorant(e) en IA agentique correcte par construction (SoS)  - CDD de 12 mois
descriptionHtml:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en IA agentique correcte par construction (SoS) pour rejoindre le département INFRES de Télécom Paris.

Contexte scientifique :

les cadres de vérification existants supposent généralement des modèles finis et précisément définis, dont les actions et les relations de transition sont connues. Ces hypothèses sont difficiles à maintenir dans les systèmes modernes d’IA agentique, où les actions peuvent être générées dynamiquement, les environnements peuvent évoluer et les informations sur le système peuvent être incomplètes.

Le projet Sound or Silent (SoS) vise à combler cette lacune en étudiant une nouvelle approche d’IA agentique correcte par construction. L’idée centrale consiste à intégrer le raisonnement stratégique et la vérification formelle directement au processus décisionnel des agents autonomes. Au lieu de vérifier un agent uniquement après son développement ou de surveiller son comportement après l’exécution, SoS étudie la possibilité de produire des actions formellement certifiées conformes à une spécification donnée. Selon cette approche, une action candidate n’est exécutée que s’il est établi qu’elle appartient à une stratégie garantissant les propriétés requises. Si une telle garantie ne peut être établie, l’agent s’abstient d’agir.

Atteindre cet objectif exige d’étendre les techniques de vérification stratégique à des environnements ouverts, évolutifs et partiellement spécifiés, et d’étudier des notions de correction adaptées à une information incomplète. Le projet explorera également une architecture associant un composant génératif non fiable, chargé de proposer des actions ou des stratégies candidates, à un noyau de vérification formelle de confiance, chargé d’en contrôler la correction. Une attention particulière sera portée à l’expressivité des modèles formels sous-jacents, au coût de calcul de la certification et au compromis entre garanties formelles et capacité des agents à accomplir des tâches utiles.

Les travaux associeront des développements théoriques à la réalisation et à l’évaluation expérimentale de prototypes, dans des scénarios de planification autonome, d’agents d’IA utilisant des outils et de coordination multi-agents. L’objectif général est de poser les fondements de systèmes d’IA agentique dont l’autonomie est encadrée par des garanties stratégiques formellement vérifiables.

Vos missions principales seront de :

  • Mener des travaux de recherche sur l’IA agentique correcte par construction

  • Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat

  • Contribuer au rayonnement scientifique de Télécom Paris


Vous devrez être titulaire d’un doctorat ou d’un diplôme équivalent et disposer de solides connaissances en méthodes formelles, logique et vérification de modèles. Une expérience dans les systèmes multi-agents, les logiques stratégiques, la vérification à l’exécution ainsi que dans le développement d’agents fondés sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM) sera également attendue.

Vous devrez maîtriser le développement logiciel et l’implémentation d’algorithmes, ainsi que la démarche de recherche scientifique, notamment la formulation de problématiques, la conception d’expériences et l’analyse de leurs résultats. Une excellente maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, sera indispensable.

Enfin, vous devrez faire preuve d’un bon esprit d’équipe, de qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques, de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles ainsi que d’un esprit de synthèse.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers).

Vous bénéficierez de :

  • 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT)

  • flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service)

  • télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible

  • Remboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75%

  • Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne...

  • A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé

Informations diverses :


Date limite de candidature : 15 janvier 2027

Type d'emploi : CDD de 12 mois

Rémunération : 36 000 euros brut/an

Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, d'identité de genre et d’orientation sexuel et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Möchtest du in deinem Praktikum mehr bewegen als nur Kaffee zu kochen oder Akten zu sortieren? Bist du leidenschaftlich an Umweltschutz und Nachhaltigkeit interessiert und möchtest aktiv zum Schutz unseres Planeten beitragen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Mit einem Praktikum bei Project Wings kannst du Teil eines motivierten Teams sein, in dem du deine Ideen und Fähigkeiten umfassend einbringen kannst. Bei uns findest du ein freundliches und respektvolles Arbeitsumfeld, mit flachen Hierarchien sowie offener Kommunikation. Mit deiner Arbeit erhältst du die Möglichkeit, hinter die Kulissen einer modernen NGO zu blicken, einen echten Einfluss auf unsere Projekte zu haben und deine persönlichen Stärken und Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln. Wir suchen Praktikant:innen, die teamfähig und neugierig sind und Interesse daran haben, verschiedene Projekte und Arbeitsbereiche im Bereich Nachhaltigkeit kennenzulernen.

Deine Aufgaben bei uns sind vielfältig:

  • Mediengestaltung: Videos, Reels, Infografiken, Animationen, Präsentationen

  • Design: Grafiken, Layouts, Templates für Social Media, Website & Print

  • Marketing: Social Media Kampagnen, Community-Management, Influencer- & Kooperationskampagnen, Website-Pflege, Presse- & Öffentlichkeitsarbeit, Events

  • Vertrieb: Recherche und Kontaktaufnahme zu Partner:innen & Förder:innen und Mitarbeit an Konzepten (z. B. Wings Coin, Wings Dining), Antragstellung für Förderungen

  • Webseite: Pflege, Verbesserung, Änderung und Umgestaltung

good to know: Da wir ein kleines Team sind, packt jede*r überall an, wo Hilfe gebraucht wird. So bekommst du rundum einen Einblick in die Arbeit einer NGO. Wir bieten dir die Chance für ein abwechslungsreiches Praktikum, in dem du alle Bereiche kennenlernst und mitwirken kannst. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt jedoch in dem Bereich, der dich am meisten interessiert – sei es Design, Vertrieb, Mediengestaltung oder Marketing. Andere Aufgabenbereiche sind beispielsweise:

  • Bildungsarbeit

  • Backoffice

  • Spendenmanagement

Was Du mitbringst:

  • Kreativität und Interesse an Design und Content Creation

  • Bereitschaft, sich in verschiedene Themen in kurzer Zeit einzuarbeiten

  • Empathie, Teamfähigkeit, Sensibilität und offene Kommunikation

  • Eigeninitiative in der Gestaltung, Weiterentwicklung und Neuentwicklung von Konzepten im Marketingbereich

  • sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse

  • Engagement und Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit und Umweltschutz

Nice to have:

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Canva

  • Erste Erfahrung in Social Media Marketing und Content Creation

  • Kenntnisse in Video-Schnitt und Bildbearbeitung

  • Grundkenntnisse im Projektmanagement oder Vertrieb

  • Studium/ Ausbildung in Marketing, Kommunikation-/ Mediendesign, Medien, BWL

  • Führerschein

Wenn Dein Bereich in der Aufzählung fehlt – kein Problem! Ob du gerade ein Gap Year machst, frisch von der Schule kommst, dich im Studium oder einer Ausbildung befindest, bereits Berufserfahrung gesammelt hast oder aus einem ganz anderen Fachbereich kommst – bei uns zählt vor allem deine Motivation. Unabhängig von Vorwissen oder Studienrichtung: Wer Lust hat, sich mit Ideen und Engagement für die Umwelt einzusetzen, ist bei uns genau richtig. Wir bieten Dir eine offene Arbeitsatmosphäre, in der du dich einbringen und gemeinsam mit uns etwas bewegen kannst.

Was wir dir bieten:

  • flexibler Arbeitsplan (teile Deine Stunden selbst ein - von Montag bis Sonntag frei wählbar)

  • motiviertes und engagiertes Team, das dir stets mit Rat und Tat zur Seite steht

  • Verantwortung für Deinen eigenen Bereich

  • Zusammenarbeit mit bis zu vier weiteren Praktikant:innen, von deren Erfahrungen du profitierst

  • ein sehr vielseitiges Praktikum, da du die Möglichkeit hast, in alle Bereiche rein zu schauen

  • Snacks für zwischendurch und - wer möchte - verschiedene gemeinsame Aktivitäten (wie Yoga oder Spieleabende)

Start jederzeit möglich, Mindestdauer 2 Monate bis 1 Jahr

title: Principal Counsel, Africa Legal
descriptionHtml:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world's largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world's largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world's largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we've built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people's lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You and The Role

Zipline is seeking a senior, strategic, and highly adaptable lawyer to lead and scale legal and compliance across multiple countries of operation in Africa. This role sits at the intersection of compliance execution and regulatory strategy and is critical to enabling Zipline's continued growth in complex and evolving regulatory environments.

You will independently lead all Africa Legal & Compliance operations and strategy while serving as an integral member of Zipline International's high-impact Legal Team. You will also be a key member of the Zipline Africa Leadership Team, with the Heads of People and Finance and our Country Directors, and with a dotted reporting line to Zipline Africa's CEO. You will work cross-functionally with the Africa Leadership Team, Operations, Policy, Government Affairs, People, Finance, and Engineering, and will report directly to Zipline's Deputy General Counsel.

This is a hands-on leadership role that offers the rare opportunity to build and shape the Legal function with significant autonomy, while benefiting from the collaboration and support of a larger global legal team. One day you may be advising on a complex Nigerian employment or a healthcare regulatory issue in Cote d'Ivoire; the next, developing compliance training for teams across Africa or helping the business navigate export controls, sanctions, anti-corruption, and other cross-border legal risks.

What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, scale, and continuously improve Zipline's legal and compliance programs across Africa, with a focus on sustainable, practical operations that support rapid growth
  • Lead day-to-day compliance workstreams covering sanctions, anti-bribery and anti-corruption, privacy, healthcare, employment, and product-related regulations
  • Support internal investigations, audits, and risk assessments, partnering closely with People, Finance, and senior leadership
  • Manage litigation and disputes across Zipline's African markets
  • Translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, actionable guidance for business and technical teams
  • Own compliance with U.S. government award requirements, including FARs and 2 CFR 200, and serve as a primary point of contact for U.S. government contracting officers (including at the U.S. Department of State)
  • Monitor and assess regulatory and policy developments across relevant African jurisdictions and advise leadership on emerging risks and opportunities

Cross-Functional Partnership & Culture

  • Act as a senior legal advisor to business leaders, providing pragmatic, risk-calibrated guidance
  • Build strong relationships across the company and help foster a durable "culture of compliance" where teams understand the rules of the road and feel empowered to raise issues early
  • Help shape Zipline's long-term legal and regulatory strategy in Africa, balancing compliance rigor with innovation and speed

What You'll Bring

  • A willingness to dive deep into unfamiliar issues and operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-environments
  • Strong judgment and the confidence to make independent decisions, coupled with the discernment to escalate when appropriate
  • Experience advising on legal and compliance matters, preferably in international or emerging-market environments
  • The ability to break down complex legal and regulatory problems into clear priorities and practical solutions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to advise senior stakeholders
  • A collaborative, solutions-oriented mindset and strong organizational skills
  • Willingness to travel up to ~25% to Africa and San Francisco headquarters

What Else You Need To Know

Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities.

We value diversity at Zipline and welcome applications from those who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this position but are not sure if you are the perfect fit, please apply!

Voluntary Self-Identification

For government reporting purposes, we ask candidates to respond to the below self-identification survey. Completion of the form is entirely voluntary. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file.

As set forth in Zipline 's Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

title: Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT
descriptionHtml:
The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT owns the DeepHealth Acute Care CT Suite end to end, with primary accountability for what to build and shared accountability for getting it shipped. DeepHealth is building the Acute Care CT Suite from the ground up to cover detection, care coordination, and reporting for emergency CT, starting with head CT and expanding to chest and abdomen, where minutes saved in stroke, bleeds, and trauma directly affect patient outcomes. The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT shapes the suite from day one: owning the roadmap, translating clinical needs into ML and product work, and driving cross-functional delivery on a subset of the suite from data through customer activation. The role does not write code or own technical software design.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Product Strategy and Roadmap

  • Own the Acute Care CT Suite roadmap and define what to build, defer, or stop based on evidence.

  • Define suite scope across pathology detection modules, software capabilities such as alerting and care coordination, and comprehensive draft reporting.

  • Work with emergency radiologists and neuro/stroke teams to distinguish stated requests from real clinical needs, including time-to-treatment, triage, missed findings, and care coordination.

  • Translate clinical problems into ML work and set model metrics that reflect clinical value, including sensitivity versus false-positive burden.

  • Track the acute care market (including Aidoc, Viz.ai, RapidAI, Nicolab, and peers) and position products with Sales and Marketing.

  • Delivery and Cross-Functional Execution

  • Own delivery end to end on a subset of the Suite, from data to customer activation, including planning, coordination across data, ML, software, QARA, and Support, tracking, and escalation.

  • Run squads for new devices (typically 3 to 9 months), such as ASPECTS detection.

  • Coordinate with QARA on the regulatory impact of each release, including EU MDR and FDA 510(k).

  • Cut scope or move dates when needed, and escalate further as required.

  • Partner with engineering and technical leads without writing code or carrying technical software design.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.


Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical, scientific, clinical, business, or related field, or equivalent experience (required).

  • 8+ years in product or delivery for medical devices or medical imaging software, with products shipped end to end (required).

  • Knowledge of radiology and emergency department workflows (required).

  • Knowledge of machine learning in Clinical AI (required).

  • Experience running cross-functional delivery across data, ML, software, and QA/RA to fixed dates (required).

  • Fluent English (required).

  • Hands-on use of AI tools (Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar) in current work (required).

  • Preferred: French language skills.

  • Preferred: Acute care, stroke, or emergency imaging background.

  • Preferred: Experience with SaMD and regulated environments (EU MDR, FDA 510(k)).

  • Quality Standards

  • Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.

  • Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.

  • Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.

  • Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.

  • Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.

  • Practices universal safety precautions.

  • Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.

  • Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.

  • Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.

  • Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

Travel

This position requires domestic / international travel up to 10%.

title: Principal Research Scientist
descriptionHtml:
About us

Re-architecting Engineering for the Age of Intelligence

PhysicsX is the physics AI company for industrials. The company’s mission is to accelerate hardware innovation by overhauling what industrial engineering and manufacturing look like today. PhysicsX is building a new simulation software stack to deliver deep physics AI enablement across the entire engineering lifecycle. The company partners with leading organisations in aerospace & defence, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy & renewables, supporting them on some of their most critical and complex challenges. PhysicsX is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in London, New York, and Singapore and an expanding presence in the Bay Area.

Note: We are currently recruiting for multiple levels and positions, however please only apply for the role that best aligns with your skillset and career goals.

What you will do 

  • Own Research work-streams at a high-level to deliver outcomes.
    • Align priorities with problem stakeholders, internal and external.
    • Set the technical direction for the stream and apply judgement and taste to drive progress.
    • Plan roadmaps with clear milestones for key decisions and outcomes.
    • Organise and guide the more junior members of the team to effectively execute and deliver against this roadmap.
    • Communicate purpose and key outcomes to raise awareness across the company and create opportunities for use and deployment.
  • Contribute towards Research group strategy and culture.
    • Identify research areas that would be valuable to the company and champion their development, ordering wrt other research objectives.
    • Promote effective working patterns and proactively flag issues with team dynamics to foster a productive environment.
    • Nurture younger colleagues to grow their skillset and guide their professional development.
  • The below activities in particular.
    • Work closely with our machine learning engineers, simulation engineers, and customers to translate physics and engineering challenges into mathematical problem formulations.
    • Build models to predict the behaviour of physical systems using state-of-the-art machine learning and deep learning techniques.
    • Discuss the results and implications of your work with colleagues and customers, especially how these results can address real-world problems.
    • Collaborate with colleagues beyond the research team to translate your models into production-ready code.
    • Communicate your work to others internally and externally as called for in paper publication venues, industry workshops, customer conversations, etc. This will involve writing for academic and non-academic audiences.

What you bring to the table

  • Ability to scope and effectively deliver projects.
  • Enthusiasm about using machine learning, especially deep learning and/or probabilistic methods, for science and engineering.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to analyse issues, identify causes, and recommend solutions quickly.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills — with teams and customers alike.
  • PhD in computer science, machine learning, applied statistics, mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related field, with particular expertise in any of the following:
    1. operator learning (neural operators), or other probabilistic methods for PDEs;
    2. geometric deep learning or other 3D computer vision methods for point-cloud or mesh-structured data;
    3. generative models for geometry and spatiotemporal data (VAEs, Diffusion Models, Bayesian non-parametric, scaling to large datasets, etc.).
  • Ideally, >4 years of experience in a data-driven role in a professional industry setting, where you have been instrumental in:
    • building machine learning models and pipelines in Python, using common libraries and frameworks (PyTorch / CUDA, ideally with exposure to JAX, NumPy / SciPy), especially including deep learning applications;
    • developing models for bespoke problem settings that involve high-dimensional data (spatiotemporal, geometric, physical);
    • iterating on network architectures and model structure, tuning and optimising for inductive biases, improved generalisability, and improved performance;

About the role

In this role, you will set the standards for how process safety is managed across our projects and future assets, from design and construction through commissioning and operations. title: Product Designer (UX), HCI

Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. Role

Design how people use AI in real product workflows. This role focuses on building HCI interfaces where users can understand, guide, correct, and stay in control of AI systems that reason and act across multiple steps.

Current UX patterns are not enough for proactive AI products. You will help define new interaction models for how users work with AI, review progress, recover from mistakes, and build trust in the system.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design end-to-end user experiences for AI product surfaces, from concept to shipped product.

  • Create interaction patterns for human-AI workflows, including prompting, review, confirmation, correction, handoff, and recovery.

  • Design interfaces that help users understand what the AI is doing, what it knows, what it is unsure about, and what will happen next.

  • Turn complex, multi-step AI capabilities into flows that are clear, controllable, and usable in everyday contexts.

  • Work closely with product, engineering, and ML teams to define problems, test ideas, and ship quickly.

What You Will Need

  • Comfort working with ambiguity and shaping solutions before requirements are fully defined.

  • Good judgment on usability, edge cases, and failure handling.

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. title: Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
London, 4x days per week in-office


Vega is looking for an engineer to build features end to end across our platform from Java/Spring Boot services and APIs to React and TypeScript interfaces – using AI tools as a core part of how they work and helping bring AI-powered capabilities into the product.

About Vega

Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.

Vega built the industry's first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done – from the start of an investor's journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it's also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.

Who we are

We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world's leading technology and financial services firms – including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.

How we do it

Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:

  1. We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

  2. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

  3. We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

  4. We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

  5. We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

We know that this culture won't be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.



Who succeeds in this role

We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.

In this role, you will:

  • Own problems from scoping through shipping and iteration, working directly with business and engineering teams to turn ideas into production features across the full stack

  • Use agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor as a core part of how you design, build, test and review software – and help shape how the team gets the most from them

  • Work with our AI engineers to integrate AI features into the platform – wiring agents, LLM-powered workflows and MCP integrations into services and user interfaces, including streaming responses and sensible guardrails

  • Build and maintain microservices using Java 21 and Spring Boot, contributing to an open architecture that integrates the many players in the private markets ecosystem

  • Define, develop and optimise RESTful APIs, owning the contract between front end and back end with scalability and performance in mind

  • Work closely with designers to turn mockups into responsive, intuitive interfaces using React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, and contribute to the evolution of our design system and theming

  • Ensure seamless integration with third-party systems used by PE firms, distributors, private banks and fund administrators

  • Identify and fix bottlenecks across the stack – from data flow and service efficiency to front-end rendering and UX

  • Champion unit, integration and end-to-end testing, and DevOps best practices

  • Share knowledge and support other engineers, contributing to a culture of excellence and continuous learning

 

What we look for:

  • Proven professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on work across both front end and back end, ideally on fintech applications

  • Fluency with AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) as part of your everyday workflow, with sound judgement on reviewing, testing and owning AI-generated code

  • Practical exposure to building with LLMs – e.g. calling model APIs, integrating an agent or tool-use flow, or shipping a feature on a platform such as AWS Bedrock – and an appetite to go deeper

  • Strong backend experience with Java and Spring Boot, including designing and building microservice architectures with RESTful APIs, and proficiency with SQL and ORMs

  • Proficiency in TypeScript, React and Tailwind CSS, with a strong grasp of responsive and mobile-first design

  • Experience in modern cloud distributed architecture, particularly AWS, Kubernetes and Kafka

  • Solid understanding of unit, integration and end-to-end testing, plus CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks

  • Experience working in an agile environment with cross-functional teams (product, design, engineering)

  • A proactive problem solver who takes initiative and brings high ambition to a fast-moving team

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on scalable solutions

  • Strong communication skills, including explaining complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience

 

Why join us?

  • You will help define the transformation of one of the most influential industries of our time with AI, working alongside an ambitious and dedicated team

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Benefits including medical insurance, gym membership, learning budget, and more

title: Product Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

Agentic process automation is a category enterprises are actively budgeting for - and one crowded with claims. As our Product Marketing Manager, you make sure blp's story cuts through; sharp positioning against the alternatives our buyers actually consider, messaging that speaks to CFOs and COOs in business outcomes rather than technology, and sales teams equipped to win against ERP workflow add-ons, RPA vendors, and point-AI copilots.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the center of how blp goes to market. You will own the translation layer between product capability and buyer value - across launches, enablement, competitive intelligence, and the content that carries our positioning into every deal.

 

What you'll do

  • Own positioning and messaging execution. Maintain and evolve blp's messaging house: value proposition, pillars, proof points, and persona-specific narratives, and enforce its consistent use across web, decks, campaigns, and sales conversations.

  • Build and maintain competitive intelligence. Own battlecards and competitive positioning against ERP workflow automation, RPA, IDP/point-AI solutions, and adjacent AI platforms; keep sales ahead of competitor moves and objection patterns.

  • Enable the field. Create and maintain the core sales toolkit - first-meeting decks, discovery guides, objection handling, ROI narratives, and persona playbooks for CFO, COO, shared services, and process excellence audiences.

  • Sharpen personas and ICP. Continuously refine our understanding of buying committees, triggers (ERP transformation, e-invoicing mandates, shared-services efficiency programs), and where we win and lose - grounded in win/loss analysis and field feedback.

  • Drive product launches and releases. Turn platform capabilities and new workflow coverage into launch narratives, internal enablement, and external announcements that land with executive buyers.

  • Fuel demand and thought leadership. Supply campaigns, events, and content marketing with differentiated angles, from executive-facing reports to industry-specific value narratives.

  • Be the voice of the market internally. Bring buyer, analyst, and competitive insight back into product and leadership discussions, even when it complicates the roadmap story, to sharpen framing and packaging.

 

What you'll bring

  • 5–8 years in B2B software marketing, with at least 3 years in product marketing for enterprise SaaS - ideally in ERP-adjacent, finance operations, automation, or applied-AI categories.

  • Proven ability to market to economic buyers: you write for CFOs, CIOs/CTOs, and COOs in the language of cost, productivity, working capital, and EBIT - not features.

  • Strong competitive instincts: experience building battlecards and positioning in crowded categories, and translating technical differentiation into commercial arguments.

  • A portfolio of enablement assets that sales teams actually used - you measure your work by win rates and message adoption, not asset counts.

  • Analytical rigor: comfortable with win/loss analysis, market and analyst research, and grounding messaging claims in defensible evidence.

  • Excellent writing and presentation craft in English; German is a strong plus for our DACH-concentrated customer base.

  • Enough technical depth to understand ERP processes, AI agents, and enterprise integration well enough to challenge product - and simplify it for buyers.

 

What you'll get

  • Category-defining work. Agentic process automation is being defined now, and you will shape how the market understands it.

  • Real substance. 550+ enterprise customers and measurable outcomes mean your positioning rests on proof, not promises.

  • Scope and access. You get a seat at the table with product, sales leadership, and the executive team, and your work goes straight into deals and board narratives.

  • A company at an inflection point. It has a strong European base, fresh US market entry, and a proven platform to build the story on.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

descriptionHtml:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are seeking a Product Qualification Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will execute product qualification activities, turning qualification plans into robust test setups, reliable bench data, and clear, traceable evidence that supports product release.

Reporting to the Quality & Reliability Program Lead, you will work closely with the Package Reliability Engineer, Product Engineering team, and external laboratories and OSAT partners to plan and execute qualification testing. You will develop test hardware in collaboration with external partners, coordinate the design of test PCBs and fixtures, select and configure test equipment, and ensure every qualification campaign produces accurate, well-documented, and reproducible results.

Your core focus will be to transform qualification requirements into practical test solutions, execute high-quality validation campaigns, and deliver the reliable data needed to make confident product qualification and release decisions.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Run product qualification testing by performing bench and laboratory qualification tests (thermal, electrical, mechanical, and environmental stress tests) in accordance with qualification plans and test matrix, while accurately tracking samples, test conditions, and results.

  • Develop test PCBs and fixtures with external partners, work ontest boards, adapters, and fixtures, from requirements through review and bring-up.

  • Set up and maintain qualification test equipment, including thermal chambers, power supplies, data acquisition systems (DAQ), probe stations, and other laboratory instrumentation, ensuring the lab is always ready to support qualification activities.

  • Coordinate qualification campaigns with OSATs and external laboratories by managing schedules, sample logistics, and test execution, while providing on-site or remote test supervision where needed

  • Collect, analyze, and document qualification results, producing clear pass/fail assessments, comprehensive test reports, and fully traceable records that contribute to the overall product qualification evidence package.

  • Identify and communicate risks early, proactively escalating test failures, equipment limitations, data anomalies, or schedule risks to the Package Reliability Engineer and Quality & Reliability Program Lead to keep qualification activities on track.

Your Qualifications

  • Educational background with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related discipline.

  • Hands-on product qualification experience with 2–4+ years of experience in hardware bring-up, bench testing, or product qualification test campaigns.

  • Experience testing RF and high-speed I/O, including high-speed serial, RF, or optical links using equipment such as vector network analyzers (VNAs), high-bandwidth oscilloscopes, BERTs, and other signal integrity measurement tools. This is a core requirement for the role, as experience limited to low-speed digital or logic circuit testing is not sufficient. Experience with photonics testing is a strong advantage.

  • Proficiency with laboratory test equipment, including oscilloscopes, power supplies, thermal chambers, data acquisition (DAQ) systems, and, ideally, RF and high-speed characterization equipment such as VNAs, BERT, and high-bandwidth scopes.

  • Experience developing test hardware, working closely with PCB design and fabrication partners to define specs, review designs, and support the bring-up of test boards or fixtures.

  • Strong test execution and documentation skills, running test campaigns methodically and writing clean, traceable results.

  • Excellent collaboration and coordination skills, with experience working across reliability engineering, product engineering, external laboratories, and OSAT partners to successfully execute qualification activities.

  • Thrives in a startup environment, demonstrating initiative, adaptability, and the ability to take ownership in a fast-paced, resource-conscious setting.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

title: Program Director
descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the job

Anduril Australia delivers advanced maritime capability to the Royal Australian Navy and our allied partners. Our maritime programs are among the most significant and closely watched capability efforts in Australian Defence, and they are moving into operational service at a pace the sector has not seen before.

As Director, Program Management, you will lead a critical program for Anduril Australia and our Maritime division through disciplined execution, introduction into service and continuous capability development. You will own cost, schedule, risk and performance outcomes, and you will be the senior relationship lead for Navy, Defence and Government stakeholders. Working hand-in-hand with the Chief Engineer and with the engineering, operations and support teams, you will make sure capability reaches the fleet, is supported in service and keeps improving. This is an execution-focused leadership role, and stakeholder confidence matters as much as the schedule. You will both lead and execute.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and execute a large, complex, high-profile maritime program, owning delivery against contracted cost, schedule, scope and performance commitments.
  • Own the program’s baselines, Integrated Master Schedule and resource plan (headcount, budget and facilities). Forecast accurately, identify variances early and drive recovery.
  • Lead introduction into service. Plan and coordinate delivery, acceptance, operational test and evaluation, and transition to the operating and support organisations, working with Navy to reach initial and full operational capability milestones.
  • Work with the engineering, logistics and support teams to ensure the Fundamental Inputs to Capability are in place for service entry, including training, maintenance and support, supply, facilities and documentation.
  • Drive continuous capability development. Manage a regular cadence of hardware and software capability increments, balance new capability against operational availability, and keep configuration management and assurance in step.
  • Capture operator and customer feedback and, with product and engineering leads, turn it into a prioritised capability roadmap that the customer understands and supports.
  • Build and manage relationships across a complex stakeholder landscape, including Navy capability and fleet stakeholders, Defence acquisition and sustainment organisations, Government, industry partners and suppliers. Act as their trusted senior point of contact for the program.
  • Develop and maintain stakeholder engagement and communication plans. Lead program governance forums, steering committees and executive briefings, and manage expectations proactively, particularly when the news is difficult.
  • Manage delivery against Commonwealth contracts (including ASDEFCON-based contracts), covering milestones, contract deliverables, payments, contract change proposals, acceptance and reporting obligations.
  • Ensure crisp communication and reporting at all levels: to Anduril Australia and Maritime senior leadership, to Defence customers, to your program teams and to functional teams across Anduril globally.
  • Lead, mentor and grow a team of Program and Technical Program Managers. Set clear expectations and instil a high-ownership, delivery-focused culture.
  • Partner with the Chief Engineer and engineering leaders to drive execution and team velocity. Understand the technical implementation well enough to make informed trade-offs and to propose alternatives when necessary.
  • Identify, resolve and escalate key cross-team dependencies, including those spanning Anduril’s Australian and US teams, industry partners and suppliers.
  • Ensure the program meets its Defence security (DISP), export control (Australian and ITAR/EAR) and Australian Industry Capability obligations.
  • Identify and resolve systemic execution issues. Establish lean, effective governance, processes and tools suited to a fast-moving environment, and exercise meticulous, swift follow-through on all asks and deliverables.

Core Requirements

  • Minimum of 10+ years’ experience in program and project management, including at least 5 years in senior roles such as Program Director, Senior Program Manager or Project Director leading complex defence programs through execution and into service.
  • Background in Navy or military programs (as serving or former ADF personnel, within Defence, or in defence industry), with experience across maritime platforms, systems or capability.
  • Significant experience delivering complex programs with the Australian Government, including strong working knowledge of the Defence capability life cycle, introduction into service and sustainment processes, and Commonwealth contracting (ASDEFCON).
  • Demonstrated experience introducing capability into service, including acceptance, operational test and evaluation, the Fundamental Inputs to Capability and transition to sustainment.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, with a proven ability to build trust with and influence senior Navy, Defence and Government stakeholders, balance competing interests and keep their confidence through challenging program phases.
  • Proven track record of managing cost, schedule and risk on large, technically complex programs, including resource management and integrated schedule planning.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams of program and project managers, and leading cross-functional teams through influence.
  • Solid technical aptitude and an understanding of systems engineering, hardware and software integration, configuration management, and the associated challenges and risks.
  • Practical familiarity with both Agile and Waterfall (phase-gated) methodologies, including managing incremental capability updates within a contracted environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong interpersonal skills and executive presence. Able to brief senior Defence and company leadership with confidence.
  • An aptitude and appetite to thrive in an organisation with nascent structure, a high-ownership culture and a “whatever it takes” environment. High ownership, low ego.
  • Based in Sydney and willing to travel domestically and internationally (including to the US), approximately 25% of the time.
  • Australian citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain an NV1 security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current NV2 security clearance.
  • Experience with autonomous systems, robotics or other advanced and emerging maritime capability.
  • Experience with in-service support and sustainment, including integrated logistics support; reliability, availability and maintainability; and performance-based support arrangements.
  • Experience running programs with continuous or spiral capability development, including software release management under Defence seaworthiness or technical regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience with Defence gate reviews, independent assurance reviews and capability acceptance processes.
  • Experience on international or collaborative programs, including US–Australia collaboration, AUKUS-related activity and export controls (ITAR/EAR).
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to use data and metrics to back up assumptions and recommendations and to drive decisions.
  • Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, MS Project or Primavera P6.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science or a related discipline. Postgraduate qualifications in project management or business, or a professional certification (e.g. AIPM, PMP, PRINCE2, MSP), are desirable.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an ----- address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to

    • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is ----- before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

    • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

title: Program Manager, Office of the Chief Product Officer
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Opportunity

The CPO office at Prosus is deliberately small. Nalden sets the direction: what we build and why. Jons, as Chief of Staff, creates the traction: the operating model, the portfolio, the prioritisation, and the decisions that turn direction into shipped product. Around them sit product managers, product marketing, growth, brand, content and design, and three product pods that do the building.

What holds those two ends together is the work itself: every initiative visible, owned and moving, and every decision captured before it evaporates. That is this job. As Program Manager you run Nalden_OS — the operating loop of the CPO portfolio — day to day. You do not own the initiatives; you make sure each one has someone who does.

You join while that loop is being built rather than maintained, so you shape it: what gets tracked, how reviews run, what a decision record looks like, and which reporting we stop doing because nobody reads it.

In this role you will

  • Keep the whole portfolio visible, with an explicit owner on every line of work in flight across the CPO office and the product pods.

  • Prepare the decisions: shape ambiguous work until it is ready to be decided on, and prepare the prioritisation calls and operating reviews for the CPO and the Chief of Staff.

  • Make it move: track progress and dependencies across teams, surface blockers early, and escalate with a recommendation rather than a status update.

  • Make it stick: capture decisions and the reasoning behind them, keep the information people rely on accurate, and turn what teams learn into knowledge someone will reuse.

  • Build the view: a clean, reliable portfolio in slides, backed by a tracking system people actually update — assembled with AI so it takes an hour, not a week.

  • Be the honest signal: say early where the plan and reality have diverged, including when the useful version is the uncomfortable one.

What This Role Is Not

You do not make product decisions, approve teams' work, or become a reporting layer between teams and leadership. If teams spend more time updating you than shipping, the role is failing — and you would be the first to say so.

Who You Are

You are the person others trust in a messy week. When priorities shift and work stalls, you stay level, name what is actually happening, and get the loop closed. You follow up without nagging, and an unowned item bothers you until somebody picks it up.


You like order, but you fit the system to the work rather than the other way round. You build trust quickly across designers, engineers and executives, and you carry influence without authority: you move work through people who do not report to you. You are direct enough to raise the awkward problem early, and low-ego enough to let someone else take the credit when it lands.

What You Bring

  • 8 to 10 years running cross-team program execution in digital commerce, technology product management, consumer facing technology, with an earlier career in management consulting.

  • You have owned outcomes across teams without owning the teams. Titles vary — program manager, strategy manager, operations lead, product operations — but the pattern is the same: you were accountable for work you moved through people who did not report to you.

  • Fluent in product work: you know how discovery, design and shipping actually run, and you can talk to designers and engineers without a translator.

  • Comfortable with data and tools: you build a clean portfolio view and a tracking system people trust, and you use AI to do the assembly faster than most.

  • Experience working closely with senior leaders, ideally from an executive office or chief-of-staff environment; experience inside a larger corporate group around a small, fast team is a real advantage.

  • Comfortable at both altitudes: you can run a room of executives in the morning and fix the tracking sheet in the afternoon.

  • Excellent written and spoken English. Dutch is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Not a classic PMO profile. We want someone who clears the path, not someone who produces process.

What We Offer

  • Global Impact: Play a crucial role in shaping the future of global commerce. Be part of a dynamic ecosystem of tech-led companies across markets, from emerging disruptors to established platforms, all working to create positive change at scale.

  • Growth Opportunities: Expand your expertise through high-stakes challenges within our diverse portfolio. You will gain access to a network of businesses, leaders, and learning opportunities that span continents and industries.

  • Innovative Culture: Join a forward-thinking team that values strategic insights and bold ideas. You will operate at the intersection of venture-building, innovation, and investment, where experimentation is encouraged and cross-company collaboration drives breakthroughs.

  • Creative Environment: Engage in work that encourages creativity and constant improvement. We challenge assumptions, explore new frontiers, and believe great ideas can come from anywhere in our ecosystem.

  • Collaborative Atmosphere: Benefit from autonomy and self-management in a supportive, outcome-driven workspace. You will work alongside sharp, motivated peers across our portfolio, all united by a shared ambition to move the needle.

  • Hybrid Work: Experience the satisfaction of our flexible model tailored to balance work and life.

  • Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a salary package that reflects your skills and contributions.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: From health and wellness to learning, commuting, and everyday perks, we offer a well-rounded package designed to help you thrive at work and beyond.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

title: QA Engineer - Payments
descriptionHtml:
SumUp is already live in 38 markets and still growing. Our Global Expansion Team takes SumUp's payment products into new countries, with Mexico and Canada among our most recent launches and more markets like New Zealand and Argentina on the way. As a QA Engineer in our Berlin payments team, you'll build the automated and manual tests that decide when a new card reader can go live in a market, across frontend, backend and mobile flows, and you'll also help complete L3 certification (the final round of testing that acquiring banks and card networks require). It's hands-on engineering work with real launch impact, because your tests help new markets go live and recently launched ones stay stable, so small businesses there can take card payments with confidence.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain frontend and backend test automation, with mobile where relevant, and add targeted regression tests to continuous integration (CI) workflows so market specific checks run consistently after code changes
  • Test SumUp products across markets, with a mix of automated and manual testing, functional, integration and regression checks, plus edge cases and recovery scenarios.
  • Spot ways to improve how we test, explain why they matter and make a convincing case for the changes with the biggest payoff
  • Trace failures through complex payment flows using logs and transaction traces, then raise clear, prioritised defects and work with engineers and external partners until they're fixed
  • Own the testing of end-to-end communication between a payment terminal, software applications, and an acquiring network. with acquiring banks and card networks, and keep the team informed on certification status, quality risks and release readiness so launch decisions rest on evidence
  • Work closely in collaboration with engineers, product and market-launch teams, as well as acquirers, card schemes and certification labs.

What you'll bring

  • Programming or scripting skill to build and maintain automated tests for frontend web and backend APIs, and comfort reading code in languages such as Golang, Kotlin, Java or others on our Tech Radar.
  • Experience testing software both manually and with automation, including turning requirements into test scenarios and deciding what to automate first based on customer, launch and technical risk.
  • Ability to analyse logs, transaction traces and test results, and to write defect reports that include reproduction steps, expected versus actual behaviour, impact and evidence.
  • Comfort working with Git and Jira (or similar tools)
  • Experience with SQL and test-data setup, contract testing, mocking or service virtualisation.
  • An engineering mindset: the ability to spot what can be improved, explain the reasoning and persuade others with clear evidence
  • A curious, ownership minded approach: seeking out context when things are unclear and using AI tools where they help.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Card payments, payment terminals, acquirers, card schemes or certification labs.
  • Market launches, device integrations, external technical partners or business-to-business communication.

Payments experience is helpful but not required. We'll support you in learning card payments, devices and the certification process.

Why you should join SumUp

  • 🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first set up
  • 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced
  • 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success
  • 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education
  • 💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions
  • 🏖️ Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days
  • 🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches
  • 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

descriptionHtml:

You’ll champion our automation-first, shift-left approach to quality, building automated testing into delivery from the outset and embedding quality throughout the lifecycle. You’ll identify risks early, provide rapid feedback, prevent defects and continuously improve quality. You’ll be confident questioning assumptions, influencing technical and quality decisions, and adapting quickly to different technologies, teams and client environments.

The role

You'll work on public and private sector projects. You may be the sole software quality engineer on a project or work in a team.

Leading by example and promoting the Opencast approach, you'll work in an agile environment across all testing types. You'll collaborate with team members, clients and users to maintain quality and follow best practice. You'll adapt to different tools and technologies, advising on the best and mentoring junior colleagues.

You'll ensure that work is carried out in accordance with Opencast's quality, environmental, and information security policies and procedures, as well as applicable customer policies, standards, and procedures while working on client.

Requirements

We’re looking for people with experience delivering digital services within the public sector, with an understanding of GDS standards and ways of working.

You’ll need strong test automation experience, including hands-on involvement in building, developing or maintaining automation frameworks. You should be comfortable contributing to automation strategy and embedding effective testing practices throughout the delivery lifecycle.

This role involves weekly on-site work, and you’ll be required to travel regularly to client locations across the UK. We’re looking for people who value in-person collaboration, enjoy building strong relationships, and are passionate about delivering solutions that make a real difference for our clients.

Due to the nature of this role, you must either hold active Security Check (SC) clearance or be eligible and willing to undergo the clearance process. 

SC clearance is granted in line with UK Government security vetting requirements. Typically, applicants must have UK citizenship and have lived continuously in the UK for at least the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days. Nationality and immigration status may also be considered as part of the vetting process. We are unable to progress applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements.

  • Concepts and benefits of non-functional testing

  • Basic principles of programming paradigms, such as object-orientated and procedural programming

Essential Skills

In the interview, we will assess how you have:

  • Strong attention to detail

Other experience

title: Regional Sales Director, Core Enterprise – DACH
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in the DACH region, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role in a new market: you will create the pipeline machine from the ground up, rather than inherit an established team or playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

This role is remote, and you can be based anywhere in Germany. Munich, Düsseldorf and Cologne are our key hub cities for the region.

In this role, you will

  • Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives
  • Build a pipeline machine in a new market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across Germany, Austria and Switzerland
  • Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly
  • Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large DACH enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across the region's largest accounts
  • Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting
  • Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers
  • Partner closely with your peer Regional Sales Directors, Samsara's wider leadership and Customer Success to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and into new markets

Minimum requirements for the role

  • Three or more years of proven success leading new business sales at enterprise level, with a track record of revenue delivery and overachievement against target
  • Has built something rather than inherited it, with experience building a market or a new sales function from scratch
  • Full team lifecycle experience: has recruited, ramped and retained a team, and can show where each happened
  • Direct experience selling into enterprise companies at comparable deal sizes and cycle lengths
  • Experience establishing rigour in value-based selling, using methodologies such as MEDDIC or Command of the Message
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business
  • Fluent German and based in Germany

An ideal candidate also has

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company, helping to build or refine the enterprise go-to-market playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style, with a record of developing AEs from good to exceptional
  • Intelligence and genuine coachability: you learn fast, welcome feedback and apply it
  • A competitive, entrepreneurial streak: you create momentum without needing to own every function involved
  • Experience leading and engaging a remote team across multiple cities
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you are expected to build process while delivering results
  • A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity: you can set the market strategy and also step into a deal review to show a rep where their qualification is weak

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers
