title: Senior Account Executive - Consumer Tech
descriptionHtml:
Who we are:

We are Axicom, part of WPP, an award-winning global communications agency for tech-driven brands. We bring together a diverse team of PR professionals passionate about integrated communications and telling the transformative stories of technology. With offices in the Netherlands, United States, United Kingdom, Spain, Italy, Germany, France, Sweden, Brazil, and Mexico, we are the largest global agency specializing in tech communication.
 
We're proud to be recently recognized as Agency of the Future, Disruptive Agency of the Year, and Best PR Network to Work For (EMEA). This underscores our commitment to innovation, growth, and fostering a collaborative culture. Since 1994, we've delivered ground-breaking campaigns for the world's most innovative tech companies, and we are always seeking new talent to join our team of Futurists.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com. 

More about the role 
We are an award-winning team of PR pros who are proud to be PRovoke’s Technology Agency of the Year in 2025 at the EMEA Sabre Awards. We bring together a diverse group of people who share a passion and deep understanding of the technology landscape and tech storytelling and we are looking for new talent to join our team.  

Axicom delivers communication campaigns for some of the world’s most innovative technology companies. From offices in Amsterdam, Austin, Los Angeles, London, Madrid, Milan, Munich, New York, Paris, San Francisco, and Stockholm, Axicom designs, builds, and delivers ground-breaking and thought-provoking campaigns. We offer our clients PR consultancy, creative strategy, media relations, influencer engagement, content, digital marketing, and integrated communications. 

As a Senior Account Executive at Axicom, you will work with leading consumer  technology businesses who are shaping how we live and work.  This role is perfect for an ambitious individual a few years into their PR career, who is looking to become a consumer technology specialist. You’ll be working with a team launching the latest smartphones and fitness tech products and delivering creative press office and campaign stories across gaming and smart home brands.  

We’re looking for someone who has a passion for the tech space, so if you are a gamer, a gadget nerd or just someone who loves working in the consumer tech landscape this is the role for you. Someone who loves the thrill of securing coverage in today’s media landscape, is always reading the newest substack or hunting out the latest YouTuber for their clients,  enjoys heading to trade shows across the world and who has the attention to detail and creative mindset to deliver stand out events, experiences and campaigns and wants to be part of a team that always goes the extra mile.  

We are an agency of Futurists not Followers, so if you are top of your game, ambitious and wanting to work with people who are looking to the future of comms now. This is the role for you.  

Our London Office Axicom has a significant presence in London, as one of our global office locations, enabling us to deliver ground-breaking campaigns for our clients. 

What you'll do 

  • Media relations: Own media relationships with consumer technology, lifestyle and national press, be a go to in the team for the press we need to be speaking to, building on relationships you already have and establishing new ones. You’ll have a good bank of contacts and want to grow this further.  
  • Writing: You’ll be writing press releases, media pitches and developing smart content for your clients. We want someone who knows how to tell a story that media will love and clients will sign off   
  • Client communications: You’ll confidently build relationships with clients, speaking to them regularly as the main point of contact on specific projects, joining weekly calls and proactively updating them on activity taking place. We firmly believe the best work happens when we act as one team with our clients and want engaging, confident people who want build professional relationships with their clients.   
  • Proactivity: Spot media opportunities, cultural trends and points of interest for your clients, identify ways to creatively solve problems and contribute proactively to your accounts 
  • Account organisation: You will help your team keep accounts organised, update clients in timely ways and be aware and proactive in keeping your account leads updated 
  • Media interest: Outside of specific pitches and sell ins you will be expected to foster an interest in the UK media landscape from following relevant journalists to your clients, reading media relevant to clients and actively sharing with your teams  
  • Team player: Play an active and helpful part in client teams and broader Axicom initiatives, demonstrating effective time management and acting as an agency ambassador. 

Experience that contributes to success 

  • Established early career PR experience, two years or more experience across the consumer lifestyle or consumer technology sectors 
  • A strong interest in the UK consumer technology landscape and UK media  
  • Proven ability to execute and manage media sell ins, work on multiple clients and strong interpersonal skills  
  • Proven ability to juggle multiple tasks at any one time and excellent time management skills 
  • Solid writing skills with experience in writing press materials   
  • Energetic and passionate about PR & communications  
  • High levels of Intelligence, Initiative, and Integrity, with an ambition to create award-winning work. 

 #LI-CY1

You belong at Axicom:

Our vision is for Axicom, a Burson Group company, to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Axicom, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. title: Senior Account Manager (French-speaking)
descriptionHtml:
Who are we

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

Location

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis. We do not partner with search firms.

About the Team

We are looking for a Senior Account Manager to join our EMEA team, which focuses on strengthening relationships with existing customers and driving sustainable revenue growth through retention, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.

In this role, you will own the commercial outcomes and full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts. This includes protecting customer retention, supporting successful renewals, identifying expansion opportunities, and ensuring customers continue to realise value from Lokalise over time.

You will manage a portfolio of strategic customers, with a particular focus on French-speaking stakeholders and organisations. You will act as a trusted commercial partner, helping customers connect Lokalise's capabilities to their business objectives, localisation workflows, and international growth plans.

You will report to the Director of Sales EMEA and work closely with Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, Product, Finance, and Legal. You will be measured primarily on account expansion through upselling, cross-selling, and broader customer adoption and gross revenue retention across your portfolio .

What You Will Do

  • Own account commercial outcomes: Take responsibility for the full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.
  • Protect retention and renewal outcomes: Monitor account health, customer engagement, product value, and commercial risks to identify potential retention challenges early and coordinate effective action with internal teams.
  • Drive account expansion: Identify and execute upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities, leading commercial conversations and negotiations with a focus on achieving and surpassing sales quotas.
  • Develop account strategies: Create and maintain clear account plans based on customer goals, stakeholder priorities, product adoption, business risks, renewal plans, and opportunities for broader collaboration.
  • Lead consultative customer conversations: Advise customers on how to improve their localisation and content workflows, connect their needs to Lokalise's solutions, and articulate clear business value and return on investment.
  • Navigate complex enterprise sales processes: Coordinate multi-stakeholder opportunities, procurement activity, contract negotiations, and legal discussions, ensuring progress toward successful commercial outcomes.
  • Partner cross-functionally and maintain accurate reporting: Work closely with Customer Success and Solutions Architecture to support retention and expansion, collaborate with Product, Finance, and Legal to resolve customer needs, and maintain accurate CRM records, account plans, pipeline updates, and forecasts.
  • Use AI to elevate your work: Proactively explore and apply AI tools and approaches to improve customer research, account planning, decision-making, productivity, and go-to-market impact.

What You Must Have

  • Full account lifecycle ownership: +5 years of experience owning the commercial lifecycle of strategic or enterprise customer accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling in a quota-based B2B SaaS environment.
  • Proven commercial outcomes: A track record of protecting customer revenue, achieving gross revenue retention or comparable retention targets, and generating measurable account expansion.
  • Professional fluency in French, including the ability to lead customer conversations, presentations, and commercial negotiations in French.
  • Ability to understand complex SaaS products, with experience selling to business, marketing, and sales stakeholders, and translating product capabilities into clear commercial value.
  • Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across a remote, international organisation.
  • Experience engaging and influencing C-level and senior stakeholders, including the ability to lead strategic conversations and align solutions with business priorities.
  • Strong commercial skills, including experience identifying growth opportunities, negotiating contracts, and navigating complex procurement or legal discussions.
  • Competency using AI tools to accelerate customer research, synthesis, account planning, and decision-making, with a proactive mindset toward adopting new AI-enabled ways of working.

It's a Plus If You Have

  • Experience managing or selling to enterprise customers in the French market, regardless of where you are based.
  • Experience engaging technical stakeholders (e.g., IT, engineering, product) in addition to business buyers.
  • Experience selling localisation, translation management, or other workflow software.
  • Experience working with procurement processes such as RFPs, security reviews, or complex enterprise buying committees.
  • Familiarity with structured sales methodologies or account planning frameworks.

Our Benefits

💰 Competitive salary and employee stock options.

🌍 Fully remote setup with flexible working hours.

🏢 Co-working budget for those days you want a change from your home office.

🌴 Flexible vacation policy to recharge when you need to.

🖥️ Home office setup budget: monitor, desk, ergonomics, whatever helps you do your best work.

📚 Learning & development budget to grow your skills and career.

🏥 Health insurance to keep you covered.

🧘 Wellness allowance to support your mental and physical well-being.

🤝 Great startup culture: remote but close-knit, with regular retreats and social events to stay connected.

*Final compensation will depend on location, skills, and experience.

Spain: For this position in Spain, the On-Target Earnings (OTE) range from €76,000–€120,000 (50/50 base and commission split), with uncapped commission potential. The applicable collective agreement is the XIX Convenio colectivo estatal de empresas de consultoría, tecnologías de la información y estudios de mercado y de la opinión pública, under professional classification Area 4 – Group/Level C2.

We are committed to a culture of inclusion and equal opportunities. As part of our global hiring process, we kindly ask that resumes/CVs be submitted in English, as it’s our primary business language across teams and regions.

Support global consolidation and reporting

Partner across Finance and with our auditors

  • Coordinate with the Manager, Accounting and the Accounting team to gather the data needed for consolidation entries.
  • Support internal and external audit requests relevant to the consolidation and global reporting scope.
  • Work across our finance systems (Tagetik, Microsoft Business Central, Sage 200) and help us as we migrate to NetSuite, improving processes and controls along the way.

title: Senior AI Product Manager (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.
We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

As a Senior AI Product Manager, you move plancraft closer to becoming the autopilot for the trades: Evolving our product from software that helps tradespeople manage their work into one where AI agents can take on meaningful parts of their daily workload.

This is not about adding AI features to an existing roadmap. You’ll own an emerging problem space and identify where agents can create the highest leverage for our customers beyond what Plancraft does today. That means getting close to tradespeople and their businesses, uncovering the problems worth solving, and working with Engineering and UX to turn them into reliable, trustworthy products customers are willing to rely on for real work.

You’ll operate across the full product journey: from spending time with tradespeople in the field and deciding which opportunity to pursue, to working with Engineering to understand technical requirements and trade-offs, defining evaluation criteria, shipping to production, and learning from real-world usage.

The impact should be tangible. The products you build will aim to help trades businesses improve outcomes such as profit margins, quote acceptance rates, and capacity utilisation — while opening up entirely new product and growth opportunities for plancraft.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Plancraft’s customer-facing AI agents and workflows.

  • Identify high-potential customer problems beyond today’s platform and translate messy, real-world trades workflows into focused opportunities for agentic products.

  • Define and own the single co-worker interface for customers to interact with and manage agents and their underlying workflows.

  • Work in a Product Trio with Engineering and UX throughout discovery, evaluation, and delivery, from early problem validation to production-quality releases.

  • Establish a repeatable AI product operating loop across discovery, evaluation, release gates, monitoring, and iteration.

  • Define and maintain evaluation sets, quality standards, and release criteria for customer-facing AI products, including accuracy, correction rates, latency, and safe rollback conditions.

  • Instrument and monitor AI product performance, using customer behaviour and quality signals to decide what to scale, change, or stop.

  • Demonstrate measurable customer outcomes from AI-powered workflows, including improvements in efficiency, profitability, quote acceptance, capacity utilisation, activation, and retention.

  • Contribute the Product perspective to technical and platform trade-offs, including customer value, quality, cost, and time to market, together with Engineering and the shared AI infrastructure counterpart.

  • Partner across Product and Engineering to manage dependencies, reusable AI experience patterns, mobile and voice input, and handovers between customer workflows.

  • Work closely with RevOps, Sales, and Customer Success to understand adoption and willingness-to-pay signals and contribute to AI pricing and monetisation experiments.

Must-Have Skills

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including at least 2 years owning and shipping AI products in production end-to-end.

  • Strong applied GenAI literacy across LLMs, agents, RAG, and evaluation frameworks — sufficient to understand technical requirements and help evaluate Product, quality, cost, and time-to-market trade-offs together with Engineering.

  • Experience building 0-to-1 AI products or new product areas, from customer discovery and problem definition through production launch and iteration.

  • Experience defining quality and success criteria for AI products, including evaluation metrics, release thresholds, customer outcomes, and post-launch monitoring.

  • Strong customer discovery and product judgment, with the ability to turn complex real-world workflows into focused AI product opportunities.

  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up environment, with a track record of creating structure, setting priorities, and delivering despite ambiguity.

  • Proven cross-functional ownership, working closely with Engineering and UX from discovery through production and managing dependencies across teams.

  • English at C1 level and German at C2 level.

  • Willingness to stay close to customers and the team, including field discovery with tradespeople and regular presence in Hamburg (approximately one week per month or equivalent).

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with voice, mobile, or document AI, particularly products that turn unstructured inputs into reliable workflows.

  • Experience with AI monetisation, including usage-based, credit-based, or hybrid pricing models.

  • Background in B2B SaaS for SMBs, field service, construction, or the trades.

  • Familiarity with product and research tools such as PostHog, Sentry, Dovetail, or ProductFruits.

  • Additional language skills in Italian, Spanish, Dutch, or Polish.

WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR

You’ll probably enjoy this role if you want to build rather than inherit.

You like starting with an important but not fully defined problem and creating clarity through customer insight, data, experimentation, and strong product judgment. You’re excited by AI because of the problems it can solve — not simply because the technology is new.

You’re comfortable working closely with engineers, understanding technical requirements and evaluation results, and translating them into sound Product decisions.

You want meaningful ownership. You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, narrowing a large opportunity space into the right first wedge, shipping it, learning from real usage, and changing course when the evidence tells you to.

And importantly, you want your work to have a visible outcome. The products you build here should change how trades businesses operate — and their adoption, customer value, and commercial impact will be measurable.

WHY PLANCRAFT?

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

title: Senior Applied AI Scientist, Commerce Foundation Models
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

About the team

Join the AI team at Prosus, a global technology group with businesses in food delivery, e-commerce, classifieds, travel and payments. We build LCM, the Large Commerce Model: our own foundation model, trained on billions of transactions and interactions from proprietary data across the portfolio. LCM already powers search, recommendations and marketing in production at iFood. We are extending it across our companies around the world and to businesses outside the group, while broadening its capabilities in agents and real-time prediction tasks. Your work will shape what LCM learns next and feed directly into products used by millions of people.

About the role

We’re looking for experienced applied scientists in two tracks: pre-training, and post-training and continual learning. Each scientist will own a focused research direction within a track. The areas below describe the team’s research agenda; we are looking for depth in one or more of them.

The role involves designing experiments, writing the code to run them, analysing results and developing training methods that other teams can use. Scientists own the research questions, training objectives and evidence needed to decide whether a change works, and work with ML engineers to turn successful experiments into reliable training runs. We are a team of around 30 engineers with a flat structure, working directly with portfolio companies to define problems, evaluate models and bring successful work into production.

In the first three months, the expectation is to establish strong baselines in a chosen research area, develop and evaluate an improvement, and work with the relevant teams to test it in a downstream application.

Track 1: Pre-training

This track focuses on continued pre-training of open-weight models on commerce data, including how we represent that data, allocate training compute and transfer capabilities to smaller models. Research areas include:

  • Studying scaling behaviour, data mixtures and compute allocation to decide what goes into the next training run.

  • Developing mid-training methods, including data refinement, annealing schedules, context extension and alignment between text and semantic IDs for users, items and merchants.

  • Designing training sequences from user histories, merchant catalogues and market data, and studying how representations transfer across companies, languages and commerce categories.

  • Building synthetic data pipelines and measuring their contribution through controlled comparisons with real data.

  • Distilling the base model into smaller models, including through on-policy distillation, and measuring the trade-offs between quality, inference cost and latency.

  • Developing evaluations that help select pre-training runs and predict downstream performance, including checks for temporal leakage, generalisation to new users and items, and retention of existing capabilities.

  • Tabular foundation models are a possible specialisation: pre-training and in-context learning on structured commerce data, using synthetic and real tables and comparing results with established tabular methods.

Relevant experience includes continued pre-training or mid-training, data mixture research, scaling laws, tokenisation, entity representations, distillation, or tabular foundation models such as TabPFN and TabICL.

Track 2: Post-training and continual learning

This track focuses on adapting LCM to commerce tasks and learning from interactions after deployment. The goal is to turn signals from a continuous stream of billions of user sessions across the portfolio into regular updates to model weights, while retaining the capabilities the model has already learned. Research areas include:

  • Developing post-training methods using supervised fine-tuning, preference optimisation such as DPO, and reinforcement learning with verifiable or learned rewards, including GRPO and PPO.

  • Learning from session histories, searches, clicks, purchases, repeat orders and operator feedback. This includes data selection, credit assignment and reward design that account for exposure bias, delayed outcomes and the difference between observed engagement and incremental business value.

  • Studying how to combine new interactions with historical data, how frequently to update models, when an update is ready for deployment, and how to preserve performance as user behaviour and catalogues change.

  • Building RL environments with simulated users, catalogues and multi-step commerce tasks, including inspecting trajectories, validating rewards and testing whether improvements in simulation transfer to real interactions.

  • Developing reward models and LLM-based graders, calibrating them against expert judgments and observed outcomes, and testing for reward hacking, sycophancy and excessive concentration on popular items.

  • Training decision models for rankings, offers and promotions using contextual bandits or offline RL, with off-policy evaluation to estimate value and uncertainty, identify gaps in the available evidence and inform controlled online experiments.

  • Developing automated experiments that propose and test changes to training methods, prompts, tools or agent control flow, evaluated on held-out tasks and regression tests before acceptance.

Relevant experience includes language-model post-training, reinforcement learning, reward modelling, agent training environments, continual learning, or offline RL and bandits applied to real decisions. The training experience required will depend on the research direction.

Responsibilities across both tracks

  • Define success with portfolio teams and evaluate models against strong baselines, including existing production systems, accounting for inference cost, latency and the business outcome the model is meant to improve.

  • Design reproducible experiments with appropriate ablations, uncertainty estimates and failure analysis, using future-period and held-out evaluations, and test whether offline improvements hold online.

  • Work with data and engineering teams on provenance, permitted use across companies and privacy-aware handling of customer histories.

  • Publish research and contribute models, benchmarks, environments and training methods to open source where the work and data can be shared.

  • Mentor colleagues, review experiment designs and communicate findings clearly enough to support training and deployment decisions.

Minimum qualifications

  • A PhD or equivalent industry research experience in machine learning, computer science, statistics or a related field.

  • At least five years of research or applied science experience in machine learning, including doctoral research, with hands-on experience designing and running model-training experiments. For Track 1, this should include pre-training or mid-training of language models. For Track 2, it should include language-model post-training, or reinforcement learning and decision-model training relevant to the specialisation.

  • Evidence of original research through papers, released models, public benchmarks, open-source projects or significant research contributions to deployed systems.

  • Strong Python and PyTorch skills, with experience implementing experiments and debugging training runs in a shared research codebase. Work on large language models requires hands-on experience with distributed training.

  • Sound experimental judgment, including strong baselines, statistical analysis and the willingness to report negative results.

  • Clear written and verbal communication.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience implementing and debugging training methods in frameworks such as Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, NeMo RL, verl or OpenRLHF, depending on the chosen track.

  • Research in recommender systems, generative retrieval, semantic IDs or user behaviour modelling.

  • Experience with synthetic data, model distillation or compression for production.

  • Experience working with marketplace or commerce data and evaluating changes through online experiments.

What we offer

  • Autonomy to design experiments and make technical decisions within your research direction.

  • Proprietary commerce data, B300 and H200 GPUs for large-scale training, and external models for evaluation and benchmarking.

  • The opportunity to take research from early experiments through publication and deployment, working directly with portfolio teams on products used by millions of people.

  • Colleagues who have released Hugging Face models with more than 100 million downloads, authored papers at NeurIPS, created benchmarks and built multiple production AI systems.

  • An uncapped budget to recruit and mentor research interns for your projects, with access to candidates through our connections with leading universities.

  • Current ML frameworks and unlimited access to coding assistants.

  • A base at our Amsterdam office and AI House, with relocation support. We also consider remote arrangements for candidates with particularly strong experience relevant to the role.

  • Competitive compensation and a top-spec MacBook Pro.

How to apply

If you want to work on these problems, we would like to hear from you. Please indicate the track and research areas that best match your experience, and include examples of work that show your contribution.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

title: (Senior) B2G Manager: Public Sector & Research Funding (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
“This is not your typical B2G role.”

B2G sounds boring, until you realise it's money from the state and you own it. You'll be responsible for a big share of RIZM's funding sources, with real influence on RIZM's cash flow and on how fast we grow. You'll be tapping into new sources that most companies never even look at.

Why this role exists

RIZM builds RIZMO, an AI agent that makes energy decisions for industrial companies. Our next lever is the public sector: municipalities, utilities and economic development agencies have to implement heat plans, keep business parks competitive and relieve the grid. We're looking for someone to own B2G as a business line at RIZM, from public funding all the way to municipalities as paying customers.

What you'll own

  • Public funding as a growth channel. Forschungszulage (Germany's R&D tax allowance), EU grants, ERDF (EFRE) and other programmes: build the pipeline, actively own and track our running programmes, forge consortia and get applications approved.

  • Connect research. Coordinate our research collaboration with Stanford and translate it into funded projects.

  • Build the machine, AI-first. Set up your own systems, tracking and automation, so one person can run a funding pipeline that usually takes a whole team. You decide how the role works behind the scenes.

  • Take over and scale ReNET-EV. Own our part of the ERDF project ReNET-EV (grid-friendly energy supply for business parks in the Münster/NRW region) and roll the model out to more municipalities.

  • Turn municipalities into customers. Win cities, municipal utilities and economic development agencies that use RIZM for heat planning, climate strategy and business park development. Set up offers and procurement routes for the public sector.

  • Orchestrate the ecosystem. Bring chambers of commerce (IHKs), economic development agencies, utilities and industry partners together in joint projects.

  • Build the data foundation. Tap into public and municipal data that makes our models more precise at regional level.

  • Create visibility. References with municipalities and mayors that show publicly what's happening in their region.

  • Leadership. Over time, build a small B2G team, including working students.

You're a fit if you

  • Have several years of experience in the public sector, politics, municipal utilities, economic development agencies, associations or funding management.

  • Have successfully won funding (EU, federal, state) or led consortia.

  • Know how municipalities make decisions and buy, and have a strong network in NRW or beyond.

  • Understand energy transition topics such as municipal heat planning, grid congestion and flexibility.

  • Think like an entrepreneur and see public funding as a path to a business case.

  • Are curious about AI and enjoy building your own tools and workflows.

  • Speak business-fluent German and bring good English for EU programmes.

What we offer

  • A business line you build from scratch, with a direct line to the management team.

  • Real financial leverage: what you win shows up directly in RIZM's cash flow.

  • A product already running at industrial customers like BMW and BSH.

  • Salary plus equity.

How to apply

No cover letter needed. We'd rather hear how you think. Two questions, a few honest sentences each:

  • A mayor gives you 5 minutes in an elevator. What do you tell them about RIZM?

  • What's the most absurd hurdle you've hit in public funding or procurement, and how did you get around it?

Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Your work will directly impact developer experience, platform reliability, and system performance as Vinted continues to scale.

In this position, you’ll

  • Participate in technical design reviews, RFCs, and code reviews, fostering high engineering standards within the team.
  • Help write clear documentation and guidelines to empower engineers across Vinted to adopt golden paths effortlessly.

About you 

  • Strong backend engineering experience with solid system design skills and hands-on experience building scalable services.
  • Practical expertise in designing API contracts, service startup patterns, and performance optimization.
  • Passionate about developer experience, tooling, and enabling other engineers through well-designed software.
  • Ability to evaluate pragmatic technical trade-offs between code maintainability, delivery speed, and technical debt.
  • Communicates technical concepts clearly and collaborates constructively across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Enjoys sharing knowledge, participating in design discussions, and driving continuous technical improvements.

Work perks

  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models

Working at Vinted

title: Senior Cloud Engineer - AWS
descriptionHtml:
Working at CreateFutureCreateFuture is an AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. Our UK Benefits 

  • 35 days leave (including bank holidays).

 View our full list of UK benefits. 

CreateFuture is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

About the role and team:

A hands-on Senior engineer embedded in the client’s platform team, responsible for the reliability, scalability, and evolution of their infrastructure on AWS. The right candidate is comfortable working autonomously in a mature, opinionated stack and can influence without authority across engineering teams. This role combines deep hands-on expertise with team leadership, stakeholder engagement, and delivery planning. The right candidate can operate credibly at an engineering level while also communicating clearly with business and technical stakeholders, translating platform priorities into a coherent roadmap and ensuring the team has the clarity and support needed to deliver effectively.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Design and build reliable AWS platform capabilities, including federated identity.
  • Build and maintain platform infrastructure as code with Terraform, and run containerised workloads on Kubernetes.
  • Assess the current platform and help prioritise the work needed through year-end.
  • Work with the solution architect and technical BAs to turn requirements into implementable, auditable work.
  • Help establish a foundation that can support wider use of the platform in 2027.

What you bring:

  • Strong hands-on AWS cloud engineering and platform design experience.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (ideally Amazon EKS) and infrastructure as code using Terraform, including reusable module design and managing state across multiple environments.
  • Ability to work independently, navigate an unfamiliar estate and make sound technical judgments.
  • Experience with federated identity and complex integrations.
  • Familiarity with Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore.
  • Experience working within regulated environments, including risk, assurance and design controls.
  • Strong operational mindset, with experience owning incident management, on-call frameworks, and post-incident review processes.
  • Proven experience leading a platform or infrastructure engineering team, including mentoring, performance support, and day-to-day team management.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, able to engage confidently with technical and non-technical audiences, translate complexity into clear priorities, and manage competing demands.

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

  • Call with our Talent Acquisition Team 
  • Role specific capability interview 

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

We look forward to your application!

title: Senior Creator Channel Manager (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle

Als Creator Channel Manager (all genders) übernimmst du die Gesamtverantwortung für die strategische Ausrichtung, Weiterentwicklung und Performance des Creator-Kanals. Die Rolle verbindet Strategie, Analyse, Stakeholder-Management und operative Steuerung und geht damit weit über das klassische Influencer-Management hinaus.

Der Creator-Kanal hat sich in den vergangenen Jahren stark weiterentwickelt. Während die operative Creator-Akquise größtenteils über eine Agentur gesteuert wird und die kreative Strategie beim Creative Strategist liegt, wirst Du Dich auf die strategische Kanalsteuerung konzentrieren: von Agenturmanagement und Performance-Optimierung über innovative Vergütungsmodelle bis hin zur Identifikation neuer Wachstumschancen.

Vor allem suchen wir Menschen, die HelloFresh besser machen. Wir lieben vielfältige Erfahrungen und glauben, dass es viele Wege gibt, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln.

Wenn Du also nicht alle Kriterien erfüllst, aber glaubst, in dieser Rolle überzeugen zu können, möchten wir gerne mehr über Dich erfahren.

Dein Aufgabenbereich

  • Verantwortung für die übergeordnete Strategie, Weiterentwicklung und Performance des Creator-Kanals – unter Berücksichtigung der  langfristigen Kanalvision und Wachstums-Roadmap
  • Steuerung von Agenturpartnerschaften und Eskalationsmanagement mit Fokus auf die strategische Ausrichtung, Qualitätssicherung sowie Einhaltung definierter Performance- und Prozessstandards
  • Entwicklung und Optimierung von Incentivierungsstrategien und innovativen Ansätzen wie Virtual Sampling, der Weiterführung von CPA-Modellen und dem Benchmarking von Vergütungsstrukturen
  • Steuerung der Amplification von Influencer-Content in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Paid-Social-Team durch regelmäßige Briefings, Abstimmung der Umsetzung und Performance-Monitoring
  • Koordinierung der PR-Box-Prozesse, Koordination von Stakeholdern sowie Management von Eskalationen mit internen und externen Partnern
  • Bearbeitung technischer Eskalationen im Zusammenhang mit Rabattaktionen, Gratisprodukten und Customer-Service-Fällen
  • Durchführung Performance-Analysen und strategischer Kanaloptimierung, inklusive WBR-/MBR-Reporting (Weekly/Monthly Business Reviews), Identifikation von Performance-Mustern und Ableitung strategischer Empfehlungen
  • Leitung bereichsübergreifender Projekte wie Landingpage-Tests, ISEM-, CPO- und weiterer Wachstumsinitiativen mit Bezug zum Creator-Kanal
  • Förderung der Diversifizierung des Creator-Portfolios über verschiedene Plattformen hinweg, einschließlich Entscheidungen zur Plattformerweiterung (z. B. Reaktivierung von YouTube- und TikTok-Aktivitäten oder Amplification-Initiativen), abhängig von verfügbaren operativen Ressourcen
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Creative Strategist in Form von direkten Briefings bei kanalspezifischen Botschaften und Kommunikationsansätzen
  • Beobachtung und Bewertung von Plattformänderungen, Creator-Trends, Entwicklungen bei iCAC sowie der zunehmenden Überschneidung von Performance- und Brand-Influencer-Marketing

Dein Profil

  • 4–6+ Jahre Erfahrung im Influencer- oder Creator-Marketing mit nachweislicher End-to-End-Verantwortung eines Kanals, vorzugsweise in einem DTC- (Direct-to-Consumer) oder Subscription-Geschäftsmodell innerhalb einer zentralen/lokalen Matrixorganisation
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung und Optimierung von Fixed-Fee- sowie CPA-/Affiliate-Vergütungsmodellen, ein tiefes Verständnis der wirtschaftlichen Unterschiede und der optimalen Einsatzlogik der jeweiligen Modelle
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Daten inklusive der Fähigkeit, Kennzahlen wie CAC, CTR, CVR, ROI und LTV zu analysieren, interpretieren und daraus strategische Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten
  • Sicherheit in der Steuerung von Agenturen, von der Definition strategischer Vorgaben über die Sicherstellung von Qualitätsstandards bis zum Performance-Monitoring 
  • Tiefgehendes Verständnis für die Creator-Landschaft im DACH-Raum (Deutschland, Österreich und Schweiz) einschließlich relevanter Plattformen, Creator-Segmente und Zielgruppendynamiken
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, insbesondere zur Bewertung von Content-Qualität, Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen Partnern und zum Verständnis kultureller Nuancen im Markt
  • Idealerweise erste Berührungspunkte mit der Paid-Social-Amplification von Creator-Content (Meta, TikTok), im Management von YouTube-Kanälen und Verständnis für Performance-Creative-Briefings

Das bieten wir Dir

Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.

We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.

With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.

The Role

As a Senior CRM Manager, you will be helping lead the strategic planning, design, and execution of our customer communications programme across all outbound channels and brands, spanning conversion, retention, and reactivation.

You will own the performance and optimisation of parts of the CRM programme, ensuring it delivers against business objectives while remaining customer-centric and protecting the health of our channels and growing database.

Leading a small team, you will have the scope and support to significantly enhance the impact and effectiveness of CRM across your business area. You will take a data-first approach - reviewing performance daily, identifying optimisation opportunities, and driving both incremental improvements and innovative strategic initiatives to improve engagement and results.

With multiple brands, verticals, and markets, sophisticated use of data and dynamic content is critical. We are therefore looking for a technically strong marketer with hands-on experience in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC). You should be comfortable working with HTML emails, advanced segmentation and suppression logic, and have experience launching new brands, including IP warm-ups. Experience within a multi-brand, multi-channel orchestration (Push, WhatsApp, SMS, Email) is highly desirable.

At this level, we expect you to be the subject matter expert—passionate about customer centricity, committed to developing your team, and technically capable of delivering excellence.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage a team.

  • Develop and execute multichannel CRM campaigns (email, SMS, push notifications, in-app messaging), ensuring relevance and performance.

  • Oversee the full customer lifecycle, driving optimisation across acquisition, retention, and reactivation.

  • Use data and reporting to inform both strategic direction and tactical improvements.

  • Collaborate with marketing, product, affiliate, and other cross-functional teams to deliver projects aligned with business objectives.

  • Support growth across new verticals, markets, and the locale.

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory and licensing requirements across all regions.

  • Act as the voice of the customer within the organisation.

  • Ensure a customer centric app / mobile first approach

 

About You:

  • Able to manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly in a busy, deadline-driven environment.

We’re Appinio - the real-time market research partner that supports global (and local) brands to make better consumer-facing decisions. Driven by our mission to deliver rigorous, rapid research in a refreshingly human way, we give businesses real answers from real people in minutes, not weeks.

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you will own and elevate a portfolio of clients and act as a strategic, trusted advisor, helping them to effectively use customer insights to achieve their business goals and drive significant ROI.

descriptionHtml:
hellomed ist die führende digitale Pflege-Apotheke für Pflegeunternehmen – nach dem Motto: Dauermedikation nur in einfach!

Unsere Vision ist es, bis 2030 die jährlichen 250.000 Krankenhauseinweisungen aufgrund von Medikationsfehlern und die damit verbundenen 1,2 Milliarden Euro Folgekosten zu vermeiden und der Pflege wieder zurückzugeben.

Mit unserer innovativen hellomedOS-Software entlasten wir Pflegekräfte bei der täglichen Medikationsversorgung ihrer Patienten und machen diese noch sicherer. Unser revolutionäres Konzept bringen wir mit einem bunten Team aus Apothekern, Pflegeexperten und Entwicklern auf die Straße – namhafte Investoren sind bereits mit an Bord und Pflegekräfte deutschlandweit lieben das Produkt.

Für unsere größeren Kunden – Pflegedienstketten, Heime und Träger mit mehreren Standorten – suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die diese Partnerschaften betreut, ausbaut und unsere Kundenbetreuung mit uns gemeinsam weiterentwickelt.

Aufgaben

  • Größere Kunden betreuen: Du betreust unsere größeren Kunden wie Pflegedienstketten, Heime und Träger – von der Einführung bis zur langfristigen Zusammenarbeit. Du bist feste Ansprechperson für Geschäftsführungen, Regional- und Pflegedienstleitungen und führst mit ihnen regelmäßige Gespräche: Was läuft gut, wo gibt es Potenzial, was braucht der Kunde als Nächstes?

  • Nutzung steigern: Du sorgst dafür, dass an den Standorten deiner Kunden möglichst alle Patienten über hellomed versorgt werden, und schulst Pflegeteams und Leitungen im sicheren Umgang mit hellomedOS – vor Ort und digital.

  • Kundenbeziehungen ausbauen: Du erkennst, wo wir bei bestehenden Kunden weitere Standorte versorgen können, und setzt das gemeinsam mit unserem Vertrieb um. So machst du deine Kundenbeziehungen wirtschaftlich erfolgreicher: mehr Standorte und Patienten pro Kunde, weniger Kündigungen.

  • Kundenbetreuung mitgestalten: Gemeinsam mit den Gründern entwickelst du unsere Abläufe in der Kundenbetreuung weiter und gibst deine Erfahrung an Kollegen im Team weiter.

  • Perspektive: Mit wachsendem Team und deinem Erfolg bei unseren Kunden kannst du perspektivisch die Verantwortung für unsere gesamte Customer-Success-Funktion übernehmen.

Qualifikation

  • Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der Betreuung oder im Ausbau von Geschäftskunden mit, zum Beispiel als Key Account Manager, Kundenbetreuer oder im Vertrieb, idealerweise im Gesundheitswesen. Alternativ hast du Leitungserfahrung in der Pflege (z. B. als Pflegedienst-, Einrichtungs- oder Regionalleitung) und Freude an Kundenkontakt und Wachstum.

  • Erfahrung mit größeren Kunden: Du hast bereits Kunden mit mehreren Standorten betreut und trittst gegenüber Geschäftsführungen sicher und überzeugend auf.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du erklärst komplexe Sachverhalte klar und verständlich und baust schnell Vertrauen auf – bei Pflegekräften ebenso wie bei Geschäftsführern.

  • Sprache: Du kommunizierst sicher und souverän auf Deutsch (mind. C1) – im Pflegealltag unserer Kunden ist das der Schlüssel zu Vertrauen.

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest zuverlässig und organisiert, behältst auch bei mehreren Kunden mit vielen Standorten den Überblick und hast ein gutes Gespür für Zahlen.

  • Technische Offenheit: Du arbeitest sicher mit digitalen Anwendungen. Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System oder Pflegesoftware ist von Vorteil.

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du besuchst unsere Kunden regelmäßig vor Ort (max. 1/3 der Arbeitszeit).

  • Haltung statt Lebenslauf: Startup-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung – entscheidend sind deine Erfahrung und dein Anspruch an gute Kundenbetreuung.

Benefits

  • Du profitierst von einer überdurchschnittlichen Bezahlung mit attraktiver Bonuskomponente, die sich am Wachstum deiner Kundenbeziehungen orientiert.

title: Senior Data Insights Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

Do you have strong data and analytical skills, with a passion for shaping business strategy? Can you architect, build, and apply modern data models to deliver impactful marketing insights? Are you seeking an exciting role with significant opportunities for leadership and growth? Then you might be the Senior Data Insights Consultant we are looking for! 

What will your day look like? 

As our new Senior Data Insights Consultant, you will join our growing Technology and Data team. Here, you will be a key leader in helping our clients make data-driven decisions to enhance their digital communication on an enterprise scale. This entails designing, enabling, and delivering complex data solutions and integrations for various campaign platforms. More specifically, your tasks will include: 

  • Architecting, building, and delivering value-adding insights solutions, serving as a key advisor to clients on how to leverage their data assets to optimize large-scale communication strategies. 
  • Performing advanced analysis to uncover actionable patterns, trends, and opportunities that directly inform client strategy and decision-making. 
  • Designing and running test-and-learn programs (A/B tests, incrementality, holdouts) across channels to measure impact and continuously optimize communication performance. 
  • Partnering with senior stakeholders to define strategic business questions and translating them into robust analytical frameworks and data roadmaps. 
  • Supporting or leading the data-stream on complex, large-scale projects with globally recognised brands, ensuring that data solutions and integrations are designed and delivered for scalability and business impact. 
  • Driving ongoing proactive client ideation — identifying new opportunities, use cases, and data-driven initiatives that help clients grow their business. 
  • Helping drive agentic AI adoption, exploring and embedding agentic solutions into our data and insights workflows to enhance efficiency and client value. 
  • Providing answers and insights to business-related questions via automated reporting solutions as well as ad-hoc data analyses, including building reports and insights dashboards within marketing platforms such as Adobe and Salesforce. 
  • Mentoring, reviewing, and advising less senior team members — elevating quality, fostering technical excellence, and supporting their professional growth. 
  • Collaborating with highly skilled specialists including Account Managers, Architects, Developers, Creatives, Strategists, Data Scientists and Marketing Operations experts to service our clients coherently. 

Who are you going to work with? 

You will join a team of hands-on Data Insights Consultants, Data Scientists and Data Engineers who are passionate about bringing value and knowledge from data. We are all about unlocking insights from data through analytics and making that insight applicable in 1:1 data-driven communication and CRM. Your work will always be firmly anchored in data in a cross-disciplinary setting, collaborating closely with highly enthusiastic experts from Strategy or Creative backgrounds. 

What do you bring to the table? 

As a person, you possess a strong consultancy mindset, demonstrating resilience, curiosity, and an eager-to-learn attitude. You combine this with strong business acumen, allowing you to understand and anticipate client needs effectively. You are outgoing and love being part of interdisciplinary projects and solutions. You are eager to learn and quick to understand the complexity of high-tech dialogues and solutions. 

Furthermore, you have the drive, enthusiasm, and technical credibility to act as the primary data and insights advisor for senior client leadership, guiding them through complex challenges and inspiring them to grow their business. It's an advantage if you have consulting, agency experience or marketing domain knowledge, but it's not a requirement. 

In addition, you have: 

Technical skills 

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in a consultant/business liaison role related to data, BI, analytics or reporting solutions. Can independently design, build, and optimize modern analytics solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and ready for real-world production use. 
  • Write, debug, and optimize complex SQL queries, ensuring clarity, efficiency, and production readiness. 
  • Design and build scalable dimensional data models from raw source systems (fact/dimension structures, performance-aware design). Apply strong data modelling principles, governance standards and practices that ensure data accuracy, consistency, and security. 
  • Develop and manage DBT transformations using layered architecture, including testing and documentation best practices. 
  • Build production-ready Power BI semantic models and dashboards, including advanced DAX measures, performance optimization, and secure data access (RLS). 
  • Work collaboratively using GitHub, following structured branching, pull request, and code review workflows. 
  • Familiarity with or a strong interest in the application of AI and agentic frameworks, and machine learning principles to generate conversational analytics, predictive and advanced marketing insights. 
  • Comfortable working in modern cloud data environments (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Fabric). 
  • Understanding the data structures and reporting capabilities within major marketing and martech platforms (e.g., Adobe Campaign/AJO, Salesforce Marketing Cloud). Ability to build and deliver reports and insights dashboards natively within these tools is a strong advantage 

Interpersonal skills 

  • Technical stakeholder management and influence: A proven ability to build trust and act as a strategic partner to senior-level clients and internal leaders. You can confidently navigate complex, technical stakeholder environments and influence decision-making through data-driven reasoning. 
  • Communication and storytelling: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate complex data concepts and insights into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and senior business audiences. 
  • Consultative and solutions-oriented mindset: The ability to critically assess complex business challenges, ask probing questions to uncover root causes, and propose robust, data-driven solutions. 
  • Leadership and mentorship: Proven experience in coaching and mentoring junior team members. You actively foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning within the team. 
  • Autonomy and critical thinking: You are a self-starter who can think critically, identify issues and opportunities autonomously, and take the initiative to propose and implement corrective actions. 

A leader in personalized customer experiences 

VML MAP is a world-leading Centre of Excellence that helps businesses humanize the relationship between the brand and the customer through hyper personalization at scale, marketing automation and CRM. With the brain of a consultancy, the heart of an agency and the power of technology and data, we work with some of the world's most admired brands to help them on their transformation journey to becoming truly customer-centric. Together, we are 1000+ technology specialists, data scientists, strategic thinkers, consultants, operations experts, and creative minds from 55+ nationalities. 

A global network 

We are part of the global VML network that encompasses more than 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 60+ markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

title: Senior Decision Scientist, Marketplace
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Delivery companies have always bought capacity by guesswork. Book too few drivers and parcels wait; book too many and you pay for empty vans. Most carriers accept that waste as the price of being reliable. Relay is building a marketplace where it isn't. You can't schedule drivers. You can only design what's on offer, and measure what happens.

Every part of our network runs on decisions. The next two years are about building the systems that make them well, and proving they do. Engineering and operational research build what you design.

Marketplace Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what Marketplace changes on booking, matching and shifts, and recommend on pay. Our scientists' models and experiments feed your calls, and the squad lead acts on them.

  • Drivers choose when to work. What makes a shift worth booking early, and how do you prove what works when a clean experiment isn't possible?

  • Every booked shift is paid, used or not, and every unserved route means late parcels. Where should each area sit between the two, and what would let the network get there on its own?

  • Local shops hold our parcels while running their own businesses. Where does the network need more of them, what should a shop be paid, and how would you see a closed shop coming?

  • A whole area, not a slice: no playbook, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Decision Scientist, Marketplace at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Marketplace problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Marketplace decides: which signals count, and what good looks like for booking, matching and pay.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, Marketplace's booking and pay decisions run on a system you designed.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned the decisions a matching, pricing or incentive model fed, in a two-sided marketplace or gig platform, rather than building the model itself.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

  • Can trace why drivers or couriers stop booking or cancel, and can read the experiments behind a pricing or incentive change, including when a clean test isn't possible.

  • Have been through real change, such as a pivot, fast growth or a new market, and rebuilt something because of it.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and happy to build their own analysis apps, monitors and alerts.

  • Would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter, en aan die kennis bouwen we bij Lefebvre Sdu al 200 jaar. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Dat doen we zo zorgvuldig dat andere legal AI-tools op onze data en software draaien. Vanuit ons Nederlandse kantoor bouwen we daarnaast voor Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, dat in Europa inmiddels goed is voor meer dan 100 miljoen euro ARR. Ruim 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, en we bouwen het op de standaard die hun vak vraagt. We zoeken een Senior DevOps Engineer die zorgt dat alles wat we bouwen veilig en soepel live gaat.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT

GenIA-L schuift steeds verder het dagelijkse werk van juristen en fiscalisten in, en dat vraagt om een platform dat soepel meebeweegt. Onze developers willen snel bouwen en veilig live gaan, zonder uren kwijt te zijn aan pipelines en repository-setup. Daar zorg jij voor. Onze infrastructuur draait op AWS, met Kubernetes via EKS, Terraform en Helm, en onze CI/CD loopt via GitHub Actions. In die pipelines borg jij bij elke release de secure coding-eisen van ISO 27001, van SAST en security scanning tot code quality checks en de OWASP Top 10. Nu ligt DevOps nog bij een extern team van 4 engineers. Binnen een jaar willen we die kennis volledig zelf in huis hebben, en daarin speel jij een hoofdrol. Je wordt het eerste aanspreekpunt voor de developers in Product & Technology, brengt structuur in hoe het team werkt en bouwt mee aan de volgende stappen, zoals de overstap van Helm naar ArgoCD. Je weet dat het gelukt is als de andere teams merkbaar minder tijd kwijt zijn aan hun deployments, de infrastructuur gezond is en je precies ziet wat er gebeurt. En als DevOps voelt als een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van Product & Technology. De stack staat en de ambitie is helder. Wat nu nog ontbreekt, is het team dat dit zelf gaat dragen, en dat bouw jij mee op.


DIT ZOEKEN WIJ

Je bent een DevOps engineer die het liefst dicht bij de developers zit. Je bouwt een platform waar anderen zelf mee verder kunnen, vindt het vanzelfsprekend dat security in elke pipeline is ingebouwd en brengt graag rust en overzicht in een omgeving die in beweging is.
Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met Kubernetes, idealiter met AWS EKS.

  • Je hebt veel gewerkt met AWS en Infrastructure as Code.

  • CI/CD en containers zijn een vertrouwd onderdeel van je werk.

  • Je zorgt voor duidelijkheid in technische processen en afspraken.

  • Ervaring met het bouwen en doorontwikkelen van een softwareproduct is een pré.

HIER TEKEN JE VOOR

Je rapporteert aan onze Lead Backend Engineer en bent de vaste sparringpartner van de developers in Product & Technology. Je krijgt veel vertrouwen, eigenaarschap en vrijheid, dus zie je iets wat beter moet, dan pak je het hier meestal gewoon zelf op. Daarbij is er ruimte voor een goede balans tussen werk en privé. Onze doorgroeipaden zijn nog in ontwikkeling, en omdat we tracks verwachten richting lead DevOps, principal engineering en engineering management, ben jij er vroeg bij.

  • Goed basissalaris en een standaard werkweek van 36 uur.

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 4% van jouw bruto jaarsalaris en een variabele winstdeling die kan oplopen tot 6% van jouw bruto jaarsalaris.

  • 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar voor bijvoorbeeld extra vakantiedagen.

  • Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering.

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer of een OV-vergoeding, en we bieden een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor medewerkers met een reisafstand van minder dan 10 km of meer dan 60 km hebben we een aangepaste regeling.

  • Hybride werken: 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag, op dinsdag en donderdag.

  • Ruimte om te groeien. In je vak, in je rol, in de organisatie.

MEER WETEN?
Wij vertellen je graag alles over het team en de rol. Stuur jouw cv en je hoort binnen 2 werkdagen van ons. Eerst nog wat vragen? App of bel Nadine op 0628556265.
