title: Senior Director, International Development
descriptionHtml:
Thank you for considering Oklo. We are hiring a Senior Director, International Affairs to join our Strategy team.

Position Description

Oklo is seeking a Senior Director of International Affairs to develop international opportunities that can materially advance the company's long-term strategy. This role connects market choices, senior relationships, sovereign and government capital, industrial partnerships, and selected cross-border initiatives.

You will help determine where Oklo should engage, which institutions matter, and what a credible partnership or investment proposition should look like. The scope extends across the company's businesses and strategic priorities, rather than being limited to individual international reactor deployment projects.

You will report to the Chief of Strategy Officer and work directly with the CSO on assigned initiatives. You will coordinate closely with the CFO organization, Government Affairs, Legal, technical and regulatory leaders, and business-unit teams, with explicit agreement on market coverage, counterpart relationships, and execution responsibilities.

This person must reside in either the United Kingdom or the Netherlands. 

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Target markets and partnerships. Develop recommendations on priority markets, institutions, and opportunities based on strategic fit, partner capabilities, commercial demand, capital availability, timing, and risk.
  • Sovereign and institutional relationships. Build and advance relationships with sovereign investors, government institutions, industrial partners, and other organizations relevant to Oklo's global strategy.
  • Structure international opportunities. Develop business cases and proposed structures for international partnerships, sovereign or government-capital opportunities, joint ventures, and other cross-border initiatives.
  • Advance transactions. Work with Finance, Business Development, Corporate Development, Strategic Partnerships, and Legal to test economics, assess counterparties, develop terms, and advance approved opportunities toward executable agreements.
  • Navigate regulatory and policy dependencies. Coordinate with Government Affairs and technical, regulatory, and legal specialists on political, policy, licensing, export, and other dependencies that affect an opportunity's feasibility.
  • Lead initiative execution. Lead assigned initiatives across internal teams and outside advisers, maintaining clear objectives, owners, milestones, and decisions through launch or handoff.
  • Prepare and represent leadership. Prepare senior leadership for important international engagements and represent Oklo when delegated; work with the Strategy Associate on research, analysis, and materials and the Strategy Manager on coordinated follow-through.
  • Align cross-functional stakeholders. Align engagement plans with existing international and business-unit owners, avoid conflicting commitments, and recommend where to advance, defer, or decline an opportunity.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Experience in international business, strategic investing, government, industrial partnerships, or a related field, with evidence of delivering outcomes across institutions and jurisdictions.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop substantive relationships with senior government, commercial, or financial counterparties and translate engagement into concrete opportunities
  • Strong commercial and financial judgment, including the ability to evaluate partnership economics, business cases, and potential capital structures.
  • Experience leading cross-functional work while drawing on appropriate technical, legal, policy, and financial expertise.
  • Excellent writing and cross-cultural communication, sound discretion, and the ability to make practical recommendations from incomplete information.
  • Must reside in the UK or the Netherlands.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience with sovereign investors, development finance, government-backed capital, or cross-border industrial ventures.
  • Exposure to nuclear energy, the fuel cycle, infrastructure, advanced technology, or other strategically important industries.
  • Experience connecting government and commercial objectives; relevant regional expertise or additional language capabilities.

Competencies

We are looking for a Senior Director, International Affairs that is:

  • Able to connect geopolitical and institutional context to specific commercial choices
  • Able to build durable trust while maintaining clear objectives and realistic commitments
  • Able to work effectively across cultures, disciplines, and organizations with different incentives
  • Can distinguish meaningful strategic progress from access, visibility, or meeting volume
  • Passionate about clean energy 
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Highly strategic and a forward-looking thinker
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with comfort operating in ambiguity
  • An exceptional communicator, negotiator, and has relationship-building skills
  • Contains a strong executive presence and cross-functional leadership ability
  • Aware of global perspectives with awareness of geopolitical and macroeconomic trends
  • Passionate for building transformational infrastructure businesses
  • Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways 
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before 
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • An excellent writer who can write in modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
  • Able to communicate technical content and results verbally 

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

You'll be assessed by/ join an English speaking team- please submit your application in English

🐙 Kraken Generation Flex

The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In Germany, home to the largest electricity market in Europe and a roadmap toward Net Zero by 2045, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.

Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. We are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As we expand our footprint in Germany and the wider European market, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to lead our regional technical market-access and integration efforts.

🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and customer growth in Germany, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to work with stakeholders to develop our DSR (Demand Side Response) and flexibility pipeline.

You will be bringing your regional technical expertise to aid the development of our asset integration technologies. The role is highly cross-functional: you'll bridge our software and hardware capabilities with the rigorous requirements of the four German Transmission System Operators (TSOs) and 900+ Distribution System Operators (DSOs).

The detailed Gateway (Kraken’s IoT Edge Hardware&Software) configuration and protocol engineering is owned by our UK-based team, whom you will feed with regional knowledge and design input, and who will support you on the technical aspects of how Kraken integrations work. You will own the regional relationship, the integration approach, and the design that the UK team then implements. The role may require you to attend customer calls, as well as calls with the TSO and DSOs to technically explain/defend our strategy.

You will join a team, based in Manchester, that is innovative and engineering-focused, with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Market Access & Prequalification: Drive the technical approach for connecting assets — mainly BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar) into German ancillary-service markets (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) and Redispatch 3.0. Support prequalification (Präqualifikation) with the relevant TSO and ensure our telemetry and control approach satisfies TSO-specific and BNetzA requirements for market participation. (Grid-code and plant-compliance obligations such as VDE-AR-N 4110/4120 remain with the plant/PPC; your focus is enabling market access, telemetry, and dispatch.)

  • Integration Technology (your core deliverable): Carry out research, engage technical stakeholders and engineers to design our established integration approaches for various asset types such as BESS, Wind, Solar, CHP and more. This can cover both new projects and retrofits.

  • Regional Technical Expertise: Be the regional authority who feeds and supports the UK team with knowledge of German hardware requirements, industrial protocols, connectivity, cyber-security expectations, and TSO/DSO and ancillary-service requirements. Help evaluate hardware and connectivity solutions for regional fit.

  • Stakeholder Liaison: Act as the technical point of contact for TSOs, DSOs, customers, and internal commercial teams to resolve connection, onboarding, or operational issues.

  • Hardware & On-site Support (occasional): Hardware is deployed remotely in most cases via O&Ms and third parties. However, occasional regional support and hands-on intervention may be required before or after a deployment, including some hardware handling and on-site engineering. You’ll ideally be based close to Kraken’s Berlin office and the role requires the ability to travel when needed, though this is kept to a minimum.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • Language: Native or professional fluency in German and English, essential for technical documentation and TSO/regulator communication.

  • Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration).

  • Integration & connectivity: Proven experience establishing industrial communication and connectivity between field equipment and external systems (telemetry and/or control).

  • Power-plant systems: Working understanding of power-plant control systems and instrumentation, including metering.

  • German market knowledge:

    • TSO/DSO hierarchy and the connection/integration process.

    • Ancillary services (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) prequalification and technical requirements.

    • Redispatch 3.0 regulatory framework.

  • Customer-facing delivery: Ability to produce technical integration approaches and communicate them to customers, regulators, and internal teams.

  • Travel: Occasional travel may be required.

  • A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment, comfortable navigating the complexity of a multi-TSO, decentralised grid, and comfortable being the regional face of a technical function whose deep build sits with a partner team in the UK.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Knowledge of industrial communication protocols: IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25 (wind), OPC-UA, Modbus, or similar IEC protocols.

  • Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (NIS2, EnWG/KRITIS awareness; IEC 62443 a plus).

  • Familiarity with CLI tools for configuring, diagnosing, and maintaining hardware or network connections in remote, Linux-based environments.

  • Familiarity with software languages, version-controlled configuration, and general tooling.

  • Exposure to the wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks beyond Germany.

title: (Senior) Electrical Systems Engineer – Power, Harness Design & EMC (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

As our (Senior) Electrical Systems Engineer (m/f/d), you own the electrical backbone of our robots, from industrial manipulators to our bimanual platform Alfie.

In this key role, you are responsible for the complete electrical system of a robot, not one section of it. You define the power, grounding and shielding concepts, engineer the wire harnesses through moving joints, and take them from first prototype to series supply. If you come from automotive Bordnetz development, you will find familiar work at a very different pace: concepts turn into running prototypes within weeks, and your decisions go straight into products at our customers.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the electrical system architecture of our robots: power distribution concept, load distribution, fusing (Absicherung), wire cross-section sizing and data signal integrity.

  • Define grounding/earthing and shielding concepts (Versorgungs- und Massekonzepte) and design for EMC from the first concept onwards.

  • Plan and support EMC pre-compliance and certification testing, analyse findings and implement robust fixes.

  • Specify wire harnesses, connectors, contacts and cables, and create wiring diagrams (Kabelschaltpläne), harness drawings and BOMs that suppliers can produce from directly.

  • Route harnesses through rotating joints and moving axes: select flex- and torsion-rated cables and drive cable life tests together with mechanical engineering.

  • Work closely with our electronics team on interfaces, connectors, power distribution boards and safety circuits.

  • Take harnesses from first prototype to series: supplier selection, first samples, change management, incoming inspection and quality standards. Use your expertise to inform and provide feedback on assembly procedures, build initial samples and support production engineers with new assembly procedures.

  • Work hand in hand with our prototyping technicians, who build your designs, and turn their feedback into better harnesses.

  • Support bring-up, integration and root-cause analysis of electrical issues in prototypes and in the field.

  • Set up our standards and processes for electrical systems engineering, including the choice of E-CAD tooling.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, vehicle electronics or a comparable field.

  • 3+ years of experience in Bordnetz or wire harness development, e.g., in automotive, commercial vehicles, rail, aerospace or machine building. Robotics experience is not required.

  • Proven hands-on experience with grounding, shielding and EMC design, ideally including EMC testing.

  • Solid knowledge of connectors, contacts, cable types, wire sizing and fusing, and confidence creating wiring diagrams and harness drawings.

  • Experience with cables in moving applications (e.g., doors, seats, drag chains or robot joints) is a plus.

  • Experience with an E-CAD tool such as E3.series, Capital, LDorado or SOLIDWORKS Electrical.

  • Experience taking harnesses into series with external suppliers, including change management.

  • A strong ownership mindset and the drive to build up a discipline in a fast-growing company.

  • Language skills: either fluent German plus solid working English, or excellent English (no German required)

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

descriptionHtml:

Your main mission is to design, integrate and optimize the embedded software systems that allow our robots to interact with their environment in real time ensuring a seamless connection between artificial intelligence and hardware.

This role requires a balance between system-level vision (architecture, software design, optimization) and hands-on pragmatism (real-time OS, sensor integration, low-level drivers, field testing). You will be at the core of the transition between research code and production-grade implementation on real machines.

Responsibilities

  • Sensor integration: integrate and calibrate a wide range of sensors (cameras, IMUs, etc.), ensuring software reliability under industrial conditions.

  • Low-level drivers & interfacing: develop and maintain the necessary drivers to interface with ROS2-based code, managing communication over standard buses (CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, etc.).

  • Real-time architecture & optimization: contribute to software architecture, optimize latency, CPU/GPU process allocation, and overall system robustness.

  • AI collaboration: work closely with AI engineers to connect perception, decision, and supervision models to the robot’s low-level control layers.

  • System integration: coordinate with hardware and mechatronics teams to validate the complete robot in real-world environments.

  • Field testing & continuous improvement: participate in prototype testing campaigns, collect feedback, identify anomalies, and propose corrective or improvement actions.

Profile

  • Proven experience in embedded development, software architecture design, and deployment on real systems. Ability to technically mentor juniors.

  • Significant experience in deeptech start-ups or innovative robotics projects appreciated.

  • Strong focus on code quality, yet pragmatic and hands-on.

  • Team spirit, technological curiosity, and motivation to tackle concrete challenges.

Skills

  • Excellent command of C/C++ and good knowledge of Python (scripts, tests, tools).

  • Practical experience in embedded Linux and real-time constraints.

  • Good understanding of communication protocols (CAN bus, SPI, I2C, UART).

  • Skills in performance optimization and real-time systems.

  • Experience in sensor integration and calibration (vision, lidar, inertial).

  • Knowledge of mobile robotics and ROS/ROS2 (major asset).

  • Experience in safety and robustness of embedded systems would be a plus.

  • Tests terrain & amélioration continue : participer aux campagnes de tests sur prototypes, collecter les feedbacks, identifier les anomalies et proposer des solutions.

Profil recherché

  • Formation ingénieur ou expérience équivalente (informatique, électronique, robotique).

title: Senior Flight Dynamics Integration Engineer (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.
ABOUT THE TEAM

You will join our Open Source Aero Simulation team, dedicated to building and scaling next-generation autonomous flight systems. We focus on developing, validating, and implementing end-to-end aerodynamic and flight dynamics workflows built primarily on open-source tools and simulation frameworks. By integrating cutting-edge AI agents with open-source platforms, we accelerate rapid prototyping, multidisciplinary design optimization, and mission-critical aircraft analysis. We operate in an agile, hands-on environment where open engineering and cross-disciplinary innovation drive everything we build.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior AI & Flight Dynamics Integration Engineer, you will own and develop an AI-driven autonomous aircraft design and optimization workflow at STARK. You will integrate LLMs and AI agents with aerodynamics, CFD, flight dynamics, and multidisciplinary simulation tools to accelerate rapid prototyping and aircraft development. Your mission is to automate complex engineering decision-making loops and deliver highly performant, software-defined flight platforms.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Develop LLM and AI Agent-based engineering workflows to interpret aircraft requirements and support iterative design decisions.

  • Automate parametric aircraft geometry using OpenVSP, Python, and STEP-based CAD workflows.

  • Integrate Flow5 (VLM / Panel Methods) and OpenFOAM CFD to build aerodynamic databases including C_L, C_D, C_m, C_p, and stability derivatives.

  • Develop 6-DoF flight dynamics and flight mechanics models, including trim, stability, control authority, propulsion, and aircraft performance calculations.

  • Integrate aircraft KPIs such as take-off/landing speed and distance, range, endurance, rate of climb, and efficiency into an automated optimization loop.

  • Drive multidisciplinary design optimization (MDO) frameworks to rapidly evaluate aircraft trade-offs.

  • Collaborate with systems and software teams to validate dynamic models against simulation and flight test data.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant professional experience in engineering automation, aerodynamics, or flight systems.

  • Strong background in Flight Dynamics, Aerodynamics, and Stability & Control.

  • Demonstrated experience with Python and engineering workflow automation.

  • Hands-on experience with OpenFOAM, VLM/Panel methods, or OpenMDAO.

  • Degree in Aerospace, Aeronautical, Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Direct knowledge and experience with OpenVSP and Flow5.

  • Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs, AI Agents, and modern MDO tools.

  • Experience in unmanned aerial systems (UAS) or rapid-prototyping defence environments.

title: Senior Growth Marketer, Web & Experimentation
descriptionHtml:
Our Growth Marketers bring buyers to datasnipper.com through integrated campaigns. You'll turn that traffic into demo requests and pipeline. You'll run A/B tests, personalize the site, work on conversion rate optimization (CRO), and manage the projects that add new functionality to our websites. You'll also bring AI into the website program, building on the AI that already runs our go-to-market.

You'll work from one ranked backlog and report each week on what moved conversion. You'll form hypotheses from data, get them built with our designer and developer, and roll out the winners.

Your closest partners are the Growth Marketers, our Senior Web Experience Designer and Senior Web Developer, and GTM Engineering, which collects intent data from our website.

About DataSnipper

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers.

Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

Alwin has just launched, demand is growing, and we're expanding into new markets and segments. With a product customers already rely on, there's a huge opportunity to make your mark.

Where the website stands today

Most of our inbound pipeline starts on datasnipper.com. Until now, our Senior Growth Marketer handled CRO on the side, and many people on the Marketing team publish pages, update content individually. In short, very fragmented collaboration.

In an AI-dense market, that work counts for more. Anyone can generate volume now. What's hard, and what earns attention, is staying close to what our customers care about and bringing campaign ideas sharp enough to cut through. That's the work that sets this team apart, and what you'll be part of.

Our tracking needs a cleanup before we can trust test results. Localized landing pages come next: Japan, DACH and France need web experiences in their own language. GTM Engineering already scores visitor intent by page, and we barely use that data on the site. Personalization by segment and market has barely started.

AI already runs parts of our go-to-market. Agents nurture leads, a classifier scores the intent behind every web visit, and we enrich accounts automatically. The website hasn't caught up.

Buyers also find us in new ways. More of them research software through ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews before they ever reach our site.

The web team has a dedicated designer and developer. This role decides what we test next and reports what worked.

What you'll be doing

Run the experimentation program

  • Build the testing roadmap for datasnipper.com and the localized sites, from hypothesis to rollout.

  • Set the website's testing rules: minimum sample size, test duration, and when to call or stop a test.

  • Keep a learning log that Growth, Sales and Product Marketing check before they propose a test.

  • Report results in pipeline terms: demo requests, demo-to-SQL rate and pipeline per session.

Improve conversion where buyers decide

  • Optimize the demo request flow and the pricing, product and campaign pages.

  • Map the funnel from first visit to SQL in GA4 and HubSpot, find where buyers drop off, and fix it.

  • Work with the Growth Marketers to match each campaign landing page to its ad, audience and market.

Personalize the site

  • Tailor content, proof points and CTAs by vertical, market and buying stage.

  • Use intent and enrichment data from GTM Engineering to decide who sees what.

  • Test each localized site as it launches, to the same standard as the English site.

Build AI into the web program

  • Use the intent and enrichment data we already collect to build pages that adapt to each visitor.

  • Use AI to generate and localize test variants, so we test more ideas each month.

  • Automate test QA, result analysis and weekly reporting, with a person signing off on the results.

  • Prototype new AI experiences for buyers, such as an assistant that answers product and pricing questions.

Manage web projects

  • Scope new website functionality, write the brief, and run delivery with our designer and developer.

  • Turn requests from Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships and Growth into a ranked backlog, and use data to decide what waits.

  • Run QA and launch, then measure each project's result.

Keep the site findable and measurable

  • Protect organic search and AI visibility in every test and launch: canonicals, page speed, schema markup and crawl access.

  • Track traffic and demo requests referred by AI assistants, and test pages for buyers who arrive that way.

  • Maintain website tracking with Marketing Operations in Google Tag Manager, GA4 and HubSpot.

  • Build the weekly web performance view the team works from.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years in CRO, web optimization or growth marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS. You've run an A/B testing program and can walk us through tests that won and tests that lost.

  • Data fluency. You know when to trust a test result, and when sample size, novelty or segment noise undermine it. You pull your own numbers from GA4 and HubSpot.

  • Structure. You run a backlog, write briefs a developer can build from, and keep several projects moving. You tell stakeholders each week what ships.

  • Collaboration. You get work done through a designer, a developer and stakeholders who all want space on the website. You involve them before you set a hypothesis, and use data to settle priority disputes.

  • AI builder. You’ve shipped something with AI that changed how a team works: an agent, an automated workflow, or a tool other people use. Bring the example and what broke first.

  • Commercial focus. You judge tests on the pipeline they create.

Tools you'll work with (willingness to ramp & learn matters more than a complete checklist):

  • Creative: Figma, Canva

  • Website: Framer, Contentstack

  • Analytics: HubSpot, Looker Studio, Supermetrics, Fibbler, Snowflake

  • CRM and marketing automation: HubSpot

  • Experimentation and personalization: Optimizely

  • Behavior analytics: heatmaps and session recordings

  • Project management and handoff: Linear, Figma

  • AI: Claude Enterprise (Projects, Skills and MCP integrations), ChatGPT, and build tools such as Lovable or n8n

Bonus: hands-on technical SEO and a view on how AI search changes the way buyers find B2B software. SQL, or enough HTML, CSS and JavaScript to set up a test yourself.

Recruitment Process

  1. Recruiter Screen (30 minutes, online)

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes, online)

  3. Assessment Interview (1 hour, on-site)

  4. Final Interview (30 minutes, online)

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper. 🚀

title: Senior Hardware Certification Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Hardware Certification Engineer with focus on DO-254, you will be an important part of our Certification and Systems Engineering organization, supporting the development and certification of advanced unmanned aircraft systems.

Your main focus will be the development assurance and certification of airborne electronic hardware. You will work closely with Hardware, Systems Engineering, Safety, Verification & Validation and Certification teams to ensure that hardware development and verification activities fulfil the applicable certification objectives.

You will translate certification and safety requirements into practical engineering activities and help ensure that the required compliance evidence is complete, consistent, traceable and ready for review by certification authorities.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Plan, coordinate and support DO-254 / ED-80 hardware certification activities throughout the hardware development lifecycle.

  • Develop, review and maintain certification artefacts such as the Plan for Hardware Aspects of Certification (PHAC), Hardware Verification Plan (HVP), Hardware Configuration Management Plan (HCMP), Hardware Accomplishment Summary (HAS) and supporting compliance evidence.

  • Define and maintain DO-254 compliance matrices and ensure that applicable objectives are addressed by appropriate engineering evidence.

  • Support determination and justification of the applicable Hardware Design Assurance Level (DAL) together with Systems and Safety Engineering.

  • Ensure bidirectional requirements traceability between system requirements, hardware requirements, design data and verification evidence.

  • Review hardware requirements, conceptual and detailed designs, verification activities and lifecycle data against DO-254 objectives.

  • Define and review hardware verification methods, test cases, procedures, analyses and results, including the required level of independence.

  • Support compliance of FPGA, programmable logic, complex electronic hardware and electronic assemblies, as applicable to the individual programme.

  • Assess COTS, reused or previously developed hardware and define appropriate certification and compliance activities.

  • Support configuration management, problem reporting, change control and lifecycle data management required for certification.

  • Perform compliance reviews, gap analyses and change-impact assessments and track findings through closure.

  • Work closely with Hardware Development, Systems Engineering, Safety, Test & Verification and Configuration Management to integrate certification activities into the engineering lifecycle.

  • Support certification reviews, audits and authority engagements and provide clear technical justification for the selected means of compliance.

  • Continuously improve the organisation's DO-254 processes, templates, tooling and certification methods.


What you bring to the team:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering or a comparable technical discipline.

  • Professional experience in airborne electronic hardware development, hardware verification, aerospace certification or development assurance.

  • Strong practical knowledge of RTCA DO-254 / EUROCAE ED-80 and its application to airborne electronic hardware.

  • Experience with hardware certification planning, requirements management, verification and compliance evidence.

  • Good understanding of FPGA / CPLD or complex electronic hardware development, electronic hardware and PCB development, hardware requirements and design reviews, requirements-based verification, configuration management, change control, requirements traceability, verification independence, and COTS or reused hardware assessment.

  • Experience creating or reviewing DO-254 lifecycle documents such as PHAC, HVP, HCMP and HAS is highly desirable.

  • Familiarity with AC 20-152A or comparable authority guidance for airborne electronic hardware is an advantage.

  • Knowledge of related aerospace development and safety standards such as ARP4754A, ARP4761 / ARP4761A and DO-178C is advantageous.

  • Experience working with aviation certification authorities or within a DOA or military airworthiness environment is advantageous.

  • Structured and analytical working style with a strong focus on traceability, evidence and technical correctness.

  • Ability to communicate complex certification requirements effectively to hardware engineers and other engineering disciplines.

  • Fluent English, written and spoken. German language skills are beneficial.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.

Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.

About us:

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.

title: Senior Influencer Manager
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Airbnb Communications team drives earned visibility and cultural relevance for the brand, delivering campaigns that support direct traffic, brand love and positive conversation. Our influencer function sits at the intersection of culture, content and community — leading social-first campaigns that inspire travel on Airbnb and strengthen its long-term reputation.

The Difference You Will Make

We're looking for a Senior Influencer Manager to lead Airbnb's influencer programme in theUK, localising regional priorities and delivering campaigns that connect the brand to culturally relevant conversations.

The role covers our full influencer remit: earned and organic creator partnerships, and influencer work running through paid media. You'll own campaigns end to end — creator sourcing, briefing, contracting, measurement and reporting — and help position influencers as both a commercial lever and a long-term driver of brand health, while collaborating with agency partners.

Sitting in the UK Communications team, you'll build influencer into campaign narratives from inception, and partner with Brand Marketing and Paid Media so creator content is designed for amplification from the outset, with usage rights, whitelisting and dark posting permissions secured up front.

This is a hands-on role for someone who knows how to turn brand objectives into content that is authentic, thumb-stopping and earns attention rather than interrupting it.

A Typical Day

  • Own and scale Airbnb's influencer programme in the UK against local, regional and global priorities — timelines, creative execution and performance
  • Deliver across earned, organic and paid influencer work, partnering with the regional Influencer Lead and the UK Brand Marketing and Paid Media teams on creator selection, briefing for amplification, permissions and asset delivery
  • Build influencer into the core campaign narrative and press strategy from inception, with the UK Communications team
  • Identify, vet and build relationships with creators across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube — emerging talent through to established partners — with inclusive, culturally relevant casting
  • Write clear, strategic briefs covering objectives, key messages and content guidelines, and lead onboarding and content reviews against brand standards
  • Partner with legal and agency teams on contracts: deliverables, usage rights, paid media, exclusivity and payment
  • Stay plugged into culture, consumer and media trends — particularly Gen Z — bringing forward creator ideas and campaign hooks, and moving fast on reactive opportunities
  • Manage logistics for influencer stays and experiences, including vetting, Host coordination and credit approvals
  • Track performance across commercial and brand health metrics using CreatorIQ,Sprinklr and Airtable, optimising with the agency and reporting to the regional team
  • Align plans with local Marketing, Partnerships, Affiliate and Growth teams and the global influencer team to avoid duplicated effort
  • Lead day-to-day communication and program operations with our respective UK Influencer agency partners 
  • Identify opportunities with key opinion formers — policy, cultural and news influencers, and third-party validators — for reputation campaigns

Your Expertise

  • 8+ years in communications, influencer marketing, talent partnerships or social-first content strategy
  • Deep knowledge of the UK creator landscape and strong instincts on what resonates and why, across a diverse audience
  • A communications mindset: a track record of building creator partnerships into integrated campaigns, connected to the earned, social and reputation storytelling around them
  • End-to-end campaign experience across organic and paid environments — sourcing, briefing for amplification, dark posting, usage rights, contracting and performance analysis
  • Confident negotiating with creators and managing external agencies and stakeholders across legal, marketing and comms
  • Strong writing, particularly briefs and content feedback
  • Familiarity with influencer tools (CreatorIQ, Sprinklr or similar tooling platforms) and reporting that quantifies brand health and sentiment, not just reach and engagement
  • Able to run multiple campaigns and creators at once with high attention to detail
  • Belief in influencer as a driver of long-term brand equity, not just short-term performance

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

title: Senior Key Account Executive
descriptionHtml:

Ce qu'on va attendre de toi :

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, AV Core
descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our AV Core Engineering Team

Wayve’s AV Core organisation builds the foundational capabilities required for assisted and fully autonomous driving. Within AV Core, the Core Model Safety team focuses on collision avoidance, model understanding, and robustness under failure. You’ll join a focused, high-impact senior team working with large-scale training and fleet data, alongside partners in research, simulation, evaluation, and applied engineering.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll lead large-scale data enrichment and curation initiatives, collaborating across pre- and mid-training, reward modelling, self-supervised labelling, and the Data Enrichment Platform. You’ll develop workflows for mining hard and rare events, investigate how models perform in the real world, and improve the efficiency and reliability of our machine learning operations stack.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Lead on large-scale data enrichment within the Core Model Safety team, including collaborations with Pre/Midtraining, reward modelling, self-supervised labelling, and the Data Enrichment Platform.

  • Build workflows for large-scale enrichment, data curation, and hard/rare event mining in support of robust model performance and introspection.

  • Design and train out-of-distribution detection mechanisms to enable robust driverless operation.

  • Work at the intersection of model engineering, infrastructure, compute, and data, shaping the boundaries and architecture across those teams.

  • Use your judgement and expertise to improve the overall efficiency of the machine learning and operations stack.

 

🙌 You should apply if

Essential

  • Hands-on experience with ML systems deployed in the real world.

  • Proficiency in Python and PyTorch, with strong software engineering practices and hands-on experience building reliable machine learning training and evaluation systems.

  • A strong track record with ML operations and infrastructure, including experience with distributed computing environments and large-scale inference.

  • Senior-level ownership and collaboration: able to lead a substantial technical area, work across research and engineering boundaries, and bring others along through clear written and verbal communication.

Desirable

  • Prior experience in autonomous vehicles or robotics with hands-on deployment and closed-loop validation on physical systems.

  • Experience mining, generating, or evaluating rare events using simulation and fleet or heterogeneous real-world data.

  • Experience setting up cloud-based monitoring solutions for large-scale operations, including dashboards, logging, and real-time alerts.

  • Experience with transformer-based and multimodal architectures, including vision-language models (VLM), vision-language-action models (VLA), or equivalent.

  • Proficiency in C++, CUDA, distributed training, or performance optimization for production machine learning systems.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen: 30 mins with Talent Partner.

  • Competency Interviews: Programming and System Design Interviews - 2h total.

  • Deep-dive technical interviews Domain ML Interviews - 2h total.

  • Final interview: Mission & Values Alignment - 1h.

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually

title: Senior Manager Logistics (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects.

About Our Technology

The semiconductor industry's growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude. In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution.

The Role

At Black Semiconductor, logistics is more than moving materials from A to B. It is the infrastructure that keeps our operations running as we move towards production, it is becoming increasingly business-critical.

We are looking for a Senior Manager to take ownership of this function and help build it for our next stage of growth. This is a role for someone who enjoys both getting things done and building them up properly: you will participate in day-to-day operations, while at the same time developing the processes, structures and supply chain setup we need for the future.

Today, our logistics setup is very lean, giving you significant ownership from day one. With the setup and scaling of our main headquarters and new facility (FabONE), you will play a key role in scaling Black Semiconductor’s our operational capabilities as the company moves into production.

To Join Our Team, You Should Be Excited To:

  • Build and lead the logistics team and warehouse operations, providing both functional and disciplinary leadership.

  • To keep products moving, ensure reliable day-to-day logistics operations across domestic and international transportation, shipping and distribution, taking a hands-on approach where needed.

  • Develop and optimize processes across warehousing, receiving, inventory, transportation, shipping and production support.

  • Drive initiatives to improve efficiency, quality, cost performance and delivery reliability, like our SAP S/4HANA rollout, establishing RASIC and best practices to building the team and capabilities needed for future growth.

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders across production, engineering, procurement and other business functions to ensure a reliable flow of materials and information.

  • Own dangerous goods handling and regulatory compliance, ensuring adherence to ADR, IATA, IMDG, and all relevant legal requirements

  • Ensure that compliance is an integral part of our logistics processes right from the start.

Your Qualifications

title: Senior Manager,  UK Security (R6499)
descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and  

Shield AI is a defence technology company building intelligent autonomous systems for defence programmes. We are seeking a Senior Manager, UK Security to establish and lead the UK industrial security capability required to pursue and deliver sensitive Ministry of Defence, allied-government, and prime-contractor programmes.

This hands-on leader will serve as Shield AI's senior UK security adviser and, subject to government approval and contractual need, perform the appropriate Facility Security Controller and Personnel Security Controller responsibilities. The role will align UK operations with Shield AI's global framework while preserving UK sovereign requirements and government direction.

What You'll Do

  • Establish and manage Shield AI's UK security programme across personnel, physical, information, cyber-enabled, and operational security.

  • Lead readiness for Facility Security Clearance (FSC) and Industry Personnel Security Assurance (IPSA), including gap assessments, secure-site preparations, evidence, corrective actions, and continuing assurance.

  • Serve as the principal interface with MoD contracting authorities, the Industry Security Assurance Centre (ISAC), United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV), customers, and prime contractors.

  • Establish and administer the authorised national security vetting process through NSVS, including role validation, sponsorship, clearance verification, transfers, renewals, aftercare, and cessation.

  • Partner with programme owners to identify positions requiring BPSS, SC, enhanced SC, DV, or other directed vetting, based on contractual need and need-to-know.

  • Advise Capture, Business Development, Contracts, Legal, and Programme teams on Security Aspects Letters, DEFCONs, classification guidance, flow-down obligations, costs, schedules, and risks.

  • Develop UK company security instructions, policies, risk assessments, appointment letters, procedures, registers, training, and inspection-ready records.

  • Lead secure-facility and classified-asset controls, including access, storage, accounting, transmission, destruction, visitor management, Requests for Visit, IVCO coordination, and classified logistics.

  • Coordinate with Cybersecurity and IT on secure systems, remote-working controls, government assurance, incident response, and remediation.

  • Work with product security, engineering, Cybersecurity and programme teams to identify UK customer security requirements early, support Secure by Design activities, and ensure product security risks, decisions and assurance evidence are tracked through the lifecycle.

  • Manage UK security incidents, aftercare reporting, foreign ownership or influence concerns, insider and supply-chain risks, and required government notifications.

  • Build metrics, budgets, vendors, and the UK security team as the business grows; support occasional out-of-hours response and UK or international travel.

  • Maintain a UK security risk register covering personnel, physical, information and programme security. Work with Cybersecurity and IT to identify and track relevant cyber risks, and advise or escalate material risks to UK leadership and the Board Level Contact.

Required Qualifications

  • Eight or more years of progressively responsible industrial, government, defence, intelligence, or corporate security experience, including ownership of a UK defence-security programme.

  • Experience serving as, or directly supporting, a UK Facility Security Controller, Personnel Security Controller, Security Controller, or comparable senior supplier-security role.

  • Practical experience with FSC or IPSA readiness and assurance, UKSV sponsorship, NSVS administration, SC or DV aftercare, and government inspection activity.

  • Strong knowledge of the Government Security Classifications Policy, GovS 007: Security, the UK Security Policy Framework, and MoD supplier and contract-security requirements.

  • Experience establishing or operating secure facilities and controls for classified information, systems, material, visitors, and international engagements.

  • Strong leadership, judgement, discretion, writing, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate requirements into practical processes in a fast-paced technology environment.

  • British nationality, or qualifying dual nationality including British nationality, subject to government restrictions for designated security-controller duties.

  • Current SC or DV clearance, or the ability to obtain and maintain the required level, plus legal authorisation to work in the United Kingdom.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current SC or DV clearance and prior appointment as a Facility Security Controller or Personnel Security Controller for an FSC- or IPSA-assured supplier.

  • Experience standing up a security programme or secure facility and supporting multinational defence, NATO, allied, or AUKUS-related work.

  • Relevant degree, professional certification, or recognised security-body membership; working knowledge of U.S. industrial security and export-control requirements is advantageous.

  • Working knowledge of applicable MOD security policy, including JSP 440, and the ability to identify and implement the security requirements specified in contracts.

  • Familiarity with the MOD Cyber Security Model, Defence Standard 05-138, Defence Cyber Certification, Cyber Essentials and supplier security obligations.

title: Senior Medewerker Financiële Administratie
descriptionHtml:
GGZ inGeest zoekt een senior medewerker Financiële Administratie in Amsterdam.

Als senior medewerker Financiële Administratie ben je verantwoordelijk voor een zorgvuldige uitvoering en bewaking van diverse financiële administratieve processen. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in het waarborgen van de juistheid, volledigheid en tijdigheid van de financiële administratie. Naast de uitvoering van de dagelijkse werkzaamheden analyseer je financiële gegevens, onderzoek je afwijkingen en signaleer je mogelijkheden om processen te optimaliseren. Met jouw expertise draag je bij aan een betrouwbare financiële bedrijfsvoering en een adequate ondersteuning van de organisatie.


Waar ga je werken?

  • De afdeling Financiële Administratie bestaat uit 10 enthousiaste medewerkers, inclusief de manager Financiële Administratie, en maakt onderdeel uit van de Directie Financiën.

  • De afdeling is verantwoordelijk voor de controle op en de tijdige, juiste en volledige verwerking van financiële gegevens in het financiële systeem.

  • Vanuit jouw financiële expertise ondersteun je de organisatie bij administratieve en financiële vraagstukken. Hiermee ontlast je behandelaren en andere zorgprofessionals, zodat zij zich kunnen richten op hun primaire werkzaamheden.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering en bewaking van de debiteurenadministratie. Hieronder vallen onder andere het verzorgen van facturatie, het controleren van openstaande posten, het versturen van aanmaningen en het bewaken van de volledigheid van de facturatie.

  • Je controleert financiële gegevens in AFAS en voert, indien nodig, correcties door.

  • Je stelt financiële informatie beschikbaar voor interne rapportages en levert een bijdrage aan periodieke afsluitingen en aansluitingen met het grootboek.

  • Je analyseert de financiële en projectadministratie, signaleert onvolkomenheden en doet voorstellen ter verbetering van de administratieve processen.

  • Je voert de financiële administratie van samenwerkingsprojecten in het kader van het Integraal Zorgakkoord (IZA) en van subsidieprojecten.

  • Je analyseert verschillen tussen administratieve gegevens en gerealiseerde resultaten en draagt zorg voor een adequate opvolging.

  • Je fungeert als inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor financiële vraagstukken met betrekking tot debiteuren, IZA-samenwerkingsprojecten en subsidieprojecten.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in de richting van financiële administratie, Finance & Control of een vergelijkbare studierichting.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met debiteurenadministratie en projectadministratie.

  • Bij voorkeur ervaring met de financiële administratie en verantwoording van subsidieprojecten en samenwerkingsprojecten.

  • Kennis van financiële verslaglegging en ervaring met het controleren en analyseren van financiële gegevens.

  • Een nauwkeurige en analytische werkwijze, waarbij je oog hebt voor detail en deadlines.

  • Het vermogen om zelfstandig financiële afwijkingen te analyseren, oorzaken te achterhalen en passende oplossingen te realiseren.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een servicegerichte, professionele houding.

  • Een proactieve instelling en affiniteit met het optimaliseren van financiële administratieve processen.

Ook belangrijk 

  • Je komt in het team Financiële Administratie op de Overschiestraat in Amsterdam.  

  • Een afgeronde HBO-opleiding richting financiële administratie is vereist. 

  • De functie is ingeschaald in FWG45 conform CAO GGZ. Je salaris hangt samen met je ervaring

title: Senior ML Ops Engineer (Experiences)
descriptionHtml:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor Experiences Engineering is the team that builds and supports the world's leading marketplace for travel experiences. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 400,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and everything in between) —making memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.

Our Internal Systems pillar is at the forefront of transforming how we harness AI, Machine Learning and Data Science to drive innovation and growth. To address the increasing traffic and deliver a cutting-edge platform, the team is in search of a MLOps Engineer to join and support Tripadvisor’s growth.

We are looking for an intermediate level MLOps Engineer to join the team. If you're passionate about creating ML/AI Platforms that empower teams to enhance customer experiences, we’d love to have you on board! 

This is a hybrid role based in London, opened for all the candidates who are already based in London or max 1,5h away. (relaxed hybrid, 2x per month)


What you'll do:

  • Empowering Data Science and ML stakeholders, by providing the tools and support the infrastructure necessary for seamless execution of machine learning and AI processes.
  • Support tech stack evolution by developing across our existing technology stack running in  AWS cloud, leveraging and adopting the latest solutions available in that environment.
  • Build and maintain a robust and scalable infrastructure to support pre-computed, batch and real-time model needs, ensuring smooth deployment and reducing time-to-market of machine learning models.
  • Take responsibility for all aspects of software engineering, from design to implementation, QA, and maintenance.
  • Monitor and support ML pipelines for accuracy, drifts, enhancements, changes, SLA, and billing volumes to ensure all models are processed accurately and when needed.
  • Foster a culture of innovation by generating and promoting new ideas within the MLOps domain.
  • Work with cross-functional stakeholders in defining and documenting requirements for building high-quality and impactful ML/AI products.


What you'll need:

  • 4+ years of MLOps experience, participating in building modern ML infrastructure catering to all stages of a model lifecycle.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and/or GCP, demonstrating proficiency in leveraging cloud services for scalable and reliable MLOps solutions.
  • Demonstrable experience of IaC (Infrastructure-as-code) tools like Terraform or CloudFormation in a production environment.
  • Previous exposure to additional technologies like Seldon, KServe, RayServe, Kubernetes, MLFlow, Sagemaker, Kubeflow, Anyscale, Valohai, ArgoCD, Docker, Python, Java, Ray, Spark, Pandas, Argo Workflow, Postgres, Snowflake and BigQuery is highly desirable.
  • Good to have: previous knowledge managing complementary DBs like vector and/or graph DBs
  • Good to have: Hands-on experience in model optimization with experience in handling high throughput and low latency applications with an eye on cost.
  • Good to have: Experience with LLMOps leveraging open source models
  • Ability to develop across a diverse technology stack and willingness and ability to take on new technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience participating in cross-functional teams in fast-paced environments.
  • Experience with CI/CD processes and platforms.
  • Ability to effectively operate both independently and as part of a team.
  • Sense of ownership, urgency and pride in your work. Experience being a lead engineer / SME on multiple projects
  • High-quality verbal and written communication skills.

Perks of Working at Viator

  • Competitive compensation packages, including base salary, annual bonus, and equity.
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. We take a remote-friendly approach to collaboration, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like in select locations. 
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.

Our Values

We aspire to lead; We’re relentlessly curious;... want to know more? Read up on our values: 

  • We aspire to lead. Tap into your talent, ambition, and knowledge to bring us – and you – to new heights.
  • We’re relentlessly curious. We push beyond the usual, the known, the “that’s just how it’s done.”
  • We’re better together. We learn from, accept, respect, support, and value one another– and are creating something remarkable in the process.
  • We serve our customers, always. We listen, question, respond, and strive for wow moments. 
  • We strive for better, not perfect. We won’t get it right the first time – or every time. We’ll provide a safe environment in which to make mistakes, iterate, improve, and grow.

title: Senior National Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Practical Detail
Location: Hybrid | Remote

Why this role matters
In your first year, you will deliver an ambitious growth plan for Flora Food Group's largest customer, Bidfood, driving both sales and margin across the full P&L. This role is critical to strengthening Flora's position in the food service market by embedding a joint business plan that aligns Flora's brand priorities with Bidfood's commercial strategy. You will shape how our brands are listed, promoted, and grow within a key account that influences menus and food trends across the UK. Your work will directly impact the availability and innovation of better food in kitchens nationwide.

What you'll do

  • Own the Bidfood P&L, managing pricing, promotions, trade spend, and trade promotion management accruals to achieve sales and margin growth.
  • Lead the joint business plan and negotiate annual trading terms to ensure Flora's brands are well positioned and invested in.
  • Build and maintain relationships across all levels of Bidfood, from senior buyers to depot and logistics teams, to improve service and unlock commercial opportunities.
  • Deliver new product development and innovation launches on time and at the right price, collaborating closely with culinary and new business teams.
  • Champion the push-pull strategy by engaging Bidfood's end users—contract caterers, pubs, hotels, restaurants and Quick Serve Restaurants (QSR) — to grow brand presence and volume.

Performance
You will own the full P&L for the Bidfood account, driving measurable growth in sales and margin while managing trade spend within budget. Your leadership of the joint business plan will ensure alignment between Flora's brand ambitions and Bidfood's commercial goals. Success will be seen in improved brand listings, timely innovation launches, and strong trading terms that support sustainable growth.

Care
You will report directly to Helen Scott and collaborate with internal teams including new business, culinary, supply chain, and demand planning to ensure seamless service delivery. Externally, you will engage with multiple Bidfood functions such as buying, logistics, marketing, and category teams. Your decisions will balance commercial ambition with operational integrity, supporting a lean team environment during a period of organisational change.

Passion
Bidfood is at the heart of food service trends, where culinary culture is shaped. You will connect Flora's innovation pipeline directly to the chefs and kitchens that bring our products to life. Your role will influence how plant-based, indulgent, and culinary food categories evolve in the out-of-home market. Your curiosity about taste, nutrition, and functionality will drive meaningful innovation and brand growth.

About you
You'll bring solid food service experience, ideally managing Bidfood, Brakes, or Booker accounts, with a deep understanding of this route to market. You are commercially rigorous, confident in owning a P&L, and skilled at negotiating assertively while maintaining productive relationships. You sell on brand value, not price, and thrive in a fast-changing, lean environment. Your resilience and solution-oriented mindset help you navigate complex commercial and cultural challenges. You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition, and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences.

Where this could lead to
This role typically leads to broader commercial leadership opportunities within Flora Food Group, including potential European roles as the business integrates into a larger unit. There is also scope to move into retail or new business functions. With success, you may take on direct reports and progress into senior management positions within 2 to 3 years.

What's next
If this opportunity sounds exciting, we'd love to hear from you.

We’re looking for a Senior National Account Manager to join our UKI team. In this role, you’ll manage the daily relationship with a portfolio of our largest restaurant partners, using data-driven insights to grow their sales and help them achieve operational excellence.

 

Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Data-Driven Insight: Monitor and analyse partner-specific goals, creating compelling narratives from complex data to show partners where and how they can improve.

  • Operational Training: Deliver in-person training sessions for key partners covering operational best practices, Deliveroo insights, and on-site troubleshooting.

  • Regional Collaboration: Partner with regional Commercial Managers to identify and prioritise growth opportunities across specific UK zones.

  • Marketing Integration: Work with restaurant marketing counterparts to design and deliver campaigns that create long-term value for both the partner and Deliveroo.

  • Cross-Functional Advocacy: Identify opportunities to deepen relationships by involving and working with Deliveroo’s Marketing, Operations, and Product teams.

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

 

  • Partnership Expertise: Proven experience in account management or a strategic partnerships role, ideally within a high-growth technology or marketplace environment.

  • Analytical Rigour: The ability to manage large datasets and translate them into clear, applicable insights that drive business decisions.

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:
