descriptionHtml:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£70,000 - £105,000 + Benefits |

We’re looking for several Senior Product Marketing Managers to own Product Marketing for some of Monzo's most important products across Core Banking, Borrowing and Wealth

At Monzo, Product Marketing is a global product-market fit discipline rather than a GTM discipline. We’re embedded in squads with PMs, Designers, and User Researchers, shaping products and propositions by acting as the voice of the market (UK, Ireland, Spain and future markets). We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead campaign & channel strategy, creative direction, and overall go-to-market approach to bring those propositions to customers. Together, we build the right products and drive their growth. If that’s your flavour of product marketing, Monzo is for you.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll own Product Marketing for a product end-to-end: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and helping bring launches to market. There are two levels of seniority available — we will determine together what best fits you during the interview process.

Where you could join:

  • Core is the foundation of Monzo. It's where we build the products millions of people use every day: from Current Accounts and Joint Accounts to Pots, Subscriptions, Savings Challenge, and all the moments that make managing money feel effortless. This is a role for someone who believes the best product experiences come from getting the fundamentals right, and wants to shape products that become part of people's daily lives.
  • Borrowing is helping customers access credit simply, transparently, and responsibly. Today that includes growing products like Flex, Loans, Credit Insights, Mortgages, and Overdrafts in the UK, while also taking Monzo's Flex proposition to millions more customers across Europe. This is a role for someone excited by the challenge of growing an established proposition at home while shaping how it succeeds in new markets; understanding local customer needs, refining the proposition, and helping build the foundations for Monzo to win internationally.
  • Wealth is building the future of how people grow their money: helping millions of customers save, invest, and plan for retirement with the same simplicity and trust they expect from their current account. It spans Savings, Investments, Pensions, Insurance, and brand new wealth-building experiences. This is a role for someone who wants to challenge how traditional wealth products work and make growing money feel simpler, more accessible, and more rewarding for everyday customers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Product Marketing for a Product. You'll define a 2–4 quarter Product Marketing strategy that connects customer needs, market opportunity, and product direction into a clear plan. You'll own Product Marketing across the full product lifecycle from early discovery through launches and iteration. You'll be the go-to person for understanding how your product succeeds in the market.
  • Become the expert on your market. You'll build a deep understanding of your customers, competitors, and category, using research, data, and experimentation to identify opportunities that influence product priorities. You'll bring the voice of the market into day-to-day product decisions and help your squad make better bets.
  • Define positioning customers understand. You'll create clear, differentiated positioning and messaging that helps customers understand why your product matters. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Writers, and Integrated Marketing to ensure that positioning is reflected consistently across the product experience and everything customers see.
  • Influence Product Strategy. You'll work alongside Product Managers, Designers, and Researchers to shape product strategy with customer and market insight. Product teams will seek your perspective before committing to product bets, and you'll help turn customer problems into products people genuinely love.
  • Shape successful launches. You'll design launch strategies that fit the customer problem, partner with Integrated Marketing on campaigns, and coordinate cross-functional launches across Product, Marketing, Operations, and Support. You'll measure what worked, learn quickly, and continuously improve how your product reaches customers.
  • Measure what matters. You'll use customer and commercial data to understand whether your work is making a difference. You'll build business cases for product decisions, measure launches against meaningful outcomes, and use what you learn to strengthen positioning, propositions, and future product decisions.

This is for you if: 

  • You enjoy owning entire products. You're comfortable taking responsibility for Product Marketing across a full product experience, from customer insight through to positioning. 
  • You solve ambiguous problems with evidence. You enjoy understanding customers, identifying market opportunities and turning insight into practical product and marketing recommendations.
  • You know what makes products win. You combine customer insight, market understanding and commercial thinking to build products and propositions people genuinely love.
  • You influence through collaboration. You enjoy working closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, Researchers and Integrated Marketing, bringing people with you through evidence rather than authority.
  • You're always improving and helping others improve. You seek feedback, develop your craft and contribute to making the team stronger through sharing knowledge and helping others. Mentor more junior team members informally.

The Interview Process

Our interview process involves three main stages:

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Growth
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

The next generation of AI companies is being built on APIs. As developers choose the models and infrastructure that will power their applications, Mistral has an opportunity to become the AI lab and provider of choice for those who value performance, openness and control.

We are hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to turn developer adoption into sustained commercial growth. You'll define how the market understands Mistral's developer platform and build the go-to-market strategy for model APIs, and create a measurable path from initial experimentation to production usage and larger commercial relationships. Your objective is to grow self-serve revenue and make product adoption a repeatable source of qualified pipeline across Mistral’s API business.

This is a greenfield opportunity to shape a fast-evolving market, influence product strategy and establish a new growth marketing capability. You'll work closely with senior leadership and teams across Product, Engineering, Science, Sales and Marketing to define our positioning, accelerate adoption and create a scalable path from self-serve usage to enterprise revenue.

You won't inherit a playbook. You'll build one.

What you'll do

Define how Mistral can win developers.

  • Identify the developer audiences, customer problems, and their workloads where Mistral has the strongest opportunity to differentiate.

  • Define positioning and messaging strategy for models, capabilities, and use cases selected as growth priorities.

  • Translate our technical strengths such as model performance, transparent pricing, economics, and deployment choice into clear reasons to adopt Mistral.

  • Build a deep understanding of developer needs and competitive dynamics, using market research, customer insights and technical trends to sharpen our positioning and influence product priorities.

Build the API go-to-market and growth engine.

  • Develop the marketing strategy across the developer journey, from initial discovery and first API call through sustained paid usage..

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Science and Developer Relations to bring technical innovations to market through compelling narratives, campaigns, content and developer-focused programmes.

  • Partner with Sales to identify high-potential accounts and create pathways from experimentation to larger production workloads.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • An experienced product marketer. You have proven experience in product marketing, growth marketing or developer marketing within B2B technology, developer platforms, APIs or AI, with demonstrable impact on product adoption and commercial outcomes.

  • A strategic storyteller. You've taken technical products from ambiguity to market, developing differentiated positioning and go-to-market strategies that help products stand out in competitive markets.

  • Fluent in developer audiences. You understand how developers discover, evaluate and adopt technical products, and know how to build trust, reduce friction and drive sustained engagement.

  • Technically credible. You can navigate API documentation, work with sample code and engage confidently with engineers and product teams. You understand the fundamentals of model performance, latency, inference costs, throughput and context windows, and can translate technical complexity into customer value.

  • Commercially minded and analytical. You connect marketing strategy to business outcomes, understand product-led growth, monetisation, and sales, and you use data to prioritise investments and measure impact.

  • A builder and cross-functional leader. You thrive in greenfield environments, influence senior stakeholders, challenge assumptions constructively and bring teams together around clear priorities. You're comfortable creating new capabilities and scaling what works.

  • Curious. You bring intellectual rigour, curiosity and conviction to complex problems. You're excited by the potential sovereign AI and the opportunity to give developers and businesses greater choice and control.

Nice to have

  • Experience marketing AI APIs, developer platforms, cloud infrastructure or model-serving products.

  • Experience building product-led growth programmes or self-serve-to-enterprise motions.

  • A track record of technical thought leadership, developer community engagement or open-source participation.

title: Senior Programme Manager -  Technology & AI
descriptionHtml:
About THG 

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition. 

Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition. 

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.  

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for? 

About THG

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.

Our leading retailers and brands, including LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD and Cult Beauty, make up our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?

Location: Icon 1, WA15 0AF

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Technical Programme Manager to lead the delivery of our most important customer-facing technology programmes, reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer.

THG runs several high-profile ecommerce websites in nutrition and beauty, including myprotein.com and lookfantastic.com. Our websites and mobile apps are how customers find, buy and come back to our brands, and the programmes you lead will shape that experience directly.

You will own programmes from first idea to launch, mainly across our websites and mobile apps. Examples include personalisation, loyalty and digital marketing technology, and some programmes will reach into other parts of the technology estate. The role is an even mix of programme and project management. You will run long-lived programmes that span many teams, and drive individual projects hands-on when they need it. You will work with executives to decide what gets built and in what order, and tell them plainly how delivery is going.

You don’t need to be the architect. Our technology leaders set the technical direction and you will follow their lead. You do need to understand how large websites and apps are built well enough to plan the work, spot risks early and ask the right questions.

As a Technical Programme Manager you will:

Programme Delivery

  • End-to-End Ownership: Own the delivery of large technology programmes across our websites and mobile apps, from scoping and planning through to launch and review.
  • Programme Planning: Build and maintain programme plans, milestones and dependency maps across several engineering and product teams.
  • Hands-On Project Delivery: Run individual projects directly when a programme needs it.

Prioritisation & Product Partnership

  • Executive Prioritisation: Bring options, costs and trade-offs to executives and secure a clear decision on what comes first.
  • Backlog Management: Manage the backlog for your programmes so engineering teams always know what is next and why.
  • Product Collaboration: Work with product managers to turn business goals into well-defined, deliverable pieces of work.

Reporting, Risk & Vendors

  • Honest Reporting: Give executives and stakeholders clear, candid updates on progress, risks and dates.
  • Risk & Dependency Management: Find risks, blockers and cross-team dependencies early, resolve them, and escalate when a decision is needed.
  • Vendor Management: Hold external vendors and delivery partners to their commitments and fit their work into our plans and releases.

Continuous Improvement

  • Ways of Working: Improve how we plan, track and report on delivery across the technology organisation.

A day in the life

Your day is split between the teams doing the work and the leaders deciding what the work should be. You might start with an engineering team, checking progress against the plan and clearing a blocker, then spend time with a product manager breaking a loyalty feature into deliverable stages. In the afternoon you could review a vendor’s delivery plan for a marketing technology integration, then update programme status ahead of an executive review, where you’ll set out where things stand, what is at risk and which decisions you need. You’ll leave with clear priorities and take them back to the teams.

What skills and experience do I need for this role?

Essential Requirements

  • Highly Skilled in technical programme or project management.
  • Experience working directly with software engineering teams.
  • Adept at delivering customer-facing websites or mobile apps.
  • Excellent at managing programmes across several teams, including planning, dependency management and release coordination.
  • Experience running prioritisation and backlog management with senior stakeholders and reporting on delivery to executives.
  • Managing both external vendors or delivery partners.

Desirable Attributes

  • Experience with websites and ecommerce at large scale: high traffic, many markets, or several brands.
  • Experience delivering programmes in personalisation, loyalty or digital marketing technology.
  • Experience delivering native mobile apps alongside web.
  • Experience in retail, particularly nutrition or beauty.
  • A record of bringing clear structure to ambiguous, multi-team programmes.
  • Strong written communication, with the ability to explain a complex programme to executives in plain terms.

title: Senior Researcher, Human Rights and Artificial Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
FULL-TIME JOB VACANCY
Senior Researcher on Human Rights and Artificial Intelligence
Technology, Rights and Investigations Division
Multiple Office Locations Considered
Application Deadline: December 13, 2026
 
Human Rights Watch (HRW) is seeking a highly qualified Senior Researcher on Human Rights and Artificial Intelligence to investigate, analyze, and advocate against human rights abuses worldwide related to artificial intelligence. The role of the Senior Researcher will include documenting and conveying the rights implications of various forms of artificial intelligence and other algorithmic decision-making being developed and deployed by governments and private sector actors around the world for exclusion and repression, including  information control and censorship and discriminatory decision making, especially in high-risk contexts, for example by law enforcement and immigration authorities. Experience working on the impact of AI or other technology issues in Asia is preferred.

The role sits in the Tech and Human Rights team within the broader Technology, Rights and Investigations Division and will report to the Deputy Director based in New York. The Senior Researcher on Human Rights and Artificial Intelligence will collaborate with other team members in the Technology, Rights and Investigations Division, and colleagues in regional and thematic divisions, and other relevant departments of HRW, including media, legal and policy team, and the advocacy department.

The successful candidate will have deep domain expertise, as well as a track record of conducting research and investigations at the intersection of human rights abuses and AI. The role will be based in any of the following locations where HRW has an office, and will be expected to work from the office on an as-needed basis: New York, Washington DC, Los Angeles, San Francisco, Toronto, Sao Paulo, London, Brussels, Amsterdam, Berlin, Nairobi, Johannesburg, Beirut, or Stockholm. 

Responsibilities:
1. Develop a plan for strategic research and advocacy for influencing the development, application, and regulation of artificial intelligence and similar technologies by governments and the private sector to ensure respect for internationally recognized human rights, including non-discrimination and accountability;
2. Research, document, and analyze policies and practices related to AI, machine learning, and big data technologies that raise human rights concerns by collecting and analyzing information from a wide variety of sources, including governments, media, academia, NGOs, victims of abuses, open-source information, technologists, and others; Interview persons whose rights have been harmed by AI technologies, as well as related professionals and experts (e.g., organizations representing impacted communities, engineers who build AI technologies, data and computer scientists, etc.); 
3. Identify and document where use of AI may have disparate impact on vulnerable or marginalized groups or may exacerbate economic inequality, and place abuses or potential for abuses within the broader political, social and economic contexts;
4. Write and publicize reports, op-eds, press releases, briefing memos, statements, testimony and other materials to disseminate our research findings and policy recommendations for preventing or ending human rights abuses linked to artificial intelligence applications; 
5. Work with colleagues in the Communications Department to develop innovative multimedia and social media strategies to communicate our positions in clear and compelling ways and to advance advocacy;
6. Develop and implement advocacy strategies in collaboration with HRW colleagues to change or prevent abusive government laws, policies, and practices, as well as abusive corporate policies and practices; 
7. Press companies and governments to ensure human rights protections are built into artificial intelligence by design from the outset and articulate how existing human rights standards should apply to emerging AI technologies;  
8. Build partnerships across key communities, including other human rights NGOs, groups representing vulnerable populations, data scientists, machine learning programmers, tech industry leaders, and academics; 
9. Contribute to the shaping of public debates on AI around human rights internationally through clear and prompt responses to queries from policy makers, the media, colleagues, and human rights communities; 
10. Work collaboratively with an international team of researchers within the Technology, Rights and Investigations division, including the Digital Investigations Lab, other thematic and country HRW researchers, and other relevant departments of HRW, including Communications, Legal and Policy, Advocacy, and the General Counsel’s office;
11. Travel domestically and internationally, as required, to conduct research, media work and advocacy; and
12. Be prepared and willing to work flexible hours to accommodate developing and urgent events;
13. Carry out other tasks as required.

Candidate Profile 

Candidates who are traditionally underrepresented in the technology and/or human rights sectors (such as people who identify as BIPOC, LGBTQIA+, women, migrants, people with disabilities, or people who have other related lived experiences) are enthusiastically encouraged to apply if they feel they have the ability to succeed in this role, even if they do not have all the skills and qualifications listed below.

Education: An advanced degree in journalism, law, public policy, national security, computer science, or a related field or equivalent experience is required.

Experience: A minimum of seven years of experience is required. This experience could come from a
variety of previous roles including, but not limited to journalists who have covered technology,
community activism, work at impact litigation organizations, academics, or industry professionals.

Related Skills and Knowledge:
1. Extensive knowledge of artificial intelligence, in particular the threats and complexities it poses to the major human rights challenges of our time is required.
2. Experience working on the impact of AI or other technology issues in Asia and fluency in an Asian language are desirable. 
3. Strong commitment to understanding how technology can impact the rights of women, racial and ethnic minorities, children, older people, people with disabilities, people living in poverty and low-wage workers, and other populations whose rights may be disproportionately impacted by AI is desirable.
4. Proven track record of producing timely and high-quality written research and investigations, as well as editing experience is required.
5. Ability to present and defend complex technology-related issues and positions to officials in governments, companies, and other bodies and institutions is preferable.
6. Being comfortable with generating and executing research projects, and the curiosity and creativity to follow through and follow up is required.
7. Exceptionally strong research, analytical, writing, and editing skills are required.
8. Experience conducting challenging investigative research globally is required, as is the ability to dig deep and tenacity in finding hard-to-get information, sources and records.
9. Good oral and written communication skills in English, and strong public speaking skills, are required; proficiency in other languages, is highly desirable.
10. Experience with TV, radio, print, and social media is highly desirable.
11. Demonstrated ability to work independently as well as successfully with a team and across other teams is required.
12. Strong interpersonal skills to work collaboratively within HRW, as well as develop constructive relationships with NGO partners, and company and government officials are required.
13. Demonstrated awareness and sensitivity to the needs and concerns of individuals from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and orientations is required.

Salary and Benefits: HRW offers competitive compensation and employer-paid benefits. HRW offers relocation assistance package and will assist employees in obtaining necessary work authorization in all listed locations except Nairobi, if required; citizens of all nationalities are encouraged to apply. If based in the United States, the salary range would be 88,000 – 104,000. Salary ranges outside of the United States vary based on location.
 
How to Apply: Please apply by December 13, 2026, by visiting our online job portal at careers.hrw.org and submitting a cover letter and CV or resume. No calls or email inquiries, please. Only complete applications will be reviewed and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. 
 
If you are experiencing technical difficulties with your application submission, or if you require disability-related accommodation, please email ----- Rights Watch is strong because it is diverse. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Human Rights Watch does not discriminate on the basis of disability, age, gender identity and expression, national origin, race and ethnicity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, or criminal record. We welcome all kinds of diversity. Our employees include people who are parents and nonparents, the self-taught and university educated, and from a wide span of socio-economic backgrounds and perspectives on the world. Human Rights Watch is an equal opportunity employer. 

Human Rights Watch is an international human rights monitoring and advocacy organization known for its in-depth investigations, its incisive and timely reporting, its innovative and high-profile advocacy campaigns, and its success in changing the human rights-related policies and practices of influential governments and international institutions.

title: Senior Sales Engineer, France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'd be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers. Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers.

This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success.

This role can be office-based (Paris) or fully remote in France. This role requires travel up to 25% of the time.

In this role, you will:

  • Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations.
  • Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve problems common to their industry.
  • Deliver the work products that get deals done. Think discoveries, demonstrations, value assessments, proof of concept implementations, etc.
  • Write scripts against our open API that solve real-world problems for companies that deliver essential services (for example), and document them for your fellow SEs to use.
  • Open the door for deeper entrenchment into accounts (integration, upsell, cross-sell) by becoming a consultant to your customers.
  • Act as a liaison between Samsara's product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs.
  • Partner with sales executives to plan, prepare, and execute transactions in rapid sales cycles.
  • Work in multiple levels of the technology stack.
  • Support sales executives ad-hoc queries and emails.
  • Build relationships with third-party partners, such as software providers, systems integrators, and installation partners.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 4+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT/CoM and/or Value Selling sales concepts.
  • Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations.
  • Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems.
  • Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems.
  • Fluent in French and English
  • Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Work experience in task automation scripting and transferring data between systems using Bash, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent language.
  • Work experience building solutions leveraging open APIs.
  • Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications.
  • Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.).
  • Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles.
  • Experience working with product teams internally and feature request processes.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. title: Senior SAP S/4HANA Interface Cutover Lead (Freelance)
descriptionHtml:
Mandatory Expertise – Bitte vor der Bewerbung lesen

Für ein langfristiges SAP S/4HANA-Transformationsprogramm bei einem großen deutschen Unternehmen suchen wir einen erfahrenen Senior SAP Interface Cutover Lead.

Im Rahmen der Transformation von SAP ECC auf SAP S/4HANA müssen rund 800 Schnittstellen zwischen SAP- und Non-SAP-Systemen koordiniert und im Zuge des Cutovers in die neue Systemlandschaft überführt werden. Ein Großteil der erforderlichen technischen Anpassungen wurde bereits umgesetzt.

Gesucht wird ein erfahrener Experte, der den gesamten Schnittstellen-Workstream im Cutover eigenverantwortlich plant, koordiniert und steuert.

Drei zwingende Anforderungen:

  1. SAP Interface Cutover Management: Nachweisbare persönliche Verantwortung für die Planung und Durchführung eines schnittstellenbezogenen Cutovers innerhalb komplexer SAP-Transformations-, Migrations- oder Carve-out-Projekte.

  2. Technisches Schnittstellenverständnis: Fundiertes Verständnis von SAP- und Non-SAP-Integrationen, Schnittstellenabhängigkeiten, Middleware-Technologien sowie der Deaktivierung, Umschaltung, Aktivierung und Validierung von Schnittstellen.

  3. Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung: Erfahrung in der Koordination technischer Teams, externer Dienstleister und verschiedener Stakeholder innerhalb großer Transformationsprogramme.

Es handelt sich nicht um eine reine SAP-Cutover-Management-Rolle, eine klassische Datenmigrationsrolle oder eine Schnittstellenentwicklerposition. Entscheidend ist die Kombination aus Cutover Management, technischer Integrationskompetenz und eigenverantwortlicher Workstream-Steuerung.

Bei uns gibt es flache Hierarchien, kurze Wege und keine Büropolitik. Wir arbeiten konzentriert, haben dabei Spaß und nehmen uns selbst nicht zu ernst. Wir finden, dass ein Job, der Spaß macht, und ein richtig gutes Gehalt sich nicht ausschließen.

Ehrlich gesagt

Es gibt noch keinen Prozess, kein Team und kein Handbuch. Das ist kein Mangel, das ist der Job. Du bist Person Nummer eins in diesem Bereich und trägst 100 % der Verantwortung für die Umsetzung. Den Plan schreibst du. Und wenn du findest, dass wir falsch liegen, sag es. Genau dafür suchen wir dich.

Deine Perspektive

Du startest als Senior SEO & GEO Manager und setzt selbst um. Wenn der Bereich wächst, hast du die Option, dich zum Head of SEO & GEO zu entwickeln und ein eigenes Team aufzubauen. Wie und wann, gestalten wir gemeinsam.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du setzt SEO, GEO und Bewertungsmanagement für unsere Kund:innen um, von der Analyse bis zum Ergebnis.

  • Du findest heraus, was ein Unternehmen in KI-Antworten nach vorne bringt, und machst daraus eine wiederholbare Methode(Framework/SOP).

  • Du baust das Fulfillment, die automatisierten Workflows mit KI so auf, dass es mit jedem neuen Kunden besser wird und nicht langsamer.

  • Du sagst uns, welche Nischen sich deiner Meinung nach lohnen und welche nicht.

Was du kannst

  • Google kennst du in- und auswendig: Google Business Profile, Search Console, lokale Rankings und AI Overviews.

  • Du weißt, wie ChatGPT, Perplexity und Gemini Quellen auswählen und Unternehmen empfehlen.

  • Du erstellst Websites und Landingpages automatisiert und optimierst sie für SEO und GEO, inklusive strukturierter Daten.

  • Du beherrschst Bewertungsmanagement: mehr echte Bewertungen gewinnen und professionell darauf antworten.

  • Du baust Workflows mit KI und Automationstools, etwa über APIs, n8n oder Make.

  • Du misst Ergebnisse und erklärst sie so, dass Kund:innen sie verstehen.

Woran wir merken, dass du es bist

  • Du lebst KI. Du nutzt sie jeden Tag, beruflich wie privat, und probierst neue Modelle aus, bevor jemand danach fragt.

  • Du bist neugierig und ruhst dich nie auf dem Status quo aus. Was gestern funktioniert hat, stellst du heute infrage.

  • Wir müssen dir nichts erklären. Du erklärst uns Dinge, die wir noch nicht wussten.

  • Du bist digital affin und brauchst niemanden, der dir Aufgaben gibt.

  • Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre SEO-Erfahrung, mit einem deutlichen Anteil Local SEO. Je mehr desto besser

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse.

  • Du bist einfach eine coole, sympathische Person :)

Was du von uns bekommst

  • Eine echte Founding Role mit der Option, Head of SEO & GEO zu werden

  • Ein Gesamteinkommen (OTE) weit über dem Markt, denn wir sind margenstark und teilen den Erfolg

  • Workations: Arbeite auch mal ein paar Wochen von dort, wo andere Urlaub machen.

  • Arbeiten, wo du willst: remote, hybrid oder vor Ort in München oder Wien

  • Flache Hierarchien: keine Freigabeschleifen, eine Entscheidung dauert bei uns ein Telefonat.

  • Budget für die KI-Tools, die du brauchst

  • Start ab Januar 2027 oder wann es für dich passt

Gehalt: Fixum 56.200 € brutto im Jahr. On-Target-Earnings (OTE): 130.000 € im Jahr. Wie sich die OTE zusammensetzen, erklären wir dir im ersten Gespräch.

So bewirbst du dich

Bewerben Sie sich mit dem Button auf dieser Seite.

  1. Deinen Lebenslauf

  2. Ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben, maximal eine Seite: Warum reizt dich genau diese Rolle, und was würdest du in den ersten 90 Tagen anders machen als die meisten? Und wie nutzt du KI heute schon im Alltag?

  3. Ein Vorstellungsvideo von 1 bis 3 Minuten (die Handykamera reicht, schick einfach den Link). Jeder Extra-Aufwand fließt positiv in die Bewertung ein, ist aber kein Muss.

Du hörst innerhalb von 5 Werktagen von uns, auch wenn es ein Nein ist.

  • Du kennst jemanden, der perfekt passt? Schick uns den Kontakt. Führt deine Empfehlung zur Einstellung, bedanken wir uns mit 3.000 €, sobald die Person die Probezeit bestanden hat.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production.

 

Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our growing platform engineering team. You'll be embedded in the teams building and operating Encord's core infrastructure, ensuring our platform is performant, reliable, observable, and scalable.

You will lead the planning and execution of efforts needed as we grow from our customer base from hundreds to thousands of AI teams worldwide, and the volume of AI training and supervision data managed by our platform from TBs to PBs of data.

You'll drive a culture of performant and resilient software through individual contributions and collaboration with multiple squads.

  

What You'll Do

  • Performance & Capacity — Profile and optimise services handling large-scale data pipelines; perform capacity planning for storage and compute-intensive workloads. Work with squads to establish performance benchmarks and expectations

  • Collaboration — Partner closely with backend and ML engineers to improve deployment pipelines (CI/CD), review infrastructure changes, and champion reliability best practices.

  • Reliability & Availability — Define and own SLIs/SLOs/SLAs for critical services; build alerting, runbooks, and incident response processes; lead postmortems with a blameless culture.

  • Infrastructure & Cloud — Design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure on GCP and AWS; manage Kubernetes clusters, networking, and storage at petabyte scale.

  • Automation & Tooling — Work to improve developer productivity and guide and review automation and tooling efforts across the engineering group.

  • Observability — Instrument services with distributed tracing, logging, and metrics (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog or similar); build infrastructure, define best practices and work with each squad to ensure every service is observable before it goes to production.

  

What We're Looking For

  • Experienceon hands-on SRE, DevOps, platform engineering experience or similar in a production environment.

  • Strong fundamentals in designing, building and maintaining resilient distributed and/or high performance systems

  • Solid understanding of networking, operating systems and database technologies

  • Experience with observability fundamentals — metrics, logs, traces, and alerting.

  • Comfortable with on-call rotations and incident management.

Tech stack

  • We are technology agnostic at Encord and not looking for experience across all of these — as long as you're open to learning, please apply.

    • Backend: Python and Rust

    • Frontend: TypeScript and React

    • Deployment: Kubernetes

    • Infrastructure: GCP

       

Why Encord

  • Competitive salary, commission, and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

  • Strong in-person culture — most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

  • 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

  • Daily company lunches

  • Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites

 

Operating principles

 

High agency

You see something broken, you fix it or find the person who can. We celebrate the people who solve 90% of a problem before anyone asks.

Build with care & urgency

We bear-hug the customer. Former founders and people from fast-moving, high-stakes environments thrive here.

Self-aware & hungry

We stay warm, self-aware, and genuinely hungry. We elevate our peers, and ego doesn't last long.

Invent in real time

We move toward the ambiguity. We’re pragmatic, resourceful, energized by the fact that there's no playbook.

 

If you're looking to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who push you to be better, we'd love to meet you.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Agents
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.

Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in.

We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.

The Way We Work

The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Move with Urgency: We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping.
  • Take Ownership: We own outcomes, not just our individual work. We make decisions that move the company forward and follow through.
  • Communicate Openly: We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together.
  • Build Great Teams: We lead by example, empower others, and create healthy teams where people can do their best work.
  • Raise the Bar: We're always improving ourselves. We learn from feedback, consistently challenge ourselves to grow, and focus on the work that matters most.
  • Think Long-Term: We design for what's next. We create scalable systems, simplify complexity, and use AI and automation to amplify our impact.
 

What We're Looking For

The Agents team at Lightning AI is building the infrastructure that powers the next generation of AI applications. As AI agents move from prototypes to production, developers need reliable systems for orchestrating workflows, coordinating models, executing tools, and managing long-running state. Our goal is to provide the platform and abstractions that make building production-ready agentic applications as simple as deploying any modern software service.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help design and build the backend systems that power Lightning AI's agent platform. You'll work on orchestration frameworks, tool execution, workflow management, memory and state handling, and developer-facing APIs that enable customers to build sophisticated AI applications with confidence.

You'll partner closely with engineers across Core Platform, Training & Experimentation, Sandboxes, and Optimized Compute to deliver platform capabilities that are reliable, scalable, and intuitive for developers.

This role is based in one of our San Francisco, NYC, or London office hubs, with a minimum of 2 in-office days per week and occasional team and company offsites. We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build backend services that power AI agent orchestration and execution.
  • Develop scalable APIs and platform capabilities for tool use, workflow orchestration, memory, and state management.
  • Build reliable infrastructure that enables long-running, distributed AI workflows.
  • Partner with product, research, and platform engineering teams to bring new agent capabilities into production.
  • Improve platform reliability, observability, and performance as customer workloads continue to scale.
  • Evaluate and strengthen technical architecture, engineering processes, and developer tooling.
  • Maintain high standards for software quality through testing, automation, continuous delivery, and proactive management of technical debt.
  • Mentor engineers on system design, distributed systems, and backend engineering best practices

What You’ll Need

  • Extensive experience building scalable backend systems using Go, Python, Rust, or similar languages.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous processing, APIs, and cloud-native application architecture.
  • Experience designing and operating production services at scale.
  • Hands-on experience building backend platforms, developer tools, or infrastructure products.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure and container technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Proven ability to take ownership of large technical initiatives from architecture through production.
  • Commitment to software quality, automated testing, observability, and continuous delivery.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, research, and design teams.
  • Ability to thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments while balancing technical excellence with product impact.

Compensation

We are committed to offering competitive compensation that reflects the value each team member brings to our mission. Final offers are based on factors such as experience, skills, geographic location, and role expectations. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package for eligible roles includes a discretionary bonus, a meaningful equity component, and comprehensive benefits.

The anticipated annual base salary range for this role is:$180,000—$250,000 USD

Benefits and Perks

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and long-term success:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents.
  • Meaningful Equity: RSUs that give employees a stake in the company's long-term success.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) matching (U.S.) and pension contributions (U.K.).

title: Senior Software Engineer, C++ UI
descriptionHtml:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

About the team

At Roku, the UI Systems team builds the high-performance engines and core graphics infrastructure that power millions of devices. We own the low-level C++ frameworks, rendering pipelines, and system architectures that enable smooth navigation and rich animations. Our work sits at the intersection of hardware and software, where we optimize graphics rendering, memory management, and layout engines to ensure a consistent, lightning-fast experience across our entire device portfolio. We operate in a collaborative, high-trust environment, partnering closely with firmware and silicon teams to push the boundaries of what’s possible on embedded hardware.

About the role

As a Senior Software Engineer , you will be a key architect of the core systems that underpin Roku’s user experience. You will design and implement performance-critical code within our UI engine, focusing on graphics primitives, memory efficiency, and hardware acceleration. You’ll tackle complex systems-level challenges—such as optimizing frame rates on resource-constrained hardware and building robust APIs for higher-level frameworks. This role is ideal for engineers who thrive on low-level systems programming, care about performance down to the microsecond, and want to build the high-performance foundations that power the future of television.

What you’ll be doing

  • Architect and optimize core C++ UI frameworks and rendering engines to ensure buttery-smooth performance across a diverse range of hardware profiles.
  • Lead technical investigations into system-level bottlenecks, memory leaks, and GPU/CPU synchronization issues.
  • Develop and maintain low-level graphics APIs and layout systems that serve as the backbone for Roku’s application ecosystem.
  • Integrate AI/ML capabilities at the systems level, leveraging generative AI tools to optimize code generation and automate performance profiling.
  • Collaborate with firmware and driver teams to leverage hardware-specific optimizations and ensure seamless integration with the underlying OS.
  • Mentor junior developers through deep-dive code reviews, architectural design sessions, and technical documentation of core systems.
  • Drive engineering excellence by implementing advanced debugging tools, automated performance regression suites, and modern C++ best practices.

We’re excited if you have

  • Minimum of 5+ years of software engineering experience with a heavy focus on C++ (C++14/17/20).
  • Deep understanding of systems programming, including memory management, multi-threading, and hardware-software abstraction layers.
  • Experience with graphics APIs (e.g., OpenGL, Vulkan, or proprietary embedded graphics stacks) and rendering pipelines.
  • Proficiency in Python for tooling and automation, with a working knowledge of BrightScript or JavaScript being a significant plus.
  • Strong root cause analysis skills, specifically using tools like GDB, Valgrind, or platform-specific profilers.
  • Knowledge of AI applications and hands-on experience using generative AI tools to accelerate systems-level development.
  • A proactive mindset with a passion for squeezing every drop of performance out of embedded systems and a commitment to data-driven optimization.

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to  

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Capacity and Quota Management)
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team building the Capacity and Quota Management control plane — the system that decides who gets compute, when, and how much.

Idle GPUs are waste. Overallocated ones are a contract you can't keep. descriptionHtml:

We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

LemFi's Credit tribe is early and moving fast. We're building the infrastructure that will power lending products for millions of people who've historically been locked out of fair credit - immigrants, diaspora communities, and the financially underserved across our 21 operating markets. This is a ground-floor opportunity: the tribe is being built right now, and the systems you design today will be the foundation everything else sits on.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Credit tribe and own core backend services end-to-end. You'll be working primarily in Go, with some existing Java services in the mix - switching between them is not the blocker, deep engineering craft and an instinct for how credit products behave is. What you'll build and own

  • Design, build and operate high-reliability backend services that power LemFi's credit products, from loan origination and underwriting through to repayment and collections.

  • Make the right architectural calls independently - data residency, service boundaries, state-machine design for loan lifecycles - without needing to be told what a credit-safe system looks like.

  • Own your services in production: instrument them, monitor them, debug them, and hold the bar on reliability and correctness.

  • Work closely with product and compliance to translate credit-domain requirements into clean, testable, maintainable code.

  • Contribute to growing the tribe - as one of the earliest engineers you'll help set the engineering culture, review others' work, and raise the bar on how we build.

Your experience

  • Exposure to credit products (lending, underwriting, repayment, collections) at any level - even adjacent - so you arrive with the right instincts, not just a willingness to learn them.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up where you helped establish engineering foundations from scratch.

  • Familiarity with regulatory and compliance constraints specific to consumer credit (e.g. FCA, data protection requirements for credit data).


Why join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

title: Senior Solutions Consultant, Enterprise Data Solutions
descriptionHtml:
WGSN | London | Permanent, full-time

About WGSN

For two decades, WGSN's proprietary trend intelligence has shaped how the world's most valuable brands in fashion, beauty, consumer goods, interiors and food and drink make decisions. Now those same brands are rebuilding their technology around AI (agents, knowledge platforms, recommendation engines and personalization systems) and they want WGSN forecast intelligence flowing into them as a data layer, delivered through the WGSN Intelligence API.

About the Role

You will be the solution lead on WGSN's largest and most complex new enterprise opportunities in EMEA. Partnering with Enterprise Account Directors, Product and Engineering, you will qualify, scope, design and close Intelligence API and data deals of $500k and above, mainly with new logos.

This is a hybrid technical and consultative role. You won't write code, and the API itself is simple. What matters is that you can sit credibly in two rooms: the commercial conversation with senior business leaders, and the technical conversation with the people who will integrate. Most of all, you'll make sure every deal grows WGSN's relationship with the client, protects the subscription business underneath it, and keeps our intelligence clearly credited to WGSN.

You'll report to the VP, working closely with our global commercial leadership, and you'll help raise the commercial standards of the wider North America sales team.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the solution and commercial design on priority enterprise deals, turning pipeline into signed multi-year contracts.
  • Run discovery with senior buyers in design, insight, buying and merchandising, and with Chief Digital, Innovation and Data Officers.
  • Map where WGSN intelligence creates value in a client's data and AI plans, and be clear about what the API does and doesn't do.
  • Structure deals that open new use cases, new buyers and new budgets without cannibalizing the existing subscription.
  • Build IP protection and brand attribution into the solution, the commercial model and the licensing terms from day one.
  • Design and run paid pilots that give clients a credible first step.
  • Coach the sales team on qualification and deal design, build collateral and battle cards, and feed customer insight back to Product.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong commercial judgement. You can tell true expansion from revenue moving between budget lines.
  • 6+ years in enterprise pre-sales, solutions consulting or solutions engineering, selling data, content, API or SaaS products to large enterprises.
  • A track record of leading the solution on $500k+ multi-year deals, including new logos.
  • Confidence with C-level and senior VP buyers, and the presence to lead a deal team.
  • Experience protecting IP, attribution and licensing in content, data or API deals, and the judgement to walk away when the terms are wrong.
  • Clear writing. You can produce a proposal an executive will sign and a solution outline an engineering lead will respect.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of fashion, beauty, retail, consumer goods or interiors, or of trend, research or consumer data businesses.
  • Experience with enterprise AI buying: agents, RAG, knowledge platforms, personalization engines.
  • MEDDPICC or a similar qualification method.
  • Spanish or Portuguese.

Experience

6 to 10 years in enterprise pre-sales or solutions consulting within SaaS, content, martech or data businesses.

What we offer
Our benefits and wellbeing package offers flexible benefits you can tailor to your own personal needs, including:
- 25 days of holiday per year - with an option to buy/ sell up to 5 days- Pension, Life Assurance and Income Protection Flexible benefits platform with options including Private Medical, Dental Insurance & Critical Illness - Employee assistance programme, season ticket loans and cycle to work scheme - Volunteering opportunities and charitable giving options - Great learning and development opportunities.

More about WGSN
WGSN is the global authority on consumer trend forecasting.
We help brands around the world create the right products at the right time for tomorrow’s consumer.

Our values
We Are EverywhereThe future is everything, it happens everywhere. WGSN is the world-leading forecaster because we track and analyse consumer behaviours, product innovation, design and creativity, everywhere.
We Are Future FocusedWe utilise our global resources and intelligence to research, source and analyse quantitative and qualitative data to produce our forecasts. Everything we do is focused on working with our customers to create a successful and positive tomorrow.
We Are RigorousWe source, review and assess quantitative and qualitative data to produce robust, actionable forecasts. To provide credible insights and design solutions for our clients, it is essential that rigour runs through everything we do.

Our culture
An inclusive culture is one of our key priorities. We want our people to truly be themselves and thrive. We love having a diverse team of people who bring new ideas, different strengths and perspectives & reflect the global audience we work with.

Inclusive workforce
We are committed to supporting the environment and sustainability, including ensuring our pension plan defaults to sustainable options and striving to be net zero by 2030.
Recognising great performance is a key part of our culture. Our Awards schemes recognise and reward the brilliant achievements of our people.
We offer a flexible working environment with a wide range of flexible, hybrid and agile working arrangements. Conversations about flexible working have always been—and will continue to be—actively encouraged here, but we do not offer full remote working.
We want to ensure everyone has the opportunity to perform their best when interviewing, so if you require any reasonable adjustments that would make you more comfortable during the process, please let us know so that we can do our best to support you.

A Note for Applicants
We use AI to help our team screen applications and identify candidates whose skills and experience match the role. This technology removes personal information to promote a fair and unbiased process. We believe this tool helps us find the best talent while maintaining transparency and fairness.

A Note for Recruiters
Thank you so much for your interest in working with us at WGSN! Our internal Talent Acquisition team takes care of all our recruitment efforts. When we need some extra help, we partner with agencies on our Preferred Supplier List (PSL) that truly understand our business, culture and ways of working together. Since we focus on these established partnerships, we’re unable to respond to unsolicited contacts or CVs from outside our PSL. But don’t worry! If we decide to explore new partnerships, we’ll be sure to reach out.

  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and other technical stakeholders to understand infrastructure needs, communicate architectural decisions, and deliver effective platform solutions.

    • Requirements:

  • Significant professional experience in platform engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering (SRE), cloud infrastructure, or a closely related technical discipline, at Senior or Staff level.

  • Practical experience designing, deploying, and operating infrastructure in production environments, with a strong understanding of reliability, scalability, and security principles.

title: Senior Technical Recruiter
descriptionHtml:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You'll join Vibe's Talent Acquisition team inside the People org, initially reporting directly to Nicholas Wagner, Chief People Officer. The team owns hiring across Vibe as it pushes toward its 2030 growth targets, and this role is being created to give that effort an extra dedicated pair of hands in Paris. You'll get real ownership from day one: full-cycle recruiting on technical roles, direct partnership with hiring managers, and a seat at the table as the team builds. If you want to grow into a senior/lead technical recruiter inside a team that still feels small enough for your work to be visible, this is a good place to do it.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for Engineering and Product roles, from intake to offer.

  • Build sourcing pipelines for specialized technical profiles, including Data and ML roles.

  • Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements before opening a search.

  • Run structured candidate conversations that give hiring managers real signal.

  • Keep candidates informed and engaged at every stage of the process.

  • Track pipeline health and flag bottlenecks before they slow a search down.

  • Represent Vibe's culture and mission to candidates considering multiple offers.

     

What You Need

  • 8+ years of experience running full-cycle technical recruiting in a fast-growing company.

  • You've built candidate pipelines for specialized or hard-to-fill technical roles.

  • You've managed a hiring process end to end, from outreach through offer.

  • You communicate clearly with both candidates and engineering hiring managers.

     

Nice to Haves

  • Experience recruiting in the streaming TV advertising or connected TV (CTV) space.

  • A network within the Paris or broader European tech ecosystem.

  • Proven experience on Ashby ATS.

     

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

 

What We Offer

For candidates in France, the base pay range for this role is €60k–€90k, plus variable. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

 

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it.

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

     

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting.

  • Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

  • Manager interview — Meet the person you'd work with directly.

  • Live technical discussion — 60 min. A real Vibe search, worked through live with us: search strategy, candidate calibration, pipeline diagnosis. No take-home, no homework.

  • Engineering partner interview — 30 min. A live role intake with one of our engineering leaders.

  • Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar.

  • Offer — Fast. We don't let good decisions sit.

     

Equal Opportunity
