title: Senior Treasury Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Finom Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform. We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe. Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain. At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole. Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

We are looking for a Senior Treasury Manager to build and run Finom's treasury function.

Finom safeguards a significant book of customer funds across its regulated entities. Net interest income on that book is a meaningful revenue line, and it will grow. Today the function is up and running: the money is placed, the investment policy is in place, and a large part of the book sits with an external asset manager. What we are building now is the machinery around it — an evidenced limit framework, look-through into what our managers actually hold, automated investment accounting, and a reconciled NII number we can defend to an auditor and a regulator.

That is the job. You will take part in building it, and you will run it while it is being built.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of regulation, liquidity, and commercial impact — not a back-office position. It suits someone who has done this before in a regulated environment and wants to do it again without four layers of committee above them.


What you'll own

Liquidity and funding

  • Daily liquidity positioning and float management across entities and accounts
  • Intraday funding of payment channels; nostro and correspondent account management
  • Collateral and minimum-balance obligations across card schemes, T2, and credit providers
  • Contingency funding — the playbook for the day we need €20m by tomorrow morning
  • A daily treasury balance sheet — net liquidity and net capital available — that reconciles

    • Safeguarding and portfolio

  • Portfolio management of safeguarded client funds: term deposits, MMFs, short-dated debt, held directly and via external managers
  • Safeguarding adequacy: shortfall detection, top-up execution, same-currency discipline
  • Instrument eligibility screening under CRR risk-weight, maturity and WAL constraints, and UCITS/MMF rules
  • Independent, evidenced validation that externally managed allocations sit inside mandate — position-level look-through, daily monitoring of concentration, maturity, WAL and credit quality, breach escalation
  • NII forecasting, attribution, and reconciled performance reporting; treasury inputs into the financial model and company forecast

    • Governance and controls

  • Ownership of the investment policy, limit framework, and eligible-instrument register
  • Treasury governance: decision pack, agenda, decision log, and delegated-authority register
  • Pre-deal checks and post-trade evidencing, designed so that the first line executes and the second line challenges
  • Covenant tracking across credit facilities
  • Regulator, external audit, and second-line engagement on treasury and safeguarding matters

    • Systems and data

  • Selection and implementation of investment accounting and treasury tooling — a Clearwater/Advent-class implementation is already in flight and will be yours
  • Custodian, asset-manager and bank data feeds; API connectivity where it exists and pragmatic alternatives where it doesn't
  • Replacing manual spreadsheet processes with something that survives your holiday

    • Commercial

  • Bank, custodian, broker and asset-manager relationships: onboarding, commercial terms, mandate setting, service review
  • Challenging our managers on allocation, transparency and fees — and changing them if the answers are weak

    • What good looks like in the first 12 months
  • Investment policy and limit framework live, with treasury governance running on a documented decision log
  • Daily, evidenced mandate compliance across the full book — we can answer "are we inside the boundaries?" in minutes, not weeks
  • Investment accounting platform implemented; monthly close on the portfolio no longer manual
  • An NII number that is reconciled, attributed, and forecastable
  • A contingency liquidity playbook that has been tested rather than written

    • Who you are
  • 5+ years in treasury, ALM, fixed income, or portfolio management at a regulated financial institution, EMI/PI, or asset manager
  • Direct experience with client money or safeguarding under PSD2 / EMD — core to this role, not adjacent to it
  • Experience building or materially rebuilding a treasury function, not only operating inside an established one
  • Strong command of bond math, yield and duration, MMF mechanics, and credit and concentration risk at instrument level
  • Track record of automating manual treasury processes and implementing treasury or investment accounting systems
  • Comfortable working with position-level data directly — you can interrogate a portfolio file rather than wait for a report
  • Experience with regulators, external audit, and external asset managers (mandate setting, IMA terms, performance challenge)
  • Sound judgement under time pressure in a lean environment with real accountability and limited cover
  • Strong Excel skills
  • Fluent English

    • Nice to have

  • Familiarity with IFRS 9 or Dutch GAAP (RJ 290) financial instrument accounting
  • SQL or Python
  • Experience in a firm transitioning toward a banking licence
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g. LLMs, copilots) to accelerate analytical and reporting workflows

title: Software Developer, Quantitative Platform
descriptionHtml:
About Winton

Winton is a research-based investment management company with a specialist focus on statistical and mathematical inference in financial markets. The firm researches and trades quantitative investment strategies, which are implemented systematically via thousands of securities, spanning the world's major liquid asset classes. Founded in 1997 by David Harding, Winton today manages assets for some of the world’s largest institutional investors.

We employ ambitious professionals who want to work collaboratively at the leading edge of investment management.

 

We seek a highly skilled developer with strong computer science fundamentals to join our Quantitative Platform team. This team is responsible for developing the core platforms that underpin and provide data to the research and trading of our quantitative investment strategies, alongside tools, APIs, libraries, and user interfaces to support this.

In this role you will work closely with our research and other technology teams to deliver high impact projects that improve our ability to predict and trade movements in global financial markets.

Our Technology 

Operating in a cloud-first environment, we predominantly write our backend systems in C# but otherwise make pragmatic choices for each scenario. This often means Python with C++ employed in performance-sensitive cases.

Our applications are written with containerisation in mind from the outset and deployed as a Docker image into Kubernetes on AWS where we can scale on-demand to satisfy burstable workloads. We make extensive use of Kafka for low-latency communication across applications and use a mixture of different technologies for storage, from S3 to relational databases. We utilise GitHub for source control and Jenkins for CI, though with an increasing interest in GitHub Actions.

We constantly evaluate our stack to ensure we’re using the most appropriate technologies for the needs of our business and the efficient delivery of those requirements.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Build and maintain a world-class platform that enables storage, transformation, and testing of data at scale by leveraging the latest open-source software, cloud, and distributed computing technologies.
  • Gain a deep understanding of the requirements of our research teams to deliver business-critical functionality in a timely-manner.
  • Collaborate with the team through active contribution in code reviews, knowledge-sharing, and design discussions.
  • Write and maintain good quality, well-tested code across services, data storage and UI layers.

What we're Looking For:

  • A Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics or equivalent technical field. 
  • 2+ years of professional software development experience, including C#, Python or C++
  • Comfortable using agentic AI coding tools such as Claude Code and are genuinely keen to use them as a natural part of daily work
  • Collaborative nature and ability to work in a team e.g., partnering with portfolio managers, quantitative researchers, and other technologists.
  • Strong interest in keeping abreast of latest technologies and a measured approach for adopting them.
  • Comfortable with problem solving across multiple technologies and business domains.

What would Be Useful:

  • Experience engineering systems for the cloud-based storage and processing of large datasets or using frameworks such as Spark and open standards like Parquet and Arrow.
  • Experience working with other cloud and related technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience working as a software developer in the quantitative hedge fund space.
  • Experience building web applications using front-end frameworks such as Angular.
 

Equal Opportunity Workplace

We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Software Engineer, Prime
descriptionHtml:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems.We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The Prime team's mission is to build Bitstamp's prime brokerage for institutional clients — the platform that lets hedge funds, market makers, and professional trading firms fund, trade, borrow against, and settle positions at scale. We build the systems that move real institutional money: cross-venue settlement, credit against collateral, matched-book lending, and the bridge that brings tokenized securities to our order book. These are correctness-critical systems where a wrong answer can't be cheaply undone — getting them right is the whole job.

We are looking for a Backend Engineer to join our team. As a Backend Engineer, you will lead the backend development process for core components and build services from inception to deployment. This individual will be helping solve correctness, scaling, and reliability challenges on a backend-first, high-performance, and world-class institutional trading platform.

This role is based in our London office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. 

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

Requires participation in an on-call rotation to support business needs.

What you’ll do

  • Design and ship production services: Implement and operate resilient backend services and subsystems that move institutional money — contributing to flows such as cross-venue settlement, collateral credit, matched-book lending, and order execution.
  • Author focused technical specs: Draft clear technical designs for new features and components, explicitly defining data invariants, error handling, state boundaries, and recovery mechanisms before writing code.
  • Build for failure: Write clean, idiomatic, and thoroughly tested code, pairing production features with rigorous unit/integration tests, sensible monitoring, structured logging, and targeted alerts.
  • Maintain operational health: Actively participate in the team's on-call rotation, debug production anomalies, and contribute to blameless post-mortems and remediation work to harden our platform.
  • Collaborate and review: Participate in architectural discussions and provide thoughtful, constructive code reviews to help maintain high code quality and consistency across the team.

What you bring

  • Proven backend track record: Solid experience independently designing, implementing, and maintaining backend services in a production environment, taking full ownership of what you ship.
  • Correctness-critical mindset: Hands-on experience with financial, transactional, or distributed systems (e.g., payments, ledgers, trading, order management, or inventory engines) where data integrity is paramount and mistakes are costly.
  • Systems fundamentals: Strong understanding of distributed systems and transactional boundaries, including relational data modeling (PostgreSQL), data consistency, idempotency, and asynchronous workflows/message queues.
  • Defensive engineering: Good design judgment and an instinct to test failure paths; you think about race conditions, boundary failures, and network partitions rather than just the happy path.
  • Language fluency: Proficiency in a modern backend language (such as Python or Go), with the ability to quickly get up to speed on our core stack (Python/Django and Go).
  • Clear communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills; you can clearly explain technical trade-offs, document system behaviors, and collaborate effectively with peers and cross-functional partners.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career and shape the future of global institutional finance
  • Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership
  • Top-tier health benefits to fuel your work, including 100% employer-paid private medical insurance for you and comprehensive coverage for dependents, alongside mental health and wellbeing support programs
  • Pension Scheme with highly competitive company matching to secure your future
  • Lifestyle Wallet: A highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account to offset expenses like wellness, learning, childcare, and more
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market with continuous AI skill-building opportunities for all employees
  • Time to recharge: Generous paid time off, company holidays, sick time, parental leave, and paid volunteer time off

title: Sr Product Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Axon's mission is simple and bold: Protect Life.

We build technology that helps first responders, security teams and communities act with speed, clarity and confidence in the moments that matter most. Our Real-Time Operations (RTO) portfolio, anchored by the Fusus platform, is transforming how law enforcement, enterprise security and international agencies detect, assess and respond to threats.

Fusus connects live video, alerts, sensors and location data into a unified operating picture, and the map is where that picture comes together. It shows where every officer, vehicle, camera, drone and sensor is, what state it is in, and what is happening around it. We're building a map that stays clear under pressure, so operators and responders can see what matters and act in seconds.

Your Impact

As Senior Product Manager for Maps & Presence, you will define and lead the roadmap for how Fusus shows the world in real time. You'll own the live map, floor plans and the presence layer: the "dots on the map" that tell operators who and what is where, and whether that information is fresh.

You'll own the map experience operators use every shift and the map services every other team builds on. Your work will let any device, sensor or data source appear on the map in a consistent way, without bespoke work for each one. That spans body cameras, fleet vehicles, drones, CCTV, sensors and third-party devices, indoors and outdoors.

You'll also lead the map in Axon's next generation of Fusus: role-based experiences built from shared components, where every role gets a map designed for its job. Your work will help responders find the nearest resource, follow an incident as it moves and reconstruct what happened afterwards, directly advancing Axon's mission to Protect Life.

Work Location: This role is based out of our London office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Maps & Presence product roadmap, focused on a map that is clear, consistent and fast to act from
  • Define one behavior model for every real-time dot on the map (how each device type looks, clusters, shows state and freshness) and retire legacy formats
  • Own the map services and contracts (layers, geo-boundaries, floor plans, the Presence API) that let other teams put new data on the map through self-service
  • Build self-service floor plans and map layers for customer admins, so setup no longer depends on Support or Professional Services
  • Lead the map and floor-plan components for Fusus's role-based experiences, shipping them in today's Fusus first
  • Deliver location history (breadcrumbs) and cross-camera tracking for investigations, with Search and video teams
  • Partner with engineering and design to ship responsive, low-latency and reliable map experiences across web and mobile
  • Engage law enforcement and enterprise users in real-time crime centers and the field to validate needs and test improvements
  • Use metrics and feedback to set priorities: dot freshness, map load time, presence coverage, time from alert to action
  • Support go-to-market, training and rollout with cross-functional teams

What Success Looks Like

  • Operators trust what they see on the map: every device looks and behaves the same way, and stale data is obvious
  • New devices and data sources appear on the map in days, without map-team engineering work
  • Customers set up their own floor plans and layers, and filter the map to what matters to them
  • Adoption grows across customer segments with high daily use, strong retention and positive field feedback
  • Every second saved contributes to safer outcomes for officers, teams and the public

What You Bring

  • 6–8+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years on map-based, location or real-time products
  • Experience building products where speed, clarity and reliability directly affect outcomes
  • Strong grasp of geospatial and presence concepts: map rendering and clustering, layers and tiles, geofences, indoor mapping, location data quality and freshness
  • Familiarity with live video, sensor networks, fleet or asset tracking, drones and IoT integrations
  • Experience with platform products that other teams build on, including APIs and data contracts
  • Track record of turning user insight into clear product direction and focused execution
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through roadmap, design, delivery and iteration
  • Clear communicator who drives alignment, decisions and measurable outcomes

Why Axon

  • Shape the future of how responders and security teams see and act on the world around them, creating safer outcomes for communities and organisations
  • Join a mission-driven company with a history of innovation and impact
  • Work alongside passionate teams building technology that protects lives

Benefits that Benefit You

  • Competitive base salary and RSUs
  • Pension plan with matching contributions
  • Private health insurance and cash plans
  • 30 days paid holiday plus UK public holidays
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave
  • GymPass subscription
  • Life assurance and income protection
  • Career growth, learning support, and wellness resources

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

title: Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation.

You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes.
  • Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure.
  • Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention.
  • Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact.
  • Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures, including regulated environments such as GovCloud.
  • Participate in operational ownership and incident response, using incidents and near misses to drive durable architectural improvements.
  • Mentor engineers, raise the quality of infrastructure design and operational judgment, and establish patterns that can be adopted across the organization.
  • Clearly communicate architecture, trade-offs, risks, and migration plans to technical and organizational stakeholders.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role.

  • 6+ years of experience designing and building software, infrastructure, or distributed systems, including operating critical systems in production.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of the following: compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud infrastructure control planes.
  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals in Go, Python, Java, or a similar language.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major public cloud platform; AWS experience is preferred.
  • Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, to safely manage production infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of capacity management, failure domains, observability, rollout safety, and production recovery.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams and through ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Designing and operating large-scale compute or container platforms such as ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration systems.
  • Designing and operating stateful distributed systems such as Kafka, OpenSearch, managed databases, caching, or large-scale storage platforms.
  • Building internal infrastructure platforms, control planes, or self-service developer experiences adopted across multiple teams.
  • Designing multi-account or multi-region cloud architectures with strong workload isolation and disaster recovery.
  • Leading major infrastructure migrations while maintaining availability and controlling operational risk.
  • Delivering measurable improvements in infrastructure capacity, cost efficiency, or developer self-service.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

title: Staff Backend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

Your decisions here won't get lost in a big system. They'll define it.

As Staff Backend Engineer for Manychat for Brands, you’ll own the technical side of a new product. You’ll set the architecture and technical priorities with the team, and decide what lives in our Python services and what stays in the PHP-based Manychat platform. It’s an individual contributor role with a lot of room to make an impact.

The product fills a real gap. Brands pay influencers to post but then can’t see what happens next. We’re building the first view that shows it: who asked for the link, who opened the DM, who clicked, for every campaign, creator and post.

You’ll work with Product as a partner and stay close to brands and creators, so feedback reaches you fast and helps you shape Manychat for Brands.

Sound like you? Let’s talk!

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

Meet the Engineering team:

We keep Manychat running smoothly under high load every single day and make sure it's ready to scale even further. We do it by combining strong engineering foundations with AI tools that let us move faster without cutting corners. And we're the ones who shape and own what gets built. AI accelerates. Humans own the thinking.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

  • Set the architecture and technical priorities for Brands together with the Engineering Manager and the team: service boundaries, data models, authentication, access control, and integration with the core Manychat platform.

  • Decide which logic belongs in the Python-based Brands services and which stays in the PHP-based Manychat platform. Think about data ownership, reliability, and long-term maintenance.

  • Lead big system-level changes when the path isn't clear yet. Explore options, split the work into measurable milestones, and plan data migrations, gradual rollouts, and rollbacks.

  • Define reliability and performance requirements for key Brands workflows. Set metrics and observability, and check the impact of your changes on production data.

  • Find the root causes of slowdowns and repeated incidents across service boundaries, using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing.

  • Work with Security, Infrastructure, and Platform teams on solutions. Decide what to fix in the application and what needs other teams, and explain the trade-offs clearly.

  • Work with Product on the approach and scope of solutions, and suggest simpler options when you see them.

  • Make technical decisions easy to follow: document key choices and the reasons behind them, do thorough design and code reviews, and share your knowledge in complex areas.

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

You'll need:

  • Deep expertise in Python backend development and a broad view of backend architecture beyond one language. You can understand existing systems, even when the technology is new to you.

  • A strong product mindset. You work closely with Product Managers, challenge assumptions, and explain technical trade-offs in terms of user experience, timelines, and product capabilities.

  • Experience owning the architecture and production operations of a product or a large technical area, not only delivering separate features.

  • A solid understanding of distributed systems and data flows: API contracts, async processing, data consistency, retries, idempotency, and failure handling.

  • Knowledge of how backend applications are deployed and run in production: configuration, networking, and external dependencies.

  • Knowledge of application security basics: authentication, authorization, data isolation, and access management.

  • Comfort in a fast-changing environment. Things can shift quickly here, and the team relies on everyone's proactivity and ownership.

  • Strong English for technical and product discussions and for documentation.

It would be great if you have:

  • Hands-on PHP experience, on top of understanding how our Python and PHP systems work together.

  • Experience with ETL/DWH pipelines and analytics systems.

  • Experience with environment configuration, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code.

  • Experience improving AI-assisted software development practices.

Our tech stack: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Celery. Our services integrate with Manychat's PHP-based platform. Everything runs on AWS and Kubernetes, with Terraform/Terragrunt for infrastructure. You don't need hands-on experience with every tool. Technical depth and the ability to reason about complex systems matter most.

WHAT WE OFFER 🤗

We care deeply about your growth, well-being, and comfort:

  • 🌍 Hybrid onboarding to start work remotely and relocation support for you and your family.

  • 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family.

  • 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow.

  • 🫶 Flexible benefits package: no one-size-fits-all perks here. You get a budget and you decide where it goes, from health and wellbeing to family and setting up your home office.

  • 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota.

  • 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks.

  • 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events.

  • 🤖 AI isn't a perk here — it's how we work. Claude, OpenAI, and more are on by default from day one, and we back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster.

descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Staff Software Engineer

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo’s growth at scale.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our London, UK - Hybrid (3 days from the office) team. In this role, you’ll help us define technical solutions for critical business problems and lead the technical direction for complex, high-scale systems.

Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining a high-impact engineering group focused on solving unstructured and ambiguous challenges. You will act as a technical authority, aligning non-adjacent teams to deliver results that move the needle for the entire organisation.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Drive Technical Excellence: Improve code structure and architecture across your team’s remit, developing, releasing and running large-scale web applications whilst transitioning our monolithic codebase to a microservice-based architecture

  • Lead Project Planning: Foresee dependencies and risks, partnering closely with Product and Design to ensure smooth delivery of complex features, whilst defining the backend architecture and tech stack for a product area

  • Optimise Operations:Improve performance, reliability, scalability and security for our backend systems

  • Collaborate & Influence: Build relationships across global engineering teams to identify collaboration opportunities and influence the wider technical roadmap.

  • Mentor & Hire: Support the personal growth of your colleagues through technical guidance and take an active role in conducting engineering interviews to scale our team.

title: Stage: Optimalisatie Processen Industry
descriptionHtml:
Over Nedlin

Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen.

De stageopdrachten

Tijdens deze stage binnen Nedlin Industry ga je aan de slag met een actueel vraagstuk uit onze dagelijkse operatie. Je onderzoekt waar verbeterkansen liggen, brengt processen en knelpunten in kaart en werkt jouw bevindingen uit tot concrete verbetervoorstellen.

Afhankelijk van jouw interesse kun je kiezen uit één van de volgende stageopdrachten:

  1. Klantcompleetheid verbeteren
    Onderzoek waar en waarom klantorders niet volledig worden geleverd, breng knelpunten binnen productie en expeditie in kaart en werk concrete verbeteringen.

  2. Transportkosten reduceren
    Analyseer transportkosten en routes, onderzoek de beladingsgraad en leverfrequenties en breng mogelijke kostenbesparingen in kaart.

  3. Doorlooptijden magazijn verbeteren
    Breng de magazijnprocessen in kaart, identificeer wachttijden en onnodige handelingen en werk verbeteringen uit om de doorlooptijd te verkorten.

  4. Gebruik van AI binnen de organisatie
    Onderzoek de mogelijkheden voor AI binnen de organisatie, bepaal kansrijke toepassingen voor de dagelijkse operatie en werk deze concreet uit.

  5. Werkinstructies vouwers en inpak verbeteren
    Beoordeel de huidige werkinstructies en onderzoek hoe deze eenvoudiger, duidelijker en visueler kunnen worden gemaakt voor medewerkers.

Wat bieden wij?

descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez à découvrir un métier apprenant qui fait sens ? A bénéficier d'un encadrement technique fort ? Rejoignez le Groupe Fondasol en tant qu'Ingénieur Stagiaire et entrez dans une dimension favorisant la synergie de ses métiers et mobilisant données du sous-sol et révolution digitale.

Pourquoi choisir le Groupe Fondasol ?

Vous allez bénéficier d’un encadrement technique fort et prendre part à une grande diversité de projets dans un environnement proposant des outils de travail digitaux innovants et permettant d’agir sur l’empreinte carbone des projets. Ouvert à tous, femmes et hommes de talent, le Groupe Fondasol favorise l'égalité des chances et la diversité.

Envie d’en savoir plus sur nos métiers? Consulter nos vidéos

Alors, prêt à devenir Fondasolien? Nous sommes impatients de découvrir votre candidature.

Description de l'entreprise

1958, Fondasol réalise avec succès sa première mission géotechnique.

Aujourd'hui, avec plus de 10 domaines d'expertise, le Groupe Fondasol est la référence en études et ingénierie conseil de la construction.

Géotechnique, hydrogéologie, géothermie, sites et sols pollués, géophysique, études de structures…: ses collaborateurs mutualisent leurs compétences pour aider les acteurs de la construction à bâtir durablement leurs projets.

Grâce à son actionnariat salarié majoritaire, le Groupe Fondasol continue de renforcer les synergies entre ses expertises, crée des outils digitaux innovants, décarbone ses activités…

Autant dire qu'ici, passion de son métier, engagement, évolution… sont des évidences.

title: Startup Operations Generalist
descriptionHtml:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

We are growing fast and opening a second lab in London. Every new person, contract, invoice and payroll run lands on someone's desk. You own that desk.

This is the operations generalist seat: finance admin, payroll, people operations, hiring logistics, and whatever else the company needs to run well. You own the machinery so that everyone else spends their time on the lab.

This is not a strategy role and not a pure HR role. It is hands-on, and most of the work is making sure things happen correctly and on time, then making sure they happen without you next time.

What You'll Do

  • Run payroll and people admin. Monthly payroll and the relationship with our payroll provider, contracts, onboarding and offboarding, benefits and pension, leave and absence. Every person gets paid correctly and every new hire has a laptop, accounts and a contract on day one.

  • Run the finance back office. Supplier invoices and payment runs, customer invoicing and collections, expense and card reconciliation, and the monthly hand-off to our external accountants.

  • Keep hiring moving. Interview scheduling, candidate logistics, NDAs, work-trial setup and offer paperwork in Ashby. You make sure the hiring process never stalls.

  • Keep us compliant. Swiss and UK employment rules, permits and visas, insurance, VAT filings, company registers. You are not a lawyer or an accountant, but you know when to call one and you make sure deadlines never surprise us.

  • Own general operations. Office and lab-site logistics, vendor and software contracts, renewals, company-wide tools and access. When something is nobody's job, it is yours until it has an owner.

  • Automate all of the above. Payroll, invoicing, our ATS and our ledger all have APIs. The goal is that each process you take over runs with less manual work every quarter.

What We're Looking For

  • You have run operations at a fast-growing startup. Several years covering some mix of finance admin, payroll, HR and office operations, ideally as the first or second person doing it. You have built processes, not only followed them.

  • Detail-obsessed. A wrong payslip or a missed filing is a real problem for a real person. You check the numbers before anyone asks.

  • AI-native. It's 2026. We run on Claude Code across the company, and you use AI tools and scripts to automate your own work. You check what they produce and stand behind the result. The more software engineering experience you have, the better. If your instinct is that operations is a spreadsheet-and-inbox job, we will frustrate each other.

  • Swiss or UK employment and payroll experience is a plus. Social charges, pension, permits.

  • Self-starter. Nobody hands you a prioritized queue. You see what is broken or about to break, and you fix it.

  • Trustworthy with everything. Salaries, contracts, personal data and company finances all cross your desk.

  • English required.

Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

title: Strategic Account Director, Industrials (EMEA)
descriptionHtml:
About Sayari: 

Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.

The Role

We are hiring a Strategic Account Director to take Superconductor to tier-1 industrials across EMEA. Some of these accounts already use Sayari. Others are new, and you will win them with your experience, your network, and your existing book of business.

You will be among the first to sell Superconductor into this vertical, with a Forward Deployed Engineer and an established global organization behind you. Targets are multiyear agreements of $2M+, with adoption extended across each account’s adjacent buying centers.

What You Will Do

  • Win new key logos: use your network and book of business to open tier-1 industrial accounts, and take each from first conversation to signed multiyear agreement. Build your own pipeline through your network, targeted outreach, and practitioner communities.
  • Grow existing accounts: take Superconductor into tier-1 customers that already use Sayari, moving them from a single use case to enterprise-wide deployment across the Commercial World Model and Superconductor agents.
  • Map the buying centers: build relationships across supply chain and procurement, trade compliance and sanctions, legal, risk, investigations, and IT. Think Chief Procurement Officers, Chief Supply Chain Officers, Heads of Trade Compliance, Chief Risk Officers, Chief Compliance Officers, and General Counsel.
  • Prove, then scale: work with Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and the forward-deployed engineers and analysts dedicated to your accounts to get Superconductor workflows into production with top customers, then use those results as references to unlock further budget.
  • Shape the playbook and roadmap: refine how we position and sell into industrials, and bring buyer feedback to Product and Engineering.
  • Forecast accurately: run a structured pipeline (MEDDPICC, Challenger, or Miller Heimann) and give leadership a forecast they can plan against.

What You Bring

  • 15+ years in large-cap industrials (for example aerospace and defence, automotive, chemicals, capital goods, or energy equipment), at or near C-suite level, with a verifiable network in the sector.
  • An existing book of business and relationships with tier-1 industrials that you can bring to Sayari.
  • A record of closing multimillion-dollar, multiyear agreements, through both new key logos and expansion of existing accounts, that you can walk through in named detail.
  • Depth in supply chain, procurement, trade compliance, and risk, including supply chain due diligence rules, forced labour import restrictions, sanctions, and export controls.
  • Executive presence: you can explain data provenance and AI reasoning to non-technical senior stakeholders and be treated as a peer.
  • Command of structured sales methodology in multithreaded deals involving procurement and legal review.
  • Interest in agentic AI and the ability to explain what it can and cannot yet do. You do not need to be technical.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% across EMEA.

Nice to Have

  • German speaker

Why Sayari

  • Uncapped earnings: commission with accelerators on expansion revenue and no bonus caps.
  • A product that shows its work: agentic AI that traces every finding to a primary source.
  • Seniority: you are the senior domain voice on an established sales team, with room to shape how the vertical is worked.
  Sayari is an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply. We believe diversity and inclusion mean our team members should reflect the diversity of the United States. No employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, religion, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability status, veteran status, genetics, or political affiliation. We strongly encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply.

title: Strategic Account Manager – Enterprise Hospitality (Marseille)
descriptionHtml:
Lightspeed is looking for an experienced, strategically minded Strategic Account Manager to develop, engage, and closely support our most important enterprise customers in the hospitality segment over the long term. This role is remote-based in Marseille, France, with occasional travel to our Paris office.

In this role, you will act as the primary point of contact for our largest hospitality customers in France. You will be responsible for driving growth, product adoption, and stakeholder management within your portfolio, with the goal of building true business partnerships. You will leverage data, customer feedback, and your SaaS expertise to create value at the enterprise level, while collaborating closely with teams across the business.



What you’ll do

  • Act as the main point of contact for our largest and most strategic hospitality customers

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans to drive growth, retention, and product adoption

  • Proactively work on increasing product usage and ensure Net Revenue Retention (NRR) grows across your portfolio

  • Plan and lead quarterly business reviews and success plans

  • Analyze usage data, go-live milestones, and health scores to identify and mitigate risks early

  • Build strong, trusted relationships with C-level and operational stakeholders, positioning Lightspeed as a long-term strategic partner

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, Implementation, and Support teams to deliver an excellent customer experience

  • Collect customer feedback and proactively share it with relevant teams to identify product gaps and optimize the overall customer journey


What you bring

  • 3–5+ years of experience in Account Management or Strategic Customer Success within a B2B SaaS environment, ideally with enterprise customers

  • A strong understanding of SaaS metrics (NRR, product adoption, expansion, renewals, churn) and the ability to use them to manage your portfolio

  • A strong sense of ownership; you are hands-on, data-driven, and highly skilled in relationship management

  • Experience managing complex, multi-level stakeholder structures and confidently engaging with C-level, operations, and technical teams

  • Fluent business-level French and English

  • Experience in the hospitality, POS, or hospitality tech industry is a plus, but not required


What’s in it for you?

Come live the Lightspeed experience…

  • Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day

  • Work in a team large enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact

  • Exposure to modern and proven technology

  • Ability to work and grow in a truly flexible environment

  • Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

  • Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health

  • Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform

  • People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year 

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Health insurance with attractive guarantee plans

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

title: Strategy Analytics Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

Zable is revolutionising the credit card industry by making financial tools accessible, intuitive, and empowering. Zable is a Mobile-App first credit card that empowers customers to build their credit score while meeting their spending and borrowing needs sustainably.

We’re looking for an analytical, commercially-minded Strategy Analytics Manager to help us grow and scale the product exponentially. This is a dynamic role where you’ll tackle high impact business problems across a number of disciplines including pricing, financial forecasting, growth, credit risk, new product development and product analytics.

You’ll work cross-functionally to deliver insight-driven strategies that optimise performance, drive responsible growth, and put the customer at the heart of decision-making.

You’ll operate in a fast-paced environment where ideas matter more than hierarchy, and execution beats bureaucracy. Your work will directly influence who we serve, how we grow, and how we deliver sustainable value.

  

Your impact

  • Drive promotions & pricing strategy: Develop and optimise promotional and pricing strategies through data-driven analysis and experimentation, balancing customer engagement, growth, price elasticity and profitability while continuously refining approaches based on product performance and scenario modelling. Build deep insight into marketing campaign and conversion funnel performance, identifying opportunities to improve cost and conversion efficiency. Stay abreast of industry trends and competitor activity to ensure our products remain fit for purpose.

  • Financial forecasting & portfolio analytics: Collaborate closely with the Credit Risk Analytics, Growth and Data Science teams to understand how our products and portfolio are performing at a granular sub-segment level. Define key KPIs and develop detailed monitoring to track performance against these goals, and deliver actionable recommendations to improve outcomes. Use strategic analysis to shape and influence broader business strategy.

  • Evaluate expansion opportunities: Navigate through ambiguity to assess the feasibility of new product, channel and segment expansion opportunities. Create robust commercial assessment frameworks, build tooling where necessary (e.g. RoI or NPV models) and extract data to support these assessments and deliver clear, insight-driven recommendations.

  • Influence & execution: Collaborate with stakeholders across Credit Risk, Data Science, Product and Growth to bring your strategies to life. Present insights and recommendations to senior leadership - clear, concise, and backed by data. Approach every conversation with an open mind, valuing the strength of ideas over ego or hierarchy. Ensure your implemented strategies are working as intended once deployed in production, validating outcomes and iterating as needed.

  • Build & mentor a small team of analysts: In time, you will hire, develop and mentor a small team of high-calibre analysts, fostering both technical growth and strategic thinking. Build a culture where people seamlessly collaborate across functions, challenge the status quo, and consistently deliver best-in-class, customer-first solutions.

  

Your experience

  • 3+ years of experience in an analytics role in any discipline (e.g. Growth, Credit Risk, Product Analytics, Marketing, etc.)

  • Proficiency in coding - ideally SQL and Python

  • [Bonus] Experience in managing or mentoring analytical teams

  • [Bonus] Experience in an FCA-regulated financial services firm

Life at Zable

  • The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

title: Strategy - Future Leaders Graduate Program
descriptionHtml:
Kurz und knapp

Du kommst frisch aus dem Studium und bist bereit, direkt ins Herz unseres Businesses einzusteigen? Komplexe Challenges schrecken dich nicht ab - sondern motivieren dich erst recht? Dann gehörst du ins Consumer Team von Picnic. Unser 1-jähriges Trainee Programm ist kein Warm-up, sondern dein echtes Launchpad. Du startest direkt ohne Rotation in einer Consumer-Rolle - ob Category Management, Store, Meals oder Customer, je nachdem wo deine Stärken und Interessen liegen.

Ab Tag eins arbeitest du mit echten Daten, übernimmst Verantwortung und treibst Projekte voran, die sichtbar Impact haben. Parallel dazu investieren wir gezielt in dich: mit Trainings zu Marktverständnis, Business-Knowledge und Präsentations-Skills.

Und weil Erfolg gemeinsam mehr Spaß macht, wirst du Teil einer eng vernetzten Graduate-Community - smart, ambitioniert und immer bereit, Dinge neu zu denken.

Kurz gesagt: Wenn du nicht nur mitlaufen, sondern deinen Berufseinstieg aktiv mitgestalten willst - Welcome to Picnic! 

Das erwartet dich

  • Teamwork: Gemeinsam mit unseren Category Managern, Designern, Copywritern und Tech-Teams bringst du alle Köpfe an einen Tisch. Das Ergebnis: ein App-Erlebnis, das nicht nur reibungslos funktioniert, sondern unsere Kunden begeistert.
  • Analyse: Zahlen sind dein Kompass. Aus Kundenverhalten leitest du smarte Insights ab, verbesserst App-Features, schärfst unser Pricing und entwickelst Aktionen, die einfach überzeugen.
  • Innovation: Du denkst einen Schritt weiter. Trends und Kundenbedürfnisse erkennst du früh und sorgst dafür, dass sich unser Sortiment ständig weiterentwickelt.
  • Optimierung: Mit einem Blick fürs Detail entwickelst du Tools und Prozesse, die unsere kommerziellen Aktivitäten effizienter, präziser und wirkungsvoller machen.
  • Projekte: Du steuerst cross-funktionale Projekte - von Marketing über Customer Experience bis hin zu Operational Excellence. Immer mit dem Ziel, Wachstum voranzutreiben und echten Mehrwert für unsere Kunden zu schaffen. 

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Masterstudium im MINT-Bereich (z.B. Ingenieurwesen, Physik, Mathematik, Ökonometrie) oder im Bereich Wirtschaftswissenschaften (z. B. Wirtschaft, Finanzen, Betriebswirtschaft)
  • Eine ausgeprägte Zahlenaffinität und analytische Fähigkeiten
  • Erste Berufserfahrung durch Praktika oder Werkstudierendentätigkeiten, idealerweise in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld (z. B. Start-up, Beratung oder FMCG-Branche)
  • Bereitschaft, operative Aufgaben selbst in die Hand zu nehmen
  • Motivation, von Tag eins an volle Verantwortung für deine Themen zu übernehmen
  • Fließende Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch, um dich in unserem internationalen Umfeld zu verständigen
  • Bereitschaft, vier bis fünf Tage pro Woche in unserem brandneuen Büro in Düsseldorf zu arbeiten

Darauf kannst du dich freuen 

  • Starte mit uns durch: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Treibe Projekte eigenständig voran, teste neue Ideen und profitiere von Trainings, während du den Erfolg unseres Unternehmens direkt mitgestaltest.
  • Verpflegung: Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück und Mittagessen in unserem Büro, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Ein moderner Workspace: Unser neu renoviertes Büro ist auf Zusammenarbeit ausgelegt und bietet dir flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie 30 Urlaubstage
  • Individuelle Mobilität: Du entscheidest, wie du zu uns kommst. Wir bieten ein subventioniertes Deutschlandticket und ein „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm an.
  • Wohlbefinden & Gleichgewicht: Wir bieten dir professionelle Unterstützung für deine mentale Gesundheit mit OpenUp. Und dank unseres hundefreundlichen Büros ist dein vierbeiniger Begleiter nach Absprache willkommen.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und unsere Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.

Dein Start bei uns

  • In unserem ersten Call besprechen wir gemeinsam, welches Startdatum am besten für dich passt. Je früher du dich bewirbst, desto besser!
  • Schick uns deine Bewerbung gern auf Englisch, wenn du schon eine englische Version parat hast.

title: Supply Chain Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

Achieving this ambitious goal requires more than innovative engineering — it requires a supply chain capable of turning complex technologies into reliable, manufacturable solutions.

As a Supply Chain Engineer, you'll serve as the critical technical link between our Engineering teams and external suppliers, ensuring components, materials, and systems can be sourced, manufactured, and delivered to meet our development needs. You'll own technical sourcing assessments and supplier readiness across one or two assigned technology domains, such as Laser, Targetry, Chamber, or Core Engineering.

Working closely with Engineering, Strategic Procurement, and Quality Management, you'll bring supplier capabilities and manufacturing expertise into the development process early, identifying technical challenges, assessing manufacturability, and addressing supply risks before they become costly delays. This is an opportunity to apply your engineering expertise in a highly collaborative, fast-moving environment where your technical judgment directly influences project readiness and our ability to scale.

What You'll Do

  • Own Technical Sourcing Readiness: Lead technical feasibility and sourcing-readiness assessments across your assigned technology domain, evaluating supplier capabilities, manufacturing processes, and technical requirements from early development through sourcing readiness.

  • Connect Engineering with Suppliers: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for suppliers within your domain, partnering with Engineering and Strategic Procurement to identify, assess, and engage potential suppliers.

  • Drive Early Supplier Involvement: Bring supplier manufacturing expertise into the development process early, identifying manufacturability challenges and opportunities before designs are finalized.

  • Translate Engineering Requirements: Work with Engineering to clarify incomplete or ambiguous specifications, drawings, and technical requirements to ensure they are accurate and ready for sourcing.

  • Develop Supplier Readiness: Build and track technical supplier development and qualification plans in partnership with Supplier Quality, ensuring suppliers have the capabilities and readiness needed to support development milestones.

  • Improve Manufacturability and Cost: Collaborate with Engineering and suppliers to identify opportunities to improve manufacturing processes, reduce complexity, optimize costs, and minimize lead times.

  • Inform Supplier Selection: Provide technical assessments, supplier capability insights, and recommendations to support Strategic Procurement's supplier evaluation and award decisions.

  • Manage Technical Supply Risks: Identify and proactively escalate supplier capacity constraints, long lead times, technical dependencies, and other risks that could impact project timelines.

  • Enable Cross-Functional Alignment: Maintain clear technical documentation, supplier readiness information, and risk assessments to support effective handovers between Engineering, Procurement, and Quality.

Who You Are

  • You have a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • You bring experience in engineering, technical sourcing, supplier development, manufacturing engineering, or a related role within a complex technical or industrial environment.

  • You have a strong understanding of relevant manufacturing technologies, materials, processes, and supplier capabilities within your area of expertise.

  • You can evaluate technical specifications, engineering drawings, and manufacturing requirements, identifying gaps, ambiguities, and potential manufacturability challenges.

  • You have experience assessing supplier technical capabilities, manufacturing capacity, and readiness, ideally within highly engineered products, advanced manufacturing, or complex system development.

  • You understand how to balance technical requirements, manufacturability, cost, and lead-time considerations to support effective sourcing decisions.

  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and exercising independent technical judgment, knowing when to resolve an issue directly and when to escalate decisions requiring Engineering, Quality, or commercial approval.

  • You are a proactive communicator who can translate complex technical findings into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • You thrive in cross-functional environments, building trusted relationships with engineers, suppliers, procurement professionals, and quality teams.

  • You demonstrate strong ownership and follow-through, taking responsibility for technical sourcing readiness within your domain and ensuring risks and open issues are addressed early.

  • You enjoy working in a growing organization where you can help establish processes, strengthen supplier relationships, and contribute to building a scalable supply chain.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
