title: Talent Lead at AIOS- Remote, $100-200k inc equity
descriptionHtml:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Talent Lead at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team. As Talent Lead at AIOS, your fundamental role is to supercharge our talent (recruiting) function, ensuring that a lack of key hires never blocks growth. You’ll help define what a killer sourcing process looks like while leveraging frontier tooling to increase your throughput and velocity as you recruit best-in-class operators.

You’ll work across a variety of roles: traditional direct-to-consumer Growth roles (Performance Marketing), technical roles (AI + SWE Engineering & Product), and clinical roles — flexing deftly between more junior roles all the way up to the most senior roles in the org.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice — as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday. You’ll have flex in your calendar for kids if you have them — many of our team have kids so we’re kid-friendly.

This is an individual-contributor role — no direct reports, full-cycle sourcing/screening/closing, hands dirty in the trenches. You’ll report directly to Cierra Olsen (Head of Talent).

You’ll also work closely with the rest of the Talent Team: Zoe Wheeler (UK Talent Lead), Mika Mansilla (Founder Associate), and Jordan Pellikan (VP Ops).

Key responsibilities

  • Full cycle: Own searches end to end from sourcing, outbound, screening, interview coordination, calibration, and closing (recent examples: Head of InfoSec, Head of Creative, Senior Media Buyer, Affiliate Lead).

  • Sourcing: Build repeatable sourcing engines for hard-to-fill roles. Run LinkedIn X-ray searches, build target-company lists, and do the outbound headhunting yourself. Our best hires won’t come inbound.

  • Processes: Constantly sharpen our hiring bars (seniority, industry fit, recency, builder pattern) consistently across every search you’re DRI for. Help improve interview processes across the org.

  • Hygiene: Keep pipelines, stages, and candidate communication clean and current in Ashby so nothing stalls and our time to hire continually improves.

  • Calibration: Flag pipeline risk early, bring calibration questions before they become misses, and constantly align with leaders across the org to improve our processes.

  • Closing: Manage candidate experience through to signed offer, including comp conversations.

KPIs

  • Time-to-fill on your owned searches, without sacrificing the bar

  • Sourced (outbound) candidates as a % of your total pipeline — we want you building your own pipeline, not living off inbound

  • Offer-accept rate on closed candidates

  • Ashby pipeline hygiene — stages and candidate status always current

Need to have

  • Excellence: You have 5+ years experience personally recruiting (sourcing, screening, managing, and closing) great candidates across difficult searches. You can point to hires that materially raised the talent bar of the teams they joined.

  • Hunter: You can turn a vague candidate profile into target companies, search strings and a high-quality outbound pipeline. You do not depend on inbound applicants or agencies to fill roles.

  • Senior hiring: You have successfully recruited senior leaders and understand how sourcing, assessing and closing them differs from junior hiring.

  • Judgment: You can distinguish exceptional people from candidates who simply have the right companies, titles or polish on their CV. You develop conviction quickly and can clearly articulate why someone does or does not meet the bar.

  • Range: You can move between very different searches without losing depth. You learn unfamiliar markets quickly enough to recruit credibly within them.

  • Multi-workstream: You can run several searches simultaneously while keeping sourcing quality, candidate communication, follow-ups and pipeline hygiene exceptionally tight.

  • Urgency: You push searches forward without waiting to be managed, surface problems early, and change approach quickly when a pipeline is not working.

  • High bar: You care more about making an exceptional hire than filling a seat, and you are comfortable challenging hiring managers when you do not believe a candidate meets org standards.

Nice to have

  • Startups/Scale-ups: You’ve recruited in a fast-moving startup or scale-up where priorities shift quickly, roles evolve mid-search, and there isn’t always an existing playbook.

  • Technical recruiting: You’ve successfully recruited for Engineering, AI, Data, Product or other technical roles and can credibly assess candidate quality beyond surface-level credentials.

  • Regulated industries: You’ve recruited in healthcare, financial services, or another highly regulated industry where candidate requirements and operating constraints are more complex.

  • AI-native: You actively use AI and automation to improve sourcing, research, outreach, screening, and recruiting operations.

  • Systems builder: You’ve helped build or materially improve recruiting processes, tooling, scorecards, sourcing systems, or interview loops rather than simply operating an existing process.

  • Network: You have an existing network of exceptional operators, builders and leaders you’d be excited to bring into AIOS.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

    🎯 "You just build a f\*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $100k-$200k/yr, incl equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

Our Hiring Process

title: Technical Product Manager (Data Integrations)
descriptionHtml:
Orcrist is building a next generation data intelligence platform using cutting-edge technologies. We're handling petabyte-scale data with sub-second queries. Our product is a Kubernetes‑based platform delivered as B2B SaaS or as a self‑hosted on‑prem solution, including air‑gapped deployments. We enable customers across defense, law enforcement, and enterprise to turn mission-critical data into actionable intelligence.

Role

Every investigation starts with data. As PM for the Integration team, you make sure analysts in law enforcement and defense have the data they need, when they need it. You own the roadmap for integrating data from commercial vendors, open feeds, social media and messaging platforms, as well as the admin interfaces used to manage these integrations. Your work ensures data arrives current, traceable to its source and ready to use.

This is a largely technical PM role with significant ownership over a platform and admin experience that are still taking shape. You decide what gets built and in what order, working closely with engineers and other product teams to turn provider APIs and data models into scalable integrations and features that support analysts’ investigations. You’ll read API documentation, map provider data to OIP’s data model and write clear, actionable specs that engineers can build from.

What you'll do

  • Own the provider roadmap. We add a source when it answers a question analysts can’t answer today, so you start from the analyst’s problem, not from a provider’s name. You talk regularly with analysts, admins and solutions engineers in law enforcement and defense, and with the upstream teams whose features bring integration requests. You decide which providers come next and what “done” means for each.
  • Write the technical specs. Cover authentication, pagination, rate limits and quotas, incremental sync, deduplication, field mapping, and how failures surface. Every object must carry its provider, fetch time and source URL from the moment it is fetched. Our platform runs as SaaS and on-prem, so you also decide how each source behaves in each distribution.
  • Own the connectors as a product. That covers the contract between connectors and the platform, versioning, and how quickly a new provider goes from evaluation to production. Every connector should make the next one cheaper. Where another team can reach a public source on its own, you give it a safe way to do so instead of putting it in our queue.
  • Own the admin interfaces. That means creating a connection, managing credentials, scheduling, health and status, logs, quota usage and permissions. A source we can’t monitor isn’t delivered, so every live connection needs a health check and clear failure states.
  • Work with partnerships and legal. You collaborate with the Director of OSINT and the Data Acquisition Manager to evaluate vendors, raise licensing and terms-of-service questions before we build, and turn the legal framework (storage, retention, redistribution) into product requirements. You also give the people negotiating contracts technical findings and cost per call.
  • Manage the teams around you. Upstream, you work with the teams building user-facing features, such as graphs and maps, who bring integration requests from their intelligence domain. You help them find the analyst question behind each request and decide whether a shared connector can serve several of them. Downstream, you work with the foundation teams for ontology, machine learning and processing, so incoming data arrives in a shape they can use. You forecast the load of every high-volume source before it goes live.
  • Shape person-focused investigation tools. You own how analysts go from a first lead about a person to a reviewed set of linked online identities. That includes how results are presented and reviewed, and how to avoid paying for the same lookup twice.
  • Measure the integration layer. Track sync success rate, data freshness, time to onboard a provider, active connections, and time to resolve a failed connection.

About you

  • 5+ years as a Product Manager in B2B SaaS, with experience owning a technically complex area end-to-end, such as an integration platform, an API product, or data pipelines.
  • You are comfortable in API documentation. You can discuss OAuth versus API keys, polling versus webhooks, pagination and rate limits with engineers as an equal, and you can try an endpoint yourself in Postman or curl.
  • You have designed admin or configuration interfaces for technical users: connection setup, status and error states, audit trails.
  • You write specs and acceptance criteria that are specific enough to build and test against.
  • You are data-fluent and define quality metrics for reliability and coverage, not just feature delivery.
  • You are comfortable with the legal side of third-party data: licensing, terms of service, GDPR, and provenance requirements.
  • You work well across teams, since integrations touch engineering, partnerships, customer success, and every product that consumes the data.
  • Eligible to work in Germany and willing to travel to Berlin and across DACH for workshops and customer visits.

Nice-to-haves

  • You have built or managed a connector framework, integration marketplace, or iPaaS product.
  • Familiarity with OSINT as a practitioner or product builder, and a sense of where existing collection tools fall short.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, on-prem, or air-gapped deployment constraints and what they mean for integration architecture.
  • Familiarity with entity resolution or link analysis, and how ingested data feeds them.
  • German language (B1+) 
  • Experience working directly with law enforcement or defense users in Germany or the DACH region.

What we offer

  • Real ownership, real impact: Own a critical layer of the platform that every customer relies on. Much of the integration platform and its admin experience is still taking shape, so you identify the problems, set priorities, decide what gets built, and see it through.
  • Remote-first, Germany-wide: Work from wherever you do your best work, with regular team gatherings in Berlin and other off-site locations.
  • Flexibility by default: Flexible working hours help you make work fit your life.
  • Your setup, your way: Get a personal home-office equipment budget to create a workspace that works for you.
  • 30 days of vacation: Take the time you need to recharge and come back with fresh energy.
  • Keep growing: We invest in your personal and professional development.
  • Get rewarded for impact: Performance bonuses are tied to agreed objectives and key results.
  • A warm welcome: Every new team member gets a welcome goodie bag.
  • Good people, good times: From summer and Christmas parties to regular team gatherings, we make time to celebrate together.
  • A mission that matters: Work on challenges with tangible impact on public safety and national security.

descriptionHtml:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

    • Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents, and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
    • 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.

About Product at Wave

Product has always been very important to us at Wave, starting from day one with two very strong product-minded founders. Product Managers play a central role in our organization, impacting large chunks of the company around them, similar to the founders they were shaped after years ago.

Our approach to building products may not be what you've seen in other places. Our processes are lightweight, informed by principles instead of methodologies and our PMs don't just manage backlogs full of polished tickets. Read our write-up on product at Wave!

title: Test Engineer HIL Autonomy Systems – Land Domain (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the role:
We are looking for an experienced Test Engineer – HIL who thrives in the broad spectrum between initial concept, quick prototyping and final validation for cutting-edge autonomy products in the Land Domain. You will drive building and refining our HIL and HW Test Bench infrastructure together with the HW team, and establish automated component- or subsystem-level tests on this infrastructure as an essential part of our overall test strategy. 

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Integrate relevant hardware, sensors, interfaces and software into the test environment.

  • Execute test campaigns and assess the resulting data.

  • Define clear pass, fail and invalid test criteria, including for early-stage systems where specifications may still be evolving.

  • Analyse test failures and distinguish between actual product issues and problems caused by the test setup.

  • Provide engineering teams with clear, actionable feedback based on your test results.

  • Collaborate closely with hardware, software, autonomy and systems engineering teams.

  • Continuously improve our test infrastructure, processes and overall verification and validation approach.



What you bring to the team:

  • Strong hands-on experience with HIL/HW testing, test benches and test automation, ideally in autonomy, robotics or similar complex systems.

  • Solid understanding of sensors, perception, path planning and motion control, combined with the ability to troubleshoot hardware and software integration issues.

  • A pragmatic and analytical approach to testing, including defining meaningful test criteria and pass/fail conditions, even when requirements are still evolving.

  • A hands-on and resourceful mindset, enabling you to create effective test environments and find practical solutions in fast-moving prototype projects.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to analyse failures together with engineering teams and translate test results into clear, actionable feedback.

  • A self-driven and adaptable working style with the motivation to take ownership and move challenging projects forward.

Your Benefits:

  • Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life. 

  • Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget. 

  • Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities. 

About us:

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.

title: UX Designer
descriptionHtml:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

Role

You will own the UX of Act's core app experience. This means designing the end-to-end flows users go through every day - how they start tasks, how they follow along as the AI works, how they stay in control, and how they recover when something goes wrong.

This is a UX role for a HCI product. You need to understand both user needs and AI system behavior well enough to design product flows that feel clear, reliable, and controllable.

 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own UX for Act's core app surfaces across iOS, Android, and web.

  • Design complete user flows for AI-assisted tasks - from intent capture through to task completion, including handoff, progress tracking, and error recovery.

  • Design how the app surfaces what the AI is doing, what decisions it has made, and what the user needs to confirm or adjust.

  • Map and design the full range of AI states a user encounters - loading, thinking, acting, waiting, completing, stalling, failing, and recovering.

  • Work with product, engineering, and ML teams to define user requirements and translate them into concrete design solutions.

  • Conduct usability research to understand where users lose trust, feel uncertain, or disengage.

  • Produce wireframes, user flows, and high-fidelity designs that engineering can build from directly.

  • Contribute to the design system and shared UX patterns for AI app surfaces.

  • Design for both simple everyday interactions and complex multi-step AI workflows within the same product.

 

What You Will Need

  • Experience as a UX designer on consumer mobile or web apps, with a strong portfolio.

  • Solid skills in user flow design, wireframing, and high-fidelity prototyping in Figma.

  • Ability to design for systems that are asynchronous, non-deterministic, and context-dependent.

  • Clear thinking about user trust, control, feedback, and transparency in AI-driven product experiences.

  • Experience conducting user research and turning findings into design decisions.

  • Comfortable working in fast-moving teams with evolving product scope.

  • Ability to balance simple consumer UX with complex AI system behavior.

  • Good judgment on usability, edge cases, failure handling, and recovery flows.

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design assessment.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

title: Verification & Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast. By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.
What you'll do

  • Own the system architecture and system model for Hypersonica’s high‑speed flight vehicles, ensuring mission intent, vehicle dynamics, avionics, and GNC form a coherent, verifiable whole.

  • Lead aerospace systems architecture design, taking responsibility for how the vehicle is defined across disciplines from early concept through Preliminary Design Review (PDR) and beyond.

  • Build and maintain the authoritative system requirements model, decomposing mission‑level objectives into clear, testable system and sub‑system requirements.

  • Define and own the end‑to‑end system V‑model, including requirements validation, verification strategy, and clear readiness gates for Kick‑off and PDR.

  • Apply model‑based systems engineering (MBSE) as a practical engineering tool, not a documentation exercise, ensuring traceability between requirements, models, analyses, and tests.

  • Develop and deliver a 6‑DoF Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) model to PDR standard, in close collaboration with flight physics and avionics engineers.

  • Apply closed‑loop control theory in the context of high‑speed flight and military guidance, ensuring controllability, stability, and performance are understood at the system level.

  • Integrate vehicle dynamics, control laws, sensors, and actuators into a coherent closed‑loop system representation.

  • Identify system‑level risks early particularly around requirements gaps, controllability, observability, and verification — and drive mitigations decisively.

  • Act as a technical authority across disciplines, keeping architectural decisions coherent as designs evolve at pace.


Who you are

  • An experienced Systems Engineer with a strong track record in system architecture, requirements decomposition, and delivery in safety‑ or mission‑critical environments.

  • Deeply fluent in model‑based systems engineering, with practical experience owning requirements models and using MBSE to drive real engineering decisions.

  • Strong grounding in closed‑loop control theory, applied to high‑speed flight, guidance, and defence or military systems.

  • Comfortable developing and working with 6‑DoF flight and GNC models, and understanding their implications at vehicle level.

  • Experienced taking systems through early design gates (Kick‑off, PDR), not just theoretical or paper studies.

  • Someone who thinks in system behaviours, interfaces, and failure modes, not isolated components.

  • Confident operating in ambiguous, fast‑moving environments where decisions must be made with incomplete data.

  • Technically credible across disciplines, able to challenge assumptions and close decisions without consensus theatre.

  • Motivated by working on systems where performance, robustness, and national‑level impact genuinely matter.


What we offer

  • A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.

  • A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.


Security and Elgibility Requirement
Due to the nature of the work with the UK MOD, applicants must be a British Citizen (or Dual UK national with British citizenship) and eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and, where required, Developed Vetting (DV) At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply. title: Warehouse Associate - Bermondsey
descriptionHtml:
Warehouse Associate

Location: Bermondsey (SE16)

Working pattern: Onsite | Part-time | Shift-based (15 hours per week)

Pay: £14.40 per hour

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Site Operations team powers the physical side of our marketplace through HOP (our rapid grocery delivery service) and Editions (our network of delivery-only kitchens). From launching new sites to ensuring operational excellence across markets, we combine retail and hospitality expertise with operational rigour. If you thrive in hands-on environments and want to help redefine how food and groceries reach customers—come join us on the ground.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Associate to join our Bermondsey team. Our Warehouse Associates are the beating heart of our day-to-day site operations. You’ll work closely with your management team to ensure our loyal customers get what they want when they need it, ensuring the smooth running of our Hop sites.

Get to know our Site Operations team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Execute precise order fulfillment by picking customer essentials quickly and accurately to meet delivery deadlines.

  • Maintain product integrity by ensuring all goods received and dispatched meet our high standards for freshness and quality.

  • Facilitate seamless logistics through clear communication with riders to ensure prompt order handovers.

  • Drive inventory excellence by supporting the intake of daily stock deliveries and assisting with ongoing inventory management.

  • Champion site safety and standards by maintaining a clean, organized warehouse environment for the whole team.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Adaptability in fast-paced environments, with the ability to remain focused under pressure.

  • Strong attention to detail to ensure order accuracy and high-quality stock control.

  • Effective communication skills to collaborate with teammates, managers, and riders.

  • A proactive, hands-on mentality with a drive to solve problems as they arise on-site.

  • A customer-first mindset, understanding that your speed and accuracy directly impact the user experience.

  • Previous experience in FMCG, Retail, or Warehouse environments is valued but not required.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, operations are central to how we build trust across our marketplace. You’ll work in a fast-paced environment where service excellence drives real impact.

  • 🔧 See the impact of your work in real time: Solve problems as they happen, turning challenges into positive experiences across our three-sided marketplace.

  • 🌱 Grow through doing: Develop problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills with structured progression pathways and real opportunities to move into management.

  • 🤝 Be part of a tight-knit culture: Work collaboratively to achieve shared goals in an environment that values support, ownership, and resilience.

  • 🕒 Flexibility that works for you: Enjoy the benefits of shift-based work that fits your schedule.

Our Interview Process

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine:

  • Step 1: Apply – Apply for any role you’d like to be considered for. We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

  • Step 2: Online assessment – If your application is successful, you’ll receive an assessment from our AI hiring assistant, Maki People. Please note: this must be completed to continue.

  • Step 3: Initial conversation – One of our Recruitment team will get in touch to talk through your experience and what you’re looking for next.

  • Step 4: Final Onsite interview – You’ll be invited to an onsite interview with one of our Site Managers.

  • Step 5: Outcome – We’ll get back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the result!

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

Gestalte die Zukunft der öffentlichen Verwaltung mit uns!

Ayunis (ehem. Locaboo) ist ein führendes GovTech-Startup aus München mit über 900 Kunden (Städte, Gemeinden und Kommunen) in der DACH-Region.

Aber öffentlicher Sektor? Ist das nicht super-bürokratisch?

Das dachten wir zu Beginn auch. Aber der öffentliche Bereich ist stark im Wandel und du wirst schnell merken, wie unglaublich offen und motiviert die Menschen in der Verwaltung sind. Sie sind einfach nur mega happy, dass sich bei der Digitalisierung endlich etwas tut.

Als Werkstudent im Bereich Finance & Accounting arbeitest du eng mit unserem CEO und unserer externen Steuerberatung zusammen und erhältst wertvolle Einblicke in die finanzielle Steuerung eines schnell wachsenden KI-Startups.

  • Du unterstützt uns bei der vorbereitenden Buchhaltung und im Accounting, prüfst Rechnungen, behältst offene Posten im Blick und arbeitest eng mit unserer externen Steuerberatung zusammen.
